story.en:
Serenetti is one of the Derivative Anomalies of the Silent Garden, serving as the embodiment of the Garden's will. It is a massive, pale plant composed of vines and flowers that bind the Gardener that triggers the Silent Garden's activation. Words siphoned from the Gardener's mind randomly manifest onto Serenetti's petals, though only those carrying negative emotions seem to do so. Based on observation and speculation, the Silent Garden's activation process originates from Serenetti, spreading throughout the entire Garden. It is connected to all plants within the Garden through some form of unseen bond.
Though other vegetation in the Garden may be hostile, Serenetti itself does not display strong aggression. It serves as the core of the Silent Garden's Derivative Anomalies, and as the executor of the Garden's will, it represents absolute control over "words." It strips the Gardener of speech, restricts that poor soul's actions. It proceeds to extract their life force, reshaping it into various plants that adorn the Garden, ensuring that not a single sound disturbs the space. Despite this, Serenetti also serves to protect the Gardener. Any act of offense toward the Gardener, or any attempt at rescue, will enrage Serenetti and trigger a ferocious counterattack.
In battle with Serenetti, "words" become its power. Or rather, the malice within words is somehow converted into physical violent attacks. During combat, one might observe certain text entities laden with negative emotions taking physical form. These words have been deliberately distorted and do not represent the true intentions of the one chosen as Gardener, yet their offensive capability bears a certain correlation to the Gardener's thoughts.
Even after rescuing the Gardener from Serenetti's control, the victim will bear permanent physical and psychological damage. There is no perfect solution. As the saying often goes… some wounds never heal.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Binds the Gardener, displaying words stripped from the Gardener on its petals.
· Does not initiate attacks, but will counter actions that attempt to harm, rescue, or anger the Gardener.
· Transforms words and malice into physical attacks.

Anomaly Nexus
Eliminate or rescue the Gardener, or have the Gardener break the Garden's silence through speech.

Risk Assessment
Moderate risk.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Only appears when the Silent Garden is active; cannot be contained separately.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/
story.id:
Serenetti adalah salah satu Derivative Anomaly milik Silent Garden, sekaligus perwujudan kehendak Garden. Ia adalah tumbuhan raksasa yang pucat, tersusun dari sulur dan bunga yang membelit Gardener yang memicu aktifnya Silent Garden. Kata-kata yang disedot dari pikiran Gardener muncul secara acak di kelopak Serenetti, meski tampaknya hanya kata-kata yang membawa emosi negatif. Berdasarkan pengamatan dan dugaan, proses aktifnya Silent Garden berasal dari Serenetti, lalu menyebar ke seluruh Garden. Ia terhubung dengan semua tumbuhan di dalam Garden lewat semacam ikatan tak kasatmata.
Meski tumbuhan lain di Garden mungkin bermusuhan, Serenetti sendiri tidak menunjukkan agresivitas yang kuat. Ia adalah inti Derivative Anomaly Silent Garden, dan sebagai pelaksana kehendak Garden, ia mewakili kendali mutlak atas "kata-kata". Ia merampas ucapan Gardener dan membatasi gerak jiwa malang itu. Lalu ia menyedot daya hidupnya, membentuknya ulang menjadi berbagai tumbuhan yang menghiasi Garden, memastikan tak ada satu suara pun yang mengusik ruang itu. Meski begitu, Serenetti juga berperan melindungi Gardener. Setiap tindakan menyerang Gardener, atau upaya penyelamatan apa pun, akan membuat Serenetti marah dan memicu serangan balik yang ganas.
Dalam pertarungan melawan Serenetti, "kata-kata" menjadi kekuatannya. Atau lebih tepatnya, kebencian di dalam kata-kata entah bagaimana diubah menjadi serangan kekerasan fisik. Selama pertarungan, kamu mungkin melihat entitas tulisan tertentu yang sarat emosi negatif mengambil wujud fisik. Kata-kata ini sengaja diputarbalikkan dan tidak mewakili niat sebenarnya orang yang terpilih sebagai Gardener, tapi kemampuan menyerangnya punya keterkaitan tertentu dengan pikiran Gardener.
Bahkan setelah Gardener berhasil diselamatkan dari kendali Serenetti, korban akan menanggung kerusakan fisik dan psikologis permanen. Tidak ada solusi sempurna. Seperti pepatah yang sering diucapkan… ada luka yang tak pernah sembuh.

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Membelit Gardener, menampilkan kata-kata yang dirampas dari Gardener di kelopaknya.
· Tidak menyerang lebih dulu, tapi akan membalas tindakan yang berusaha mencelakai, menyelamatkan, atau membuat marah Gardener.
· Mengubah kata-kata dan kebencian menjadi serangan fisik.

Anomaly Nexus
Singkirkan atau selamatkan Gardener, atau buat Gardener memecah keheningan Garden lewat ucapan.

Penilaian Risiko
Risiko sedang.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Hanya muncul saat Silent Garden aktif; tidak bisa di-contain secara terpisah.

Langkah Containment
/

story.en:
Fleur the Storyteller is one of the Derivative Anomalies of the Silent Garden. Compared to the other wildly overgrown vegetation in the Silent Garden, Fleur is arguably the most gentle and harmless. This plant appears as a flower with deep blue petals blooming on its vines, but at the center lies a white porcelain-like mask wrapped in plant matter. Fleur can emit a type of "readable" pheromone that conveys fragmented information, producing a sensation similar to "hearing" in those who perceive it. For ease of understanding, this method of information transmission will be referred to as a form of "narration". Based on the gathered evidence, the stories told by Fleur seem to be anecdotes about the Serenetti family. Though the garden has fallen into ruin and the family head no longer exists, the invisible shackles of their strict discipline still remain. As a result, all narrations by Fleur maintain a vague and unclear tone. The muffled "voices," ambiguous stories, and deliberately embellished wording make these narrations seem rather unreliable. However, since so much time has passed, these scattered stories relayed by the Anomaly are the only knowledge we now have of that once prosperous family.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Tells visitors stories of the Serenetti family's past, though with questionable authenticity.

Anomaly Nexus
Bound to C-3624(Lo) Silent Garden.

Risk Assessment
Harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Only appears when the Silent Garden is active; cannot be contained separately.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records

Derivative Anomaly

story.id:
Fleur the Storyteller adalah salah satu Derivative Anomaly milik Silent Garden. Dibanding tumbuhan lain di Silent Garden yang tumbuh liar, Fleur bisa dibilang yang paling lembut dan tidak berbahaya. Tumbuhan ini berwujud bunga berkelopak biru tua yang mekar di sulurnya, tapi di tengahnya terdapat topeng putih mirip porselen yang terbungkus bahan tumbuhan. Fleur bisa mengeluarkan semacam feromon yang "bisa dibaca" dan menyampaikan potongan informasi, menimbulkan sensasi mirip "mendengar" bagi yang merasakannya. Agar mudah dipahami, cara penyampaian informasi ini akan disebut semacam "penuturan". Berdasarkan bukti yang terkumpul, kisah-kisah yang dituturkan Fleur tampaknya anekdot tentang keluarga Serenetti. Meski taman itu sudah menjadi reruntuhan dan kepala keluarganya sudah tiada, belenggu tak kasatmata dari disiplin keras mereka masih tersisa. Akibatnya, semua penuturan Fleur bernada samar dan tidak jelas. "Suara" yang teredam, kisah yang ambigu, dan kata-kata yang sengaja dibumbui membuat penuturan ini terasa kurang bisa dipercaya. Namun, karena waktu sudah berlalu begitu lama, kisah-kisah yang tersebar dan disampaikan Anomaly ini adalah satu-satunya pengetahuan yang kita miliki tentang keluarga yang dulu makmur itu.

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Menuturkan kisah masa lalu keluarga Serenetti kepada pengunjung, meski keasliannya diragukan.

Anomaly Nexus
Terikat pada C-3624(Lo) Silent Garden.

Penilaian Risiko
Tidak berbahaya.

Status Containment/Penjaminan

story.en:
Mammon came into existence long ago, when ancient tribes first began fighting over treasure and territory. The Anomaly's true form is that of a massive black beast, yet it chooses to appear before people as a black cat with golden eyes, adorned with lavish jewelry. It is a omen of desire, with a keen nose that can sniff out the scent of greed. This elegant black cat prowls near wars sparked by avarice, seizing desires to satisfy its bottomless appetite. Besides desire, Mammon also loves to devour money. After all, for thousands of years, humanity has never given up its pursuit and possession of wealth, so the greed attached to coin is often the richest and purest.
In the modern times, conflicts have all but ceased. Once people's basic needs are largely met, the little desire they retain isn't even enough to serve as a snack for Mammon. As the hungry black cat was searching for food, its gaze fell upon the wealthiest family in Hethereau, the Dvořák family, and the Anomaly that could bring infinite wealth, Ladon. Thus, Pink Paws Bank and Gold Apple Collection Hall became the two locations Mammon frequents most. Predictably, the deplorable act of devouring gold coins is absolutely intolerable to Ladon, who views Mammon as a natural enemy. The moment Mammon's trail appears nearby, Ladon will mercilessly drive it away, refusing to stop until Mammon is nullified. To humans, the conflict between these two Anomalies appears to be nothing more than two bad-tempered cats fighting. Before long, their "guardians", representatives of the Dvořák family and members of ETD, will arrive with dried fish and balls of yarn to mediate. This is a common sight to see. Apart from Fons being swallowed by Mammon, their disputes have not caused any real harm to other people or buildings. But from the perspective of the Anomalies, every time they roll up their sleeves and prepare to give the other a good thrashing, some meddlesome humans always show up to watch or break up the fight… This must give both cats quite the headache.
In truth, Mammon may have arrived in this city much earlier than people realize. Several decades ago, a massive and violent beast-type Anomaly suddenly appeared in the central area of Hethereau and attacked nearby residents, causing a great panic. The Bureau of Anomaly Control was urgently dispatched to contain this unknown Anomaly, but it fled after its defeat and its whereabouts became unknown. Personnel involved in the containment conducted a carpet search of the surrounding area but found nothing, with no trace of this monster surfacing again. According to reliable sources, that Anomaly was actually Mammon's true form. After being defeated, it did not leave, choosing instead to wander the streets in the guise of a stray cat. For unknown reasons, its Wertheimer Index fluctuations are extremely low, so the Bureau of Anomaly Control never detected its presence. No one would connect the Fons thief currently running rampant in Hethereau with the black beast that once caused so much trouble… But what brought Mammon to this city in the first place? Why does it truly linger here? The secrets hidden behind those golden eyes may only be uncovered by those who come after…
In my opinion, even if Mammon were to devour the entire Dvořák family's fortune- no, all the wealth in Hethereau, or even the entire world, it would only temporarily appease its insatiable heart. Desire itself can never be truly satisfied. One needs only look back at history: no matter how much desire is fulfilled, new desires will continue to emerge endlessly. Perhaps it is under this powerful catalyst that the wheels of our society keep rolling forward, never ceasing.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Its true form is a massive black beast. Under normal circumstances, it appears as a black cat with golden eyes.
· Feeds on human greed and money. Seems to possess the ability to amplify human desires.

Anomaly Nexus
Giving Mammon what it craves will achieve temporary nullification.

Risk Assessment
Moderate risk. Generally harmless to humans, but since it is impossible to predict when it might go berserk, cautious contact is advised.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Unique Anomaly. Not in containment.

Containment Measures
Not in containment.

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

Extended Info
/
story.id:
Mammon muncul sejak lama, saat suku-suku kuno pertama kali berebut harta dan wilayah. Wujud asli Anomaly ini adalah binatang buas hitam raksasa, tapi ia memilih tampil di hadapan orang sebagai kucing hitam bermata emas yang berhias perhiasan mewah. Ia adalah pertanda hasrat, dengan hidung tajam yang bisa mengendus aroma keserakahan. Kucing hitam yang anggun ini berkeliaran di dekat perang yang dipicu ketamakan, merebut hasrat untuk memuaskan nafsu makannya yang tak berdasar. Selain hasrat, Mammon juga suka melahap uang. Bagaimanapun, selama ribuan tahun, umat manusia tak pernah berhenti mengejar dan memiliki kekayaan, sehingga keserakahan yang melekat pada uang sering kali yang paling kaya dan murni.
Di zaman modern, konflik nyaris berhenti. Begitu kebutuhan dasar orang-orang sebagian besar terpenuhi, sedikit hasrat yang tersisa bahkan tak cukup jadi camilan bagi Mammon. Saat kucing hitam yang kelaparan itu mencari makan, pandangannya jatuh pada keluarga terkaya di Hethereau, keluarga Dvořák, dan Anomaly yang bisa mendatangkan kekayaan tanpa batas, Ladon. Maka Pink Paws Bank dan Gold Apple Collection Hall menjadi dua tempat yang paling sering didatangi Mammon. Seperti dugaan, tindakan tercela melahap koin emas sama sekali tak bisa ditoleransi Ladon, yang menganggap Mammon musuh alaminya. Begitu jejak Mammon muncul di dekatnya, Ladon akan mengusirnya tanpa ampun, menolak berhenti sampai Mammon ter-nullify. Bagi manusia, konflik antara kedua Anomaly ini tampak tak lebih dari dua kucing pemarah yang berkelahi. Tak lama kemudian, para "wali" mereka, perwakilan keluarga Dvořák dan anggota ETD, akan datang membawa ikan kering dan gulungan benang untuk melerai. Pemandangan ini sudah biasa. Selain Fons yang ditelan Mammon, perselisihan mereka tidak pernah benar-benar mencelakai orang lain atau bangunan. Tapi dari sudut pandang para Anomaly, setiap kali mereka menyingsingkan lengan dan bersiap menghajar lawannya, selalu ada manusia usil yang datang menonton atau melerai… Ini pasti cukup bikin pusing kedua kucing itu.
Sebenarnya, Mammon mungkin sudah tiba di kota ini jauh lebih awal dari yang orang kira. Beberapa dekade lalu, Anomaly jenis binatang buas yang besar dan ganas tiba-tiba muncul di pusat Hethereau dan menyerang warga sekitar, menimbulkan kepanikan besar. Bureau of Anomaly Control dikerahkan segera untuk meng-contain Anomaly tak dikenal ini, tapi ia kabur setelah dikalahkan dan keberadaannya tak diketahui. Personel yang terlibat dalam Containment menyisir area sekitarnya tapi tak menemukan apa pun, dan jejak monster ini tak pernah muncul lagi. Menurut sumber terpercaya, Anomaly itu sebenarnya wujud asli Mammon. Setelah dikalahkan, ia tidak pergi, melainkan memilih berkeliaran di jalanan dengan menyamar sebagai kucing liar. Entah kenapa, fluktuasi Wertheimer Index-nya sangat rendah, sehingga Bureau of Anomaly Control tak pernah mendeteksi keberadaannya. Tak ada yang akan menghubungkan pencuri Fons yang kini merajalela di Hethereau dengan binatang buas hitam yang dulu menimbulkan banyak masalah… Tapi apa yang membawa Mammon ke kota ini sejak awal? Kenapa ia sebenarnya bertahan di sini? Rahasia di balik mata emas itu mungkin hanya bisa diungkap oleh mereka yang datang kemudian…
Menurutku, bahkan jika Mammon melahap seluruh kekayaan keluarga Dvořák, bukan, seluruh kekayaan di Hethereau, bahkan seluruh dunia, itu hanya akan menenangkan hatinya yang tak pernah puas untuk sementara. Hasrat itu sendiri tak akan pernah benar-benar terpuaskan. Cukup lihat sejarah: seberapa banyak pun hasrat yang terpenuhi, hasrat baru akan terus muncul tanpa akhir. Mungkin di bawah pemicu yang kuat inilah roda masyarakat kita terus bergulir maju, tak pernah berhenti.

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Wujud aslinya binatang buas hitam raksasa. Dalam keadaan normal, ia berwujud kucing hitam bermata emas.
· Memakan keserakahan manusia dan uang. Tampaknya punya kemampuan memperkuat hasrat manusia.

Anomaly Nexus
Memberikan apa yang didambakan Mammon akan membuatnya ter-nullify sementara.

Penilaian Risiko
Risiko sedang. Umumnya tidak berbahaya bagi manusia, tapi karena mustahil memprediksi kapan ia mengamuk, disarankan berhati-hati saat berinteraksi.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Anomaly unik. Tidak di-contain.

Langkah Containment
Tidak di-contain.

Catatan Eksperimen
/

story.en:
The Swallowtail was first sighted near a certain school. Its form is that of a giant butterfly with vivid colors, composed of numerous paper fragments resembling movie ticket stubs. This makes it rather cumbersome, capable only of low-altitude flight. Despite this, Swallowtail seems to constantly attempt to fly higher, though it has never succeeded.
There are many theories about Swallowtail's origin. The most widely circulated comes from an urban legend:
There was once a girl at the school nicknamed "Butterfly." She was introverted and kept to herself, having no friends. Then one day, that quiet and reclusive girl suddenly made a new friend! They skipped classes together for an entire week, and during that time, the two were reportedly always watching movies at the cinema. Eventually, her parents could no longer tolerate this and locked her in her room, only allowing her out once she promised to stop skipping class. A few days later, when her parents opened the door, they found the window wide open, movie ticket stubs scattered across the empty room, and the girl nowhere to be found…
Most of this story has been verified as true, but it seems the girl never had a so-called "new friend". This new friend is speculated to be connected to the Anomaly's iconic movie ticket stubs: movies that provide viewers with illusions unbounded by reality. For some, a refuge from real life… The girl's life was mundane and unhappy. She was likely easily drawn to the dramatic highs and lows of movie plots, leading her to imagine a new friend who could help her escape reality while also reducing the guilt from her rebellious behavior.
The urban legend is incomplete, and the girl's whereabouts remain unknown. The only certainty is that her habit of collecting ticket stubs and immersing herself in the fictional worlds of movies gave birth to Swallowtail. Swallowtail's constant attempts to fly toward the sky are also believed to stem from the girl's wishes.

Anomaly Characteristics
Swallowtail has a cumbersome body and maintains low-altitude flight at all times.
Displays extreme aggression toward humans. Multiple witnesses claim to have seen Swallowtail kill passersby. However, no casualties have ever occurred at its sighting locations. It is speculated that Swallowtail possesses the ability to create illusions.
In fact, Swallowtail only causes real harm to those who attack it. Multiple Anomaly Hunters who attempted its nullification have been attacked, with severe cases even being life-threatening.
Shows clear fear of fire. Those who approach it while carrying flames will also receive its real attacks.

Anomaly Nexus
Burn the ticket stubs on its body.

Risk Assessment
Stable.

Containment/Guarantee Status
It transforms into a single ticket stub upon containment, causing the main body to disappear. Therefore, it cannot be contained.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/
story.id:
Swallowtail pertama kali terlihat di dekat sebuah sekolah. Wujudnya kupu-kupu raksasa berwarna cerah, tersusun dari banyak potongan kertas mirip sobekan tiket bioskop. Ini membuatnya cukup lamban, hanya mampu terbang rendah. Meski begitu, Swallowtail tampaknya terus berusaha terbang lebih tinggi, meski tak pernah berhasil.
Ada banyak teori tentang asal-usul Swallowtail. Yang paling banyak beredar berasal dari sebuah legenda urban:
Dulu ada seorang gadis di sekolah itu yang dijuluki "Butterfly". Ia pendiam dan menyendiri, tak punya teman. Lalu suatu hari, gadis yang pendiam dan tertutup itu tiba-tiba punya teman baru! Mereka bolos sekolah bersama selama seminggu penuh, dan selama itu, keduanya konon selalu menonton film di bioskop. Akhirnya, orang tuanya tak tahan lagi dan mengurungnya di kamar, hanya mengizinkannya keluar setelah ia berjanji berhenti bolos. Beberapa hari kemudian, saat orang tuanya membuka pintu, mereka mendapati jendela terbuka lebar, sobekan tiket bioskop berserakan di kamar yang kosong, dan gadis itu tak ditemukan di mana pun…
Sebagian besar kisah ini sudah terbukti benar, tapi tampaknya gadis itu tak pernah punya apa yang disebut "teman baru". Teman baru ini diduga berkaitan dengan sobekan tiket bioskop yang menjadi ciri khas Anomaly ini: film yang memberi penontonnya ilusi tanpa batas kenyataan. Bagi sebagian orang, tempat berlindung dari kehidupan nyata… Hidup gadis itu biasa saja dan tidak bahagia. Ia kemungkinan mudah terpikat pada naik turunnya alur film yang dramatis, sehingga membayangkan seorang teman baru yang bisa membantunya lari dari kenyataan sekaligus mengurangi rasa bersalah atas perilakunya yang memberontak.
Legenda urban itu tidak lengkap, dan keberadaan gadis itu masih belum diketahui. Satu-satunya yang pasti, kebiasaannya mengoleksi sobekan tiket dan tenggelam dalam dunia rekaan film melahirkan Swallowtail. Usaha Swallowtail yang terus-menerus terbang ke arah langit juga diyakini berasal dari keinginan gadis itu.

Karakteristik Anomaly
Swallowtail bertubuh lamban dan selalu terbang rendah.
Menunjukkan agresivitas ekstrem terhadap manusia. Beberapa saksi mengaku melihat Swallowtail membunuh orang yang lewat. Namun, tak pernah ada korban jiwa di lokasi penampakannya. Diduga Swallowtail punya kemampuan menciptakan ilusi.
Kenyataannya, Swallowtail hanya benar-benar mencelakai mereka yang menyerangnya. Beberapa Anomaly Hunter yang mencoba me-nullify-nya diserang, bahkan dalam kasus parah sampai mengancam nyawa.
Jelas takut pada api. Mereka yang mendekatinya sambil membawa api juga akan menerima serangan sungguhannya.

Anomaly Nexus
Bakar sobekan tiket di tubuhnya.

Penilaian Risiko
Stabil.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Ia berubah menjadi selembar sobekan tiket saat di-contain, membuat tubuh utamanya lenyap. Karena itu, ia tidak bisa di-contain.

Langkah Containment
/

Catatan Eksperimen

Derivative Anomaly

story.en:
Throughout various Anomalous Realms, both Hunters and Bureau personnel have witnessed a cyan bird-like Anomaly. This Anomaly, which we call the Fire Phoenix, exhibits simple behavioral patterns with no intelligence, communication abilities, or aggression. It has virtually no notable characteristics and is even more docile than common birds.

The Fire Phoenix typically appears as a surge Anomaly within other Anomalies' Anomalous Realms, rarely manifesting independently. The Fire Phoenix instinctively seeks stable, secure Anomalous Realms or long-term Esper constructs as habitats. Once separated from these "habitable environments," the Fire Phoenix will naturally undergo Nullification over time. Unlike common birds, The Fire Phoenix does not seem to eat or digest, yet still instinctively avoids danger. Its flight capabilities match those of skilled flying birds. When entering Anomalous Realms or inhabiting Esper constructs, The Fire Phoenix briefly strips off its physical state and enters an energy form. This transformation is also used to evade danger, but when used under non-habitable conditions, it significantly reduces the Fire Phoenix's existence time before natural Nullification.
The Fire Phoenix's instinct to seek Anomalous Realms or Esper constructs can sometimes be used for guidance; but this makes them difficult to contain. Apart from the Bureau of Anomaly Control, civilian conditions suitable for long-term Fire Phoenix habitation are virtually nonexistent; but even with such conditions, maintenance costs are considerable, making the containment of a Fire Phoenix cost-prohibitive.
Some researchers theorize that the Fire Phoenix may be fundamentally connected to Anomaly genesis. If we compare an anomaly's birth in the real world to an explosion, the "ashes" stirred up by its aftershock become the Fire Phoenix. As ashes don't retain heat for long, the Fire Phoenix exists in a constant state of "decay" over time. If it can receive some form of "replenishment" from Anomalous Realms or Esper constructs, the Fire Phoenix can continue existing, which explains why they seek these habitable environments.

Anomaly Characteristics
• Instinctively seeks Anomalous Realms or Esper constructs as habitats.
• Transforms into energy form when entering habitats or evading danger.

Anomaly Nexus
Eliminate its physical form through attack, or allow natural Nullification over time under non-habitable conditions.

Risk Assessment
Harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Due to the demanding conditions required for containing the Fire Phoenix, only the Celaeno Compound currently maintains a limited number in containment; civilian containment is virtually nonexistent.
Currently, this Anomaly cannot be guaranteed.

Containment Measures
Joint containment with Anomalies capable of forming stable, secure Anomalous Realms.

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

Extended Info
/
story.id:
Di berbagai Anomalous Realm, para Hunter dan personel Bureau pernah melihat Anomaly mirip burung berwarna biru kehijauan. Anomaly yang kami sebut Fire Phoenix ini menunjukkan pola perilaku sederhana tanpa kecerdasan, kemampuan berkomunikasi, atau sifat agresif. Ia nyaris tak punya karakteristik yang menonjol, bahkan lebih jinak dari burung biasa.

Fire Phoenix biasanya muncul sebagai surge Anomaly di dalam Anomalous Realm milik Anomaly lain, dan jarang muncul sendiri. Fire Phoenix secara naluriah mencari Anomalous Realm yang stabil dan aman atau Esper construct jangka panjang sebagai habitat. Begitu terpisah dari "lingkungan layak huni" ini, Fire Phoenix akan ter-nullify secara alami seiring waktu. Tidak seperti burung biasa, Fire Phoenix tampaknya tidak makan atau mencerna, tapi tetap secara naluriah menghindari bahaya. Kemampuan terbangnya setara burung yang mahir terbang. Saat memasuki Anomalous Realm atau menghuni Esper construct, Fire Phoenix sejenak melepaskan wujud fisiknya dan berubah ke wujud energi. Perubahan ini juga dipakai untuk menghindari bahaya, tapi jika dipakai di kondisi yang tidak layak huni, waktu keberadaan Fire Phoenix sebelum ter-nullify secara alami akan berkurang drastis.
Naluri Fire Phoenix mencari Anomalous Realm atau Esper construct terkadang bisa dimanfaatkan sebagai penunjuk arah, tapi ini membuatnya sulit di-contain. Selain di Bureau of Anomaly Control, kondisi sipil yang cocok untuk tempat tinggal jangka panjang Fire Phoenix nyaris tidak ada; bahkan dengan kondisi seperti itu, biaya perawatannya cukup besar, sehingga meng-contain Fire Phoenix terlalu mahal.
Beberapa peneliti berteori bahwa Fire Phoenix mungkin pada dasarnya berkaitan dengan kelahiran Anomaly. Jika kelahiran Anomaly di dunia nyata diibaratkan ledakan, "abu" yang terangkat oleh gelombang susulannya menjadi Fire Phoenix. Karena abu tidak lama menyimpan panas, Fire Phoenix selalu berada dalam kondisi "meluruh" seiring waktu. Jika bisa menerima semacam "pasokan ulang" dari Anomalous Realm atau Esper construct, Fire Phoenix bisa terus ada, yang menjelaskan kenapa mereka mencari lingkungan layak huni ini.

Karakteristik Anomaly
• Secara naluriah mencari Anomalous Realm atau Esper construct sebagai habitat.
• Berubah ke wujud energi saat memasuki habitat atau menghindari bahaya.

Anomaly Nexus
Hancurkan wujud fisiknya dengan serangan, atau biarkan ter-nullify secara alami seiring waktu di kondisi yang tidak layak huni.

Penilaian Risiko
Tidak berbahaya.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Karena syarat Containment Fire Phoenix sangat berat, saat ini hanya Celaeno Compound yang meng-contain sejumlah kecil Fire Phoenix; Containment oleh warga sipil nyaris tidak ada.
Saat ini, Anomaly ini tidak bisa dijamin.

Langkah Containment
Containment bersama Anomaly yang mampu membentuk Anomalous Realm yang stabil dan aman.

Catatan Eksperimen
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

quote.id: "Bak mandi punya batas. Danau punya batas. Lalu, di manakah batas dunia?"

story.en:
In modern times, a cargo ship transporting rubber ducks suffered an accidental spill. Rubber ducks intended to spin around in bathtubs poured into the ocean, embarking on a legendary voyage. Led by a giant leader duck, they drifted around the globe for decades.
Interestingly, the leader duck was not from the cargo ship, but rather, it was an Anomaly that happened to be passing by. Its name was Rubbaduck, also known the big yellow duck, with the ability to attract nearby floating objects to follow it. Due to this, the flock of ducks that fell into the sea rarely lost their way. However, as people developed a keen interest in the drifting rubber ducks, many were plucked from the flock as they floated about. Eventually, very few remained, and the voyage came to an end. Rubbaduck's main body was acquired by a certain exhibition company and is displayed to the public from time to time.
The exhibitions brought this Anomaly into the public eye, simultaneously sparking more mysteries surrounding it. Some people claim they can communicate with the big yellow duck, believing that the ducky knows everything in the world. Apparently, all kinds of information these people have received from it has been verified as true… This phenomenon has yet to be reasonably explained.
It is worth noting that records of Rubbaduck existed long before humans invented the rubber duck, and it was explicitly recorded as a living creature. Anomalies are things that should not exist, therefore, it is understandable that this big yellow duck is considered a life form that should not exist.

Anomaly Characteristics
All bodies of water in the world are one and the same to it. It tours all bodies of water in the world according to a certain pattern.
The body of water it recognizes is defined as a water volume of 520L or more. Therefore, when coming into contact with 520L or more of water, it can directly drift to another body of water through this water, unhindered by spatial barriers. As a result, it is often seen suddenly disappearing and suddenly reappearing.
It has a pull effect on floating objects within the same body of water. Other floating objects on the water surface will gather around it, drifting along with it. This pull effect is not strong and cannot attract floating objects from far away.

Anomaly Nexus
Puncture its surface and submerge it in water. It will achieve nullification on its own and reappear at the submersion site after 24 hours.

Risk Assessment
The main body is harmless, but attention should be paid to the abnormal gathering of floating objects in the water where it resides.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Currently owned by an exhibition company. This company regularly holds public exhibitions for it.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
Experiment 1
Liquid water was continuously added to the containment unit. When the water volume reached 520L, the Anomaly disappeared and was later found in a nearby lake.

Derivative Anomaly
/
story.id:
Di zaman modern, sebuah kapal kargo pengangkut bebek karet mengalami kecelakaan dan muatannya tumpah. Bebek-bebek karet yang seharusnya berputar-putar di bak mandi tumpah ke laut, memulai pelayaran legendaris. Dipimpin seekor bebek pemimpin raksasa, mereka terombang-ambing mengelilingi dunia selama puluhan tahun.
Menariknya, bebek pemimpin itu bukan berasal dari kapal kargo, melainkan Anomaly yang kebetulan lewat. Namanya Rubbaduck, juga dikenal sebagai bebek kuning besar, dengan kemampuan menarik benda-benda terapung di sekitarnya untuk mengikutinya. Karena itu, rombongan bebek yang jatuh ke laut jarang tersesat. Namun, karena orang-orang sangat tertarik pada bebek karet yang terombang-ambing, banyak yang dipungut dari rombongan saat mengapung. Akhirnya, hanya sedikit yang tersisa, dan pelayaran itu pun berakhir. Tubuh utama Rubbaduck dibeli sebuah perusahaan pameran dan sesekali dipamerkan kepada publik.
Pameran itu membuat Anomaly ini dikenal publik, sekaligus memicu lebih banyak misteri tentangnya. Sebagian orang mengaku bisa berkomunikasi dengan bebek kuning besar ini, percaya bahwa si bebek mengetahui segala hal di dunia. Rupanya, berbagai informasi yang mereka terima darinya sudah terbukti benar… Fenomena ini belum bisa dijelaskan secara masuk akal.
Perlu dicatat, catatan tentang Rubbaduck sudah ada jauh sebelum manusia menciptakan bebek karet, dan ia dengan jelas dicatat sebagai makhluk hidup. Anomaly adalah hal yang seharusnya tidak ada, jadi wajar saja bebek kuning besar ini dianggap bentuk kehidupan yang seharusnya tidak ada.

Karakteristik Anomaly
Semua perairan di dunia baginya adalah satu dan sama. Ia menjelajahi semua perairan di dunia mengikuti pola tertentu.
Perairan yang dikenalinya didefinisikan sebagai volume air 520 L atau lebih. Karena itu, saat bersentuhan dengan air 520 L atau lebih, ia bisa langsung hanyut ke perairan lain melalui air itu, tanpa terhalang batasan ruang. Akibatnya, ia sering terlihat tiba-tiba menghilang dan tiba-tiba muncul kembali.
Ia punya efek menarik terhadap benda terapung di perairan yang sama. Benda terapung lain di permukaan air akan berkumpul di sekitarnya, hanyut bersamanya. Efek tarikan ini tidak kuat dan tidak bisa menarik benda terapung dari jauh.

Anomaly Nexus
Tusuk permukaannya dan tenggelamkan ke dalam air. Ia akan ter-nullify dengan sendirinya dan muncul kembali di lokasi penenggelaman setelah 24 jam.

Penilaian Risiko
Tubuh utamanya tidak berbahaya, tapi perlu diwaspadai berkumpulnya benda terapung secara tidak wajar di perairan tempat ia berada.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Saat ini dimiliki sebuah perusahaan pameran. Perusahaan ini rutin mengadakan pameran publik untuknya.

Langkah Containment
/

Catatan Eksperimen
Eksperimen 1
Air terus ditambahkan ke unit Containment. Saat volume air mencapai 520 L, Anomaly ini menghilang dan kemudian ditemukan di danau terdekat.

Derivative Anomaly

quote.en: "Lucky, Lucky… Please come back to me."
quote.id: "Lucky, Lucky… Tolong kembalilah padaku."

story.en:
In an apartment somewhere in Hethereau, a dog named Lucky once lived with its owner, an employee of the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Lucky remembered it clearly: during that period, Anomaly cases were frequent and staff was short, so its owner had to work overtime almost every day until very, very late. Lucky, left waiting at home for its owner, felt like the loneliest little dog in the world… The owner noticed of this too, so during work, they secretly connected to the home computer's video feed. When Lucky saw its owner appear on one of the screens at home, it happily pounced forward, only to bump its nose unexpectedly. Seeing Lucky's awkward state, the owner couldn't help but laugh. Basking in the owner's smile, Lucky felt the pain in its nose fade away and stuck out its tongue, laughing along. "Once work is done, I'll come back to Lucky." Lucky remembered those words and understood that the only thing between them was this hard piece of glass that must be called "work." If only I could do "work" too, Lucky told itself, gazing at its owner hunched over the desk on the other side of the screen. If work finished sooner, the two would be reunited sooner…
Later, on one ordinary rainy night, Lucky watched its owner through the screen as usual. It noticed the owner had gotten thinner, and the dark circles under their eyes were more obvious, but the dedication to work had never changed. Lucky barked twice, trying to convey the deepest concern a little dog could imagine: Owner, you should rest! Work can be slower, Lucky isn't afraid of being lonely! Just being able to watch the owner like this is enough!
Suddenly, the screen emitted a blinding light that illuminated the entire apartment, and Lucky instinctively closed its eyes. As the light gradually dimmed and Lucky opened its eyes again, all it saw was darkness. Unable to sense its owner, Lucky frantically barked, scratched at the door, and paced around the room anxiously until it collapsed on the floor, exhausted. Lucky tried to comfort itself, thinking: The owner must be on the way home! It dragged its tired body to crouch by the door, waiting anxiously. One hour passed, two hours passed, one day passed, two days passed, but the familiar footsteps never came from outside the door again.
"Am I abandoned?" This possibility never even crossed Lucky's mind… After all, the owner said that once all the work was done, they would come back to Lucky!
A few more days passed. Lucky stared blankly at the dark computer screen, missing its owner deeply. Maybe… maybe now is the time when the owner needs me! This thought suddenly appeared in Lucky's mind. I can't just sit around doing nothing anymore. Lucky took a deep breath and opened the door.
Opened… the door…?
Lucky looked down in astonishment and found itself standing on its two hind legs, having just opened the door with its front paws, just like its owner. After a period of surprise, Lucky quickly adapted to its new body. Thinking about finding its owner filled it with strength.
A dog walking upright naturally caused quite a commotion in Hethereau. The Bureau of Anomaly Control soon received the message and, after determining it was an unregistered Bio Anomaly, dispatched two staff members to view the situation. When Lucky saw people wearing the same uniform as its owner, it happily ran up to them. Just as one of the staff was about to pull the trigger on a tranquilizer gun, the other recognized Lucky. "Aren't you Lucky? That kid in the office was always insisting on showing us photos of you!" he said, and brought Lucky to the Bureau of Anomaly Control.
The moment Lucky entered the Bureau's doors, a long-missed scent hit its nose! Following the scent, Lucky found a desk piled high with documents, with a photo framed at the corner of the desk of the owner and Lucky together. So the owner hadn't come home to be with Lucky because "work" wasn't finished! Lucky finally relaxed and grinned. It wagged its tail, wiped the dust off the photo, and then did something that shocked everyone: it began working, as naturally as could be.
The Lieutenant of ETD-4, who had rushed over upon hearing the news, stared with awe at the scene. He seemed to completely understand Lucky's feelings. This understanding Lieutenant exchanged a few words with the nearby staff, abandoned the original plan to contain Lucky. From then on, Lucky stayed at the Bureau of Anomaly Control, and was even given an official title: Agent.LUCK.
It must be said that Agent.LUCK's ability and energy amazed almost everyone. Unfinished work was like enemy number one in LUCK's eyes. As its work scope expanded, LUCK even revealed a new ability: rapidly teleporting between two lit computer screens. With this ability, LUCK could efficiently handle work from other departments.
The Bureau of Anomaly Control's search and rescue for the mysteriously vanished employee continues, but LUCK no longer worries. Deep in this dog's heart, it firmly believes that its owner is watching it work from somewhere, just as LUCK once watched its owner work through that little screen. "Once work is done, LUCK will come back to me." It seems the owner's gentle voice still echoes in its ears from time to time. So LUCK buries its head deeper in work… This is how the owner felt back then, faster, even faster! Once all the work is done, Agent.LUCK… no, Lucky will return to its owner's side, and they'll never be apart again.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Like a little dog, it has endless energy, but LUCK seems to devote all of it to work, to an astonishingly dedicated degree.
· LUCK can teleport through lit computer screens within the Bureau of Anomaly Control, helping handle work from various departments.

Anomaly Nexus
While the Anomaly is teleporting through screens, simultaneously turn off the power to both screens.

Risk Assessment
Harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Unique Anomaly, guaranteed by the Bureau of Anomaly Control

story.id:
Di sebuah apartemen di Hethereau, dulu tinggal seekor anjing bernama Lucky bersama pemiliknya, seorang pegawai Bureau of Anomaly Control. Lucky ingat betul: saat itu, kasus Anomaly sedang sering terjadi dan stafnya kekurangan orang, jadi pemiliknya harus lembur hampir setiap hari sampai larut sekali. Lucky, yang menunggu sendirian di rumah, merasa seperti anjing kecil paling kesepian di dunia… Pemiliknya juga menyadarinya, jadi saat bekerja, ia diam-diam menyambungkan kamera video ke komputer di rumah. Saat Lucky melihat pemiliknya muncul di salah satu layar di rumah, ia melompat kegirangan, tapi hidungnya malah terbentur. Melihat Lucky yang canggung, pemiliknya tak bisa menahan tawa. Disinari senyum pemiliknya, Lucky merasa sakit di hidungnya hilang lalu menjulurkan lidah, ikut tertawa. "Setelah kerjaan selesai, aku akan pulang ke Lucky." Lucky mengingat kata-kata itu dan mengerti bahwa satu-satunya yang memisahkan mereka adalah kaca keras yang bernama "kerjaan". Andai aku juga bisa "kerja", pikir Lucky, menatap pemiliknya yang membungkuk di meja di balik layar. Kalau kerjaan cepat selesai, mereka berdua bisa cepat berkumpul lagi…
Kemudian, pada suatu malam hujan yang biasa, Lucky menatap pemiliknya lewat layar seperti biasa. Ia melihat pemiliknya makin kurus, dan lingkaran hitam di bawah matanya makin jelas, tapi dedikasinya pada pekerjaan tak pernah berubah. Lucky menggonggong dua kali, berusaha menyampaikan kepedulian terdalam yang bisa dibayangkan seekor anjing kecil: Tuan, kamu harus istirahat! Kerjanya boleh pelan-pelan, Lucky tidak takut kesepian! Bisa melihat Tuan seperti ini saja sudah cukup!
Tiba-tiba, layar memancarkan cahaya menyilaukan yang menerangi seluruh apartemen, dan Lucky refleks memejamkan mata. Saat cahaya perlahan meredup dan Lucky membuka mata lagi, yang ia lihat hanyalah kegelapan. Tak bisa merasakan kehadiran pemiliknya, Lucky menggonggong panik, mencakar pintu, dan mondar-mandir gelisah di kamar sampai ambruk kelelahan di lantai. Lucky mencoba menghibur diri: Tuan pasti sedang dalam perjalanan pulang! Ia menyeret tubuhnya yang lelah dan meringkuk di dekat pintu, menunggu dengan cemas. Satu jam berlalu, dua jam berlalu, satu hari berlalu, dua hari berlalu, tapi langkah kaki yang akrab itu tak pernah lagi terdengar dari luar pintu.
"Apa aku ditelantarkan?" Kemungkinan ini bahkan tak pernah terlintas di benak Lucky… Bagaimanapun, Tuan bilang setelah semua kerjaan selesai, ia akan pulang ke Lucky!
Beberapa hari lagi berlalu. Lucky menatap kosong layar komputer yang gelap, sangat merindukan pemiliknya. Mungkin… mungkin sekaranglah saatnya Tuan membutuhkanku! Pikiran ini tiba-tiba muncul di benak Lucky. Aku tidak bisa terus diam saja. Lucky menarik napas dalam-dalam dan membuka pintu.
Membuka… pintu…?
Lucky menunduk dengan takjub dan mendapati dirinya berdiri dengan dua kaki belakang, baru saja membuka pintu dengan kaki depannya, persis seperti pemiliknya. Setelah sempat terkejut, Lucky cepat beradaptasi dengan tubuh barunya. Memikirkan akan mencari pemiliknya membuatnya penuh tenaga.
Seekor anjing yang berjalan tegak tentu saja menghebohkan Hethereau. Bureau of Anomaly Control segera menerima laporan, dan setelah memastikan itu Bio Anomaly yang belum terdaftar, mengirim dua staf untuk memeriksa situasinya. Saat Lucky melihat orang-orang berseragam sama seperti pemiliknya, ia berlari menghampiri mereka dengan gembira. Tepat saat salah satu staf hendak menarik pelatuk pistol bius, staf yang lain mengenali Lucky. "Kamu Lucky, kan? Anak di kantor itu selalu maksa nunjukin foto-fotomu ke kami!" katanya, lalu membawa Lucky ke Bureau of Anomaly Control.
Begitu Lucky melangkah masuk ke Bureau, aroma yang sudah lama ia rindukan menyergap hidungnya! Mengikuti aroma itu, Lucky menemukan meja yang penuh tumpukan dokumen, dengan foto berbingkai pemiliknya dan Lucky di sudut meja. Ternyata Tuan belum pulang menemani Lucky karena "kerjaan" belum selesai! Lucky akhirnya lega dan tersenyum lebar. Ia mengibaskan ekor, menyeka debu dari foto itu, lalu melakukan sesuatu yang mengejutkan semua orang: ia mulai bekerja, dengan sangat alami.
Letnan ETD-4, yang bergegas datang begitu mendengar kabar, menatap pemandangan itu dengan takjub. Ia tampak sepenuhnya memahami perasaan Lucky. Letnan yang pengertian itu bertukar beberapa kata dengan staf di dekatnya dan membatalkan rencana awal untuk meng-contain Lucky. Sejak itu, Lucky tinggal di Bureau of Anomaly Control, bahkan diberi gelar resmi: Agent.LUCK.
Harus diakui, kemampuan dan semangat Agent.LUCK membuat hampir semua orang kagum. Kerjaan yang belum selesai adalah musuh nomor satu di mata LUCK. Seiring cakupan kerjanya meluas, LUCK bahkan menunjukkan kemampuan baru: berteleportasi dengan cepat di antara dua layar komputer yang menyala. Dengan kemampuan ini, LUCK bisa menangani pekerjaan dari departemen lain dengan efisien.
Pencarian dan penyelamatan Bureau of Anomaly Control terhadap pegawai yang hilang secara misterius itu masih berlanjut, tapi LUCK tak lagi khawatir. Jauh di lubuk hati anjing ini, ia yakin pemiliknya sedang memperhatikannya bekerja dari suatu tempat, sama seperti LUCK dulu memperhatikan pemiliknya bekerja lewat layar kecil itu. "Setelah kerjaan selesai, LUCK akan pulang padaku." Sepertinya suara lembut pemiliknya masih sesekali terngiang di telinganya. Maka LUCK makin tenggelam dalam pekerjaan… Beginilah perasaan Tuan dulu, lebih cepat, lebih cepat lagi! Setelah semua kerjaan selesai, Agent.LUCK… bukan, Lucky akan kembali ke sisi pemiliknya, dan mereka tak akan pernah berpisah lagi.

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Seperti anak anjing, energinya tak ada habisnya, tapi LUCK tampaknya mencurahkan semuanya untuk bekerja, dengan dedikasi yang mencengangkan.
· LUCK bisa berteleportasi lewat layar komputer yang menyala di dalam Bureau of Anomaly Control, membantu menangani pekerjaan dari berbagai departemen.

Anomaly Nexus
Saat Anomaly sedang berteleportasi lewat layar, matikan daya kedua layar secara bersamaan.

Penilaian Risiko
Tidak berbahaya.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Anomaly unik, dijamin oleh Bureau of Anomaly Control

quote.en: "The sea is bleeding."
quote.id: "Lautnya berdarah."

story.en:
According to the final voyage report, the Pequod had been chasing a whale for forty days. Supplies were nearly exhausted and the crew was at their mental limit, but the whale they pursued was also on its last legs. Harpoon strikes had caused the great beast to bleed, leaving a red trail across the open ocean. The whale was heading towards a field of packed ice, perhaps hoping to force the Pequod to abandon pursuit. Shortly after, both the whale and the Pequod vanished into the packed ice. No one ever saw them again, until we encountered the Sea Prisoner.

R-1851(Or) Sea Prisoner is a large Bio Anomaly resembling a whale-like creature. According to citizen reports, when traversing the undersea tunnels, one can occasionally hear "strange singing." Continuing forward leads into the Sea Prisoner's Anomalous Realm, which resembles packed ice interspersed with shipwrecks and abandoned structures. Inside this Anomalous Realm, water becomes "walkable." The surface remains liquid, but attempting to go below the surface meets resistance. The water composition is similar to seawater, but a period after the Anomalous Realm forms, it turns a vivid blood red. Though harmless to humans, its appearance is gruesome and terrifying leading frightened drivers to abandon their vehicles and flee. Those who do so soon find themselves exiting the Anomalous Realm, back in the undersea tunnel.
The Sea Prisoner appears unable to leave its Anomalous Realm. Based on certain physical characteristics, the Sea Prisoner shares similarities with the whale the Pequod was tracking, but the Sea Prisoner has many additional growths on its body. Some appear to be characteristics of other marine creatures, while others are scars from healed wounds. A massive harpoon is lodged in the Sea Prisoner's back. It is a common whaling cannon model, but far larger than any standard harpoon. The missing Pequod was equipped with the same model, but we have no way to determine whether this particular harpoon belonged to the Pequod. Nevertheless, after confirming it as a Derivative Anomaly of R-1851(Or), we still gave it the name Pequod.
The Sea Prisoner shows no active aggression, and according to those who have encountered it, the Sea Prisoner initially is friendly and seems inclined to communicate. Unfortunately, no one can understand the Sea Prisoner's singing, so what it is trying to express remained unknown for a long time. After entering the Anomalous Realm, the water eventually turns red and the Sea Prisoner exhibits extreme pain, struggling to dislodge the harpoon deeply embedded in its back. Even without malicious intent, the Sea Prisoner's massive size causes tremendous destruction when it thrashes. After being driven mad by agony, the Sea Prisoner begins attacking everything around it indiscriminately.
Those who have encountered the Sea Prisoner generally report sensing that it is suffering gravely. Having Anomalized, it cannot die, and the harpoon on its back will torment it forever. It appears to draw others into its Anomalous Realm as a cry for help, longing for someone to end its pain. After leaving the Anomalous Realm, those who have encountered the Sea Prisoner generally express concern for its condition. A small number develop obsessive symptoms regarding "helping the Sea Prisoner," but we cannot verify whether these changes stem from post-traumatic stress after witnessing its suffering, or whether the Anomalous Realm exerted influence on their minds.

In nearly all ancient beliefs, the sea was a personified deity: generous yet capricious, an embodiment of abundance and disaster alike. Majestic creatures like whales were also imbued with much mythological significance. Yet now, as reverence for the sea has been replaced by a hunger for resources, few stop to ask: What must we give in return? Will endless plundering one day invite the sea's fury?

Anomaly Characteristics
· The Sea Prisoner is a Bio Anomaly resembling a whale, with characteristics of multiple marine creatures fused together.
· A massive harpoon is lodged in its back, which is a Derivative Anomaly.
· It continuously emits singing of unknown meaning.
· It has no malicious intent, but when affected by the harpoon, it loses reason and attacks everything around it.
· No records exist of it being observed outside its Anomalous Realm, and it is unclear whether this is due to inability or lack of intention.

Anomaly Nexus
The harpoon embedded in the Anomaly's body.

Risk Assessment
Potentially high destructive power, but only within the Anomalous Realm. After entering the Anomalous Realm, getting off the vehicle immediately allows one to leave.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Not in containment. Cannot be guaranteed.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records

R-1851-1(Ob) Pequod
story.id:
Menurut laporan pelayaran terakhir, Pequod sudah memburu seekor paus selama empat puluh hari. Perbekalan nyaris habis dan awak kapal sudah di batas mentalnya, tapi paus yang mereka buru juga sudah sekarat. Tusukan harpun membuat binatang raksasa itu berdarah, meninggalkan jejak merah di lautan lepas. Paus itu menuju hamparan es padat, mungkin berharap memaksa Pequod berhenti mengejar. Tak lama kemudian, paus dan Pequod sama-sama lenyap di hamparan es padat. Tak ada yang pernah melihat mereka lagi, sampai kami bertemu Sea Prisoner.

R-1851(Or) Sea Prisoner adalah Bio Anomaly besar yang menyerupai makhluk mirip paus. Menurut laporan warga, saat melintasi terowongan bawah laut, sesekali terdengar "nyanyian aneh". Terus maju akan membawa ke Anomalous Realm milik Sea Prisoner, yang menyerupai hamparan es padat dengan bangkai kapal dan bangunan terbengkalai di sana-sini. Di dalam Anomalous Realm ini, air menjadi "bisa dipijak". Permukaannya tetap cair, tapi mencoba masuk ke bawah permukaan akan tertahan. Komposisi airnya mirip air laut, tapi beberapa saat setelah Anomalous Realm terbentuk, air berubah merah darah yang pekat. Meski tidak berbahaya bagi manusia, penampilannya mengerikan dan menakutkan, membuat pengemudi yang ketakutan meninggalkan kendaraannya dan kabur. Mereka yang melakukannya segera mendapati dirinya keluar dari Anomalous Realm, kembali di terowongan bawah laut.
Sea Prisoner tampaknya tak bisa meninggalkan Anomalous Realm-nya. Berdasarkan beberapa ciri fisik, Sea Prisoner mirip paus yang diburu Pequod, tapi Sea Prisoner punya banyak tonjolan tambahan di tubuhnya. Sebagian tampak seperti ciri makhluk laut lain, sementara sebagian lagi bekas luka yang sudah sembuh. Sebuah harpun raksasa tertancap di punggung Sea Prisoner. Itu model meriam pemburu paus yang umum, tapi jauh lebih besar dari harpun standar mana pun. Pequod yang hilang dilengkapi model yang sama, tapi kami tak punya cara memastikan apakah harpun ini milik Pequod. Meski begitu, setelah memastikannya sebagai Derivative Anomaly dari R-1851(Or), kami tetap menamainya Pequod.
Sea Prisoner tidak menunjukkan agresi aktif, dan menurut mereka yang pernah bertemu dengannya, Sea Prisoner awalnya ramah dan tampak ingin berkomunikasi. Sayangnya, tak ada yang bisa memahami nyanyian Sea Prisoner, sehingga apa yang ingin ia sampaikan lama tidak diketahui. Setelah masuk ke Anomalous Realm, air akhirnya berubah merah dan Sea Prisoner menunjukkan kesakitan luar biasa, meronta berusaha melepaskan harpun yang tertancap dalam di punggungnya. Meski tak berniat jahat, ukuran Sea Prisoner yang raksasa menimbulkan kehancuran hebat saat ia meronta. Setelah menjadi gila karena kesakitan, Sea Prisoner mulai menyerang segala sesuatu di sekitarnya tanpa pandang bulu.
Mereka yang pernah bertemu Sea Prisoner umumnya melaporkan merasakan bahwa ia sangat menderita. Karena sudah menjadi Anomaly, ia tak bisa mati, dan harpun di punggungnya akan menyiksanya selamanya. Ia tampaknya menarik orang lain ke Anomalous Realm-nya sebagai teriakan minta tolong, merindukan seseorang yang bisa mengakhiri sakitnya. Setelah keluar dari Anomalous Realm, mereka yang pernah bertemu Sea Prisoner umumnya mengkhawatirkan keadaannya. Sebagian kecil mengalami gejala obsesif untuk "menolong Sea Prisoner", tapi kami tak bisa memastikan apakah perubahan ini berasal dari stres pascatrauma setelah menyaksikan penderitaannya, atau apakah Anomalous Realm itu memengaruhi pikiran mereka.

Di hampir semua kepercayaan kuno, laut adalah dewa yang dipersonifikasikan: murah hati sekaligus plin-plan, perwujudan kelimpahan sekaligus bencana. Makhluk agung seperti paus juga sarat makna mitologis. Namun kini, saat rasa hormat terhadap laut tergantikan rasa lapar akan sumber daya, sedikit yang berhenti untuk bertanya: apa yang harus kita berikan sebagai gantinya? Akankah penjarahan tanpa henti suatu hari mengundang murka laut?

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Sea Prisoner adalah Bio Anomaly yang menyerupai paus, dengan ciri berbagai makhluk laut yang menyatu.
· Sebuah harpun raksasa tertancap di punggungnya, yang merupakan Derivative Anomaly.
· Ia terus mengeluarkan nyanyian yang maknanya tak diketahui.
· Ia tidak berniat jahat, tapi saat terpengaruh harpun, ia kehilangan akal dan menyerang segala sesuatu di sekitarnya.
· Tidak ada catatan ia pernah terlihat di luar Anomalous Realm-nya, dan tidak jelas apakah karena tidak bisa atau tidak mau.

Anomaly Nexus
Harpun yang tertancap di tubuh Anomaly ini.

Penilaian Risiko
Berpotensi sangat merusak, tapi hanya di dalam Anomalous Realm. Setelah masuk ke Anomalous Realm, segera turun dari kendaraan agar bisa keluar.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Tidak di-contain. Tidak bisa dijamin.

quote.id: "Mungkinkah ia hanya menikmati peran sebagai ibu, mabuk oleh rasa puas diri?"

story.en:
"The children will soon hatch, and Mommy has prepared everything."
"Brocade and velvet line the bed, a red silk dreamcatcher keeps nightmares away."
"The children will soon be born, and Mommy has practiced over and over."
"Silver bells go jingle jangle, gentle whispers lull you to sleep."

…

Humming the lullaby over and over, the Mother Bird had waited far, far too long for the day her children would be born. She wished to dote upon them, granting them all the beautiful things in the world. With her mind made up, the Mother Bird spread her wings and left the nest. She journeyed around the world before her eggs hatched, gathering countless treasures. She could see it clearly now: when her children are born, their tender faces would be illuminated by the shimmer of gold and silver filling the nest.
That was the very best a mother could prepare for her children. The Mother Bird was certain of this.
And she, too, would be the very best mother.
Whenever she closed her eyes, her heart was filled with visions of nestling with her hatchlings in a nest woven with golden thread and red silk. She dreamed of gently feeding them, watching them grow up healthy and hearty.

But such a scene would never come to pass.
The Mother Bird, so full of anticipation, never got to become a mother.
When she returned to the nest with a gem-studded mask in her beak, she was devastated to find only shattered eggshells. Her children were nowhere to be found.

Who stole my children!!!
Broke their shells and stole them from their mother!!!
It is said the shrill cries from the nest continued for three days and three nights without end.

From that day on, the Mother Bird ceased to exist. Only a bird-like creature wearing a mask with an expression neither smiling nor crying, the Nestbound Bird, remained there, guarding an eggshell with its cracks mended by red thread.
Any living being in this world could be my stolen child, so I shall be the mother of any living being in this world.
My stolen, lost children. Come back to me. Come back to this beautifully decorated nest.
Mommy promises no one will ever separate us again.
Look at these Plumettes sewn from my bones, my feathers, my flesh. They will forever guard this nest.
Come back. Please, call me Mommy.

Children who grew up in Hethereau have mostly heard this story. When lost, never heed the gentle and loving female voice calling your name from who knows where. If you answer that earnest call, you will be taken back to the Nestbound Bird's nest and raised as its child. If you listen to it and call it "Mommy," you will forget yourself forever, destined to become lost in the nest.

Who exactly stole her children? This question seems destined to remain unanswered, or perhaps the Mother Bird knew the answer all along…
The Mother Bird, so blinded by decorating a comfortable nest for her children, neglected to actually care for and accompany them. The newly hatched chicks could not find their mother and, driven by hunger, had no choice but to leave the nest. Their whereabouts remain unknown.
What does it matter if the truth is simple and clear? The Mother Bird no longer exists.
Only the Nestbound Bird's earnest calls for her children continue to echo.


Anomaly Characteristics
· This Anomaly resembles a giant bird-like creature with its face concealed by a human-faced mask. It generally dwells in an Anomalous Realm it calls its "nest."
· It calls out to lost children in a gentle, loving female voice, then abducts the entranced children to its nest.
· After the Nestbound Bird succeeds, it hangs a mask at the archway of the "nest" entrance, signifying its protection over the abducted child.

Anomaly Nexus
"The identity of mother"

Risk Assessment
Critical risk.

Containment/Guarantee Status
/

Containment Measures
/
story.id:
"Anak-anak akan segera menetas, dan Ibu sudah menyiapkan segalanya."
"Brokat dan beludru melapisi ranjang, penangkap mimpi sutra merah menjauhkan mimpi buruk."
"Anak-anak akan segera lahir, dan Ibu sudah berlatih berulang kali."
"Lonceng perak berdenting-denting, bisikan lembut meninabobokanmu."

…

Menyenandungkan lagu nina bobo itu berulang kali, Sang Induk Burung sudah menunggu terlalu, terlalu lama untuk hari kelahiran anak-anaknya. Ia ingin memanjakan mereka, memberi mereka semua hal indah di dunia. Dengan tekad bulat, Sang Induk Burung membentangkan sayap dan meninggalkan sarang. Ia berkelana keliling dunia sebelum telur-telurnya menetas, mengumpulkan harta yang tak terhitung. Ia bisa membayangkannya dengan jelas sekarang: saat anak-anaknya lahir, wajah mungil mereka akan diterangi kilau emas dan perak yang memenuhi sarang.
Itulah yang terbaik yang bisa disiapkan seorang ibu untuk anak-anaknya. Sang Induk Burung yakin akan hal ini.
Dan ia pun akan menjadi ibu yang terbaik.
Setiap kali memejamkan mata, hatinya dipenuhi bayangan meringkuk bersama anak-anaknya di sarang yang dianyam dari benang emas dan sutra merah. Ia memimpikan menyuapi mereka dengan lembut, melihat mereka tumbuh sehat dan kuat.

Tapi pemandangan itu tak akan pernah terwujud.
Sang Induk Burung, yang begitu penuh harap, tak pernah sempat menjadi ibu.
Saat ia kembali ke sarang dengan topeng bertabur permata di paruhnya, ia hancur mendapati hanya cangkang telur yang pecah. Anak-anaknya tak ditemukan di mana pun.

Siapa yang mencuri anak-anakku!!!
Memecahkan cangkang mereka dan mencurinya dari ibunya!!!
Konon, jeritan nyaring dari sarang itu terus terdengar selama tiga hari tiga malam tanpa henti.

Sejak hari itu, Sang Induk Burung tak lagi ada. Yang tersisa di sana hanyalah makhluk mirip burung yang memakai topeng berekspresi antara tersenyum dan menangis, Nestbound Bird, menjaga sebutir cangkang telur yang retakannya dijahit benang merah.
Makhluk hidup mana pun di dunia ini bisa jadi anakku yang dicuri, maka aku akan menjadi ibu bagi makhluk hidup mana pun di dunia ini.
Anak-anakku yang dicuri dan tersesat. Kembalilah padaku. Kembalilah ke sarang yang dihias indah ini.
Ibu berjanji tak akan ada lagi yang memisahkan kita.
Lihatlah Plumette-Plumette yang dijahit dari tulangku, buluku, dagingku. Mereka akan menjaga sarang ini selamanya.
Kembalilah. Kumohon, panggil aku Ibu.

Anak-anak yang tumbuh di Hethereau kebanyakan pernah mendengar kisah ini. Saat tersesat, jangan pernah hiraukan suara perempuan yang lembut dan penuh kasih yang memanggil namamu entah dari mana. Jika kamu menjawab panggilan yang sungguh-sungguh itu, kamu akan dibawa ke sarang Nestbound Bird dan dibesarkan sebagai anaknya. Jika kamu menurutinya dan memanggilnya "Ibu", kamu akan melupakan dirimu sendiri selamanya, ditakdirkan tersesat di sarang itu.

Siapa sebenarnya yang mencuri anak-anaknya? Pertanyaan ini sepertinya ditakdirkan tak terjawab, atau mungkin Sang Induk Burung sebenarnya sudah tahu jawabannya sejak awal…
Sang Induk Burung, yang terlalu sibuk menghias sarang yang nyaman untuk anak-anaknya, lalai benar-benar merawat dan menemani mereka. Anak-anak burung yang baru menetas tak bisa menemukan induknya dan, didorong rasa lapar, terpaksa meninggalkan sarang. Keberadaan mereka masih belum diketahui.
Apa artinya jika kebenarannya sederhana dan jelas? Sang Induk Burung sudah tak ada lagi.
Yang tersisa hanyalah panggilan sungguh-sungguh Nestbound Bird untuk anak-anaknya yang terus bergema.


Karakteristik Anomaly
· Anomaly ini menyerupai makhluk mirip burung raksasa dengan wajah tertutup topeng berwajah manusia. Ia umumnya tinggal di Anomalous Realm yang ia sebut "sarang".
· Ia memanggil anak-anak yang tersesat dengan suara perempuan yang lembut dan penuh kasih, lalu menculik anak-anak yang terpikat ke sarangnya.
· Setelah berhasil, Nestbound Bird menggantung topeng di lengkungan pintu masuk "sarang", sebagai tanda perlindungannya atas anak yang diculik.

Anomaly Nexus
"Identitas sang ibu"

Penilaian Risiko
Risiko kritis.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
/

Langkah Containment
/

quote.id: "Kepalanya memang besar, tapi isinya kosong."

story.en:
Hello, nice to meet you. I'm… who am I? Hello, who are you?
Huh, why am I swimming around here…? Oh, oh, I guess this is the only place that I can swim around.
Hello, who are you?
What can you possibly remember in seven seconds… What's your name again?

Mhm! I'm guessing that's what goes through some Bonzitas' heads!
Actually, most goldfish can retain memories for over a month, but the saying "goldfish only have seven-second memories" spread so widely that fat-headed fish Oddities that actually only have seven-second memories appeared: the Bonzita.
This harmless Bio Anomaly is pretty common. You can find them in aquariums, pet markets, Bio Anomaly shelters… I actually keep one myself, and it's super cute! Too bad I can't go into detail in an official profile. What a shame!

Anomaly Characteristics
· Most have no worries, since they can't remember what they were worried about anyway.
· Sizes vary.
· They swim freely in water. Their greatest hobby is blowing bubbles, which can become exceptionally large and last exceptionally long, even longer than their memories.
· Occasionally, some individuals become withdrawn due to their poor memory. "Why can't I ever make friends?" "There's something I should remember, isn't there?"… Things like that. They're the "deep thinkers" of the species: forgetful philosophers.

Anomaly Nexus
Make it remember at least one thing within seven seconds.

Risk Assessment
Harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Contained in large numbers at Bio Anomaly shelters; widely guaranteed by civilians.

Containment Measures
Containment unit consists of a fish tank.
No special measures required. Regular feeding is sufficient.

Experiment Records

story.id:
Halo, salam kenal. Aku… aku siapa? Halo, kamu siapa?
Lho, kenapa aku berenang-renang di sini…? Oh, oh, kayaknya cuma di sini aku bisa berenang.
Halo, kamu siapa?
Memangnya apa yang bisa kamu ingat dalam tujuh detik… Siapa namamu tadi?

Nah! Kurasa itulah yang ada di kepala sebagian Bonzita!
Sebenarnya, kebanyakan ikan mas bisa menyimpan ingatan lebih dari sebulan, tapi ungkapan "ingatan ikan mas cuma tujuh detik" begitu luas tersebar sampai muncullah Oddity ikan berkepala besar yang ingatannya benar-benar cuma tujuh detik: Bonzita.
Bio Anomaly yang tidak berbahaya ini cukup umum. Kamu bisa menemukannya di akuarium, pasar hewan, tempat penampungan Bio Anomaly… Aku sendiri juga memelihara satu, dan lucu banget! Sayang aku tak bisa cerita panjang lebar di profil resmi. Sayang sekali!

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Kebanyakan tidak punya kekhawatiran, karena memang tidak ingat apa yang dikhawatirkan.
· Ukurannya beragam.
· Mereka berenang bebas di air. Hobi terbesarnya meniup gelembung, yang bisa menjadi sangat besar dan bertahan sangat lama, bahkan lebih lama dari ingatan mereka.
· Sesekali, ada individu yang menjadi pendiam karena ingatannya yang buruk. "Kenapa aku tidak pernah bisa punya teman?" "Ada sesuatu yang harus kuingat, kan?"… Hal-hal semacam itu. Mereka adalah "pemikir mendalam" di spesiesnya: filsuf pelupa.

Anomaly Nexus
Buat ia mengingat setidaknya satu hal dalam tujuh detik.

Penilaian Risiko
Tidak berbahaya.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Di-contain dalam jumlah besar di tempat penampungan Bio Anomaly; banyak dijamin oleh warga sipil.

Langkah Containment
Unit Containment berupa akuarium ikan.
Tidak perlu langkah khusus. Cukup diberi makan secara rutin.
