quote.en: "Stars reflected on the ocean's surface can be seen, but remain out of reach."
quote.id: "Bintang yang terpantul di permukaan laut bisa terlihat, tapi tetap tak bisa diraih."

story.en:
On clear, cloudless nights, twinkling stars will be reflected onto the ocean's surface. However, observers may notice that any alteration in the sky that veils the stars will not be similarly reflected in the water's surface. Instead, the 'stars' in the ocean mirroring those in the sky may not be 'stars' at all.
Once night falls, you might occasionally spot tiny "starlings" drifting up and down on a water's surface, giving off a faint, blue glow. This phenomenon is actually a Bio Anomaly of near microscopic scale. These Bio Anomalies only become clearly visible when clustered together on the surface of a body of water. Typically, the relative positions and luminosity of these clusters align perfectly with the night sky's constellations overhead, forming something akin to a star chart on the water's surface. Because of this, the Anomaly has been deemed: "Aqua Astra".
The lifespan of a single Aqua Astra is incredibly short, often only lasting one night before undergoing natural nullification.
When the moon sets and the sun begins to rise, the glow of the Aqua Astra begins to fade. Observation and documentation suggest that Aqua Astra does not affect any other lifeforms in the same body of water it inhabits. As of right now, the only noted effect of Aqua Astra is to reflect the night sky on a surface of water.

Characteristics:
· Aqua Astra is an aquatic Bio Anomaly, with sightings recorded across multiple natural bodies of water of various sizes. As of now, Aqua Astra has not been observed in small artificial pools such as open-air swimming pools or storage tanks.
· A single Aqua Astra persists for only one night before undergoing spontaneous nullification.
· Each Aqua Astra cluster imitates a different constellation. There has been no noted documentation on how these clusters determine which constellation to replicate.

Anomaly Nexus:
Automatically nullifies after sunrise.

Risk Assessment:
Harmless.

Containment Status:
Since Aqua Astra will nullify itself after a set period, no method has been found to fully contain it or trigger early nullification.

Containment Procedures:
No containment procedures required.

Experiment Record:
/

Derivative Anomaly:
/
story.id:
Pada malam cerah tanpa awan, bintang-bintang yang berkelip akan terpantul di permukaan laut. Namun, pengamat mungkin menyadari bahwa perubahan apa pun di langit yang menutupi bintang tidak ikut terpantul di permukaan air. Ternyata, "bintang" di laut yang mencerminkan bintang di langit mungkin sama sekali bukan "bintang".
Begitu malam tiba, sesekali kamu mungkin melihat "bintang" mungil yang terombang-ambing di permukaan air, memancarkan cahaya biru samar. Fenomena ini sebenarnya Bio Anomaly berukuran nyaris mikroskopis. Bio Anomaly ini baru terlihat jelas saat berkumpul di permukaan perairan. Biasanya, posisi relatif dan terang kelompok-kelompok ini persis sama dengan rasi bintang di langit malam di atasnya, membentuk semacam peta bintang di permukaan air. Karena itu, Anomaly ini dinamai "Aqua Astra".
Umur satu Aqua Astra sangat singkat, sering hanya bertahan semalam sebelum ter-nullify secara alami.
Saat bulan terbenam dan matahari mulai terbit, cahaya Aqua Astra mulai memudar. Pengamatan dan dokumentasi menunjukkan Aqua Astra tidak memengaruhi makhluk hidup lain di perairan yang sama. Sampai saat ini, satu-satunya efek Aqua Astra yang tercatat adalah memantulkan langit malam di permukaan air.

Karakteristik:
· Aqua Astra adalah Bio Anomaly air, dengan penampakan yang tercatat di berbagai perairan alami berbagai ukuran. Sampai saat ini, Aqua Astra belum pernah terlihat di kolam buatan kecil seperti kolam renang terbuka atau tangki penampungan.
· Satu Aqua Astra hanya bertahan semalam sebelum ter-nullify dengan sendirinya.
· Setiap kelompok Aqua Astra meniru rasi bintang yang berbeda. Belum ada dokumentasi tentang bagaimana kelompok-kelompok ini menentukan rasi bintang yang ditiru.

Anomaly Nexus:
Otomatis ter-nullify setelah matahari terbit.

Penilaian Risiko:
Tidak berbahaya.

Status Containment:
Karena Aqua Astra akan ter-nullify dengan sendirinya setelah waktu tertentu, belum ditemukan cara meng-contain-nya sepenuhnya atau memicu Nullification lebih awal.

Prosedur Containment:
Tidak perlu prosedur Containment.

Catatan Eksperimen:
/

Derivative Anomaly:
/

quote.en: "The wheel of fortune spins on forevermore."
quote.id: "Roda nasib terus berputar untuk selamanya."

story.en:
Fate had decided upon a pair of twin goldfish—one gold and one silver, scooping them up and dropping them in the same tank, thus transforming them into the "Temporal Fish".
The owner of the pair of goldfish claimed that, on one random morning, they had stumbled upon their pet goldfish swimming in circles repeatedly. Though panicked at the time, the owner said that the fish eventually separated and resumed their normal behavior. However, over the next few days, the odd behavior returned. Over time, the owner noticed that, on the days the fish swam clockwise, his business would pull a profit. On the contrary, when the fish swam counterclockwise, the business suffered. After contacting the Bureau of Anomaly Control, it was confirmed that these two otherwise unremarkable goldfish had awakened as an Anomaly: the "Temporal Fish".
Whether the Temporal Fish can actually predict the future, or swim in certain directions by sheer coincidence, cannot be determined. Nevertheless, the Temporal Fish's popularity has grown amongst the public in recent years, causing uproar amongst those who wish to obtain them. There have even been recorded incidents of radical action, such as an attempted assassination of the business owner, to acquire the Temporal Fish.

Characteristics:
· A pair of goldfish, one with golden scales and one with silver, that assume regular goldfish behavior. However, every day at exactly 6:00 AM, the pair links head to tail and swim in a ring for fifteen minutes before returning to normal. It's been said that when swimming clockwise, good fortune is sure to follow. When counter-clockwise, vice versa.

Anomaly Nexus:
It's hypothesized that the separation of the two fish may result in nullification.

Risk Assessment:
Harmless.

Containment Status:
Privately owned.

Containment Procedures:
No containment procedures required.

Experiment Record:
/

Derivative Anomaly:
/
story.id:
Takdir telah menentukan sepasang ikan mas kembar, satu emas dan satu perak, menyendok mereka dan memasukkannya ke akuarium yang sama, sehingga mengubah mereka menjadi "Temporal Fish".
Pemilik sepasang ikan mas itu mengaku, pada suatu pagi yang biasa, ia mendapati ikan peliharaannya berenang berputar-putar berulang kali. Meski sempat panik, sang pemilik bilang ikan-ikan itu akhirnya berpisah dan kembali berperilaku normal. Namun, beberapa hari berikutnya, perilaku aneh itu muncul lagi. Seiring waktu, sang pemilik memperhatikan bahwa pada hari ikan-ikan itu berenang searah jarum jam, usahanya untung. Sebaliknya, saat ikan-ikan itu berenang berlawanan arah jarum jam, usahanya merugi. Setelah menghubungi Bureau of Anomaly Control, dipastikan bahwa dua ikan mas yang biasa-biasa saja ini sudah bangkit menjadi Anomaly: "Temporal Fish".
Apakah Temporal Fish benar-benar bisa meramal masa depan, atau berenang ke arah tertentu hanya kebetulan, tak bisa dipastikan. Meski begitu, popularitas Temporal Fish di masyarakat meningkat beberapa tahun terakhir, memicu kehebohan di kalangan orang-orang yang ingin memilikinya. Bahkan ada insiden tercatat berupa tindakan nekat, seperti upaya pembunuhan terhadap pemilik usaha itu, demi mendapatkan Temporal Fish.

Karakteristik:
· Sepasang ikan mas, satu bersisik emas dan satu bersisik perak, yang berperilaku seperti ikan mas biasa. Namun, setiap hari tepat pukul 6.00 pagi, keduanya menyambung kepala ke ekor dan berenang melingkar selama lima belas menit sebelum kembali normal. Konon, saat berenang searah jarum jam, keberuntungan pasti menyusul. Saat berlawanan arah jarum jam, sebaliknya.

Anomaly Nexus:
Diduga memisahkan kedua ikan itu bisa menyebabkan Nullification.

Penilaian Risiko:
Tidak berbahaya.

Status Containment:
Dimiliki pribadi.

Prosedur Containment:
Tidak perlu prosedur Containment.

Catatan Eksperimen:
/

Derivative Anomaly:
/

quote.en: "All aboard!"
quote.id: "Semua naik!"

story.en:
In recent history, an Anomaly Metro calling itself the "Ghost Train" appeared and caused the Bureau of Anomaly Control a myriad of problems. The Ghost Train Anomaly was large and surprisingly mobile, therefore preventing direct contact and making observation increasingly difficult. Around the time that the BAC was to deem the Ghost Train mission a complete failure, a faint glow emanated from the train's conductor's cabin. Out flew an owl, alight with a blue sheen, and, from the loudspeaker on her chest, came a gentle, human voice: "Welcome aboard the Ghost Train! I'm Miss Levi, your conductor for this trip. It's my pleasure to welcome you all aboard!"
From a scientific standpoint, "Miss Levi" can be categorized as a Derivative Anomaly of the Ghost Train itself. On the other hand, some researchers claim that she may have been a fragment of the train that split off. Others claim she's a manifestation of the train's desire to be understood; a translator of sorts.
As the conductor, Miss Levi consistently plays pre-recorded announcements for anything pertaining to the train's daily upkeep. No one has ascertained where these pre-recorded announcements were acquired from. It's important to note that Miss Levi can also communicate through natural avian means, that is, owl sounds from her beak. Despite the difficulties that being a train-conducting owl might pose, Miss Levi firmly believes in doing her job well.
Though, few humans can interpret the language used by Oddities, which leads to Miss Levi often being left with only herself to communicate.

Characteristics:
· "Miss Levi" is an owl-like Oddity that dons a train conductor hat and a loudspeaker. Similar to the Anomaly she descended from, her body gives off a faint blue glow.
· Normally, Miss Levi works at the information desk of the Ghost Train's station. Whenever someone enters the station, she appears at the desk, ready to assist. She also seems to manage many other tasks within the station and the Anomalous Realm it's connected to. Miss Levi can manifest in several different stations, or in multiple places, at the same time.
· When the station is empty, Miss Levi is believed to disappear entirely.


Anomaly Nexus:
Access restricted.

Risk Assessment:
Miss Levi is extremely friendly toward humans. Her aggression is reserved primarily for unreasonable complaints.

Containment Status:
Guaranteed by the Bureau of Anomaly Control.

Containment Procedures:
No containment procedures required.

Experiment Record:
/

Derivative Anomaly:
/
story.id:
Belum lama ini, sebuah Anomaly Metro yang menyebut dirinya "Ghost Train" muncul dan menimbulkan banyak masalah bagi Bureau of Anomaly Control. Anomaly Ghost Train ini besar dan ternyata sangat lincah, sehingga sulit disentuh langsung dan makin sulit diamati. Sekitar waktu BAC hendak menyatakan misi Ghost Train gagal total, cahaya samar memancar dari kabin masinis kereta. Keluarlah seekor burung hantu yang berpendar biru, dan dari pengeras suara di dadanya terdengar suara manusia yang lembut: "Selamat datang di Ghost Train! Saya Miss Levi, kondektur Anda untuk perjalanan ini. Dengan senang hati saya menyambut Anda semua!"
Dari sudut pandang ilmiah, "Miss Levi" bisa digolongkan sebagai Derivative Anomaly dari Ghost Train itu sendiri. Di sisi lain, beberapa peneliti mengklaim ia mungkin pecahan kereta yang terpisah. Ada juga yang mengklaim ia adalah perwujudan keinginan kereta untuk dimengerti; semacam penerjemah.
Sebagai kondektur, Miss Levi rutin memutar pengumuman rekaman untuk segala hal terkait perawatan harian kereta. Belum ada yang tahu dari mana pengumuman rekaman itu didapat. Perlu dicatat bahwa Miss Levi juga bisa berkomunikasi dengan cara burung alami, yaitu suara burung hantu dari paruhnya. Meski menjadi burung hantu kondektur kereta mungkin penuh kesulitan, Miss Levi sangat yakin untuk menjalankan tugasnya dengan baik.
Namun, sedikit sekali manusia yang bisa memahami bahasa Oddity, sehingga Miss Levi sering hanya bisa berbicara sendiri.

Karakteristik:
· "Miss Levi" adalah Oddity mirip burung hantu yang memakai topi kondektur kereta dan pengeras suara. Seperti Anomaly asalnya, tubuhnya memancarkan cahaya biru samar.
· Biasanya, Miss Levi bekerja di meja informasi stasiun Ghost Train. Setiap kali ada yang masuk stasiun, ia muncul di meja, siap membantu. Ia juga tampaknya mengurus banyak tugas lain di stasiun dan Anomalous Realm yang terhubung dengannya. Miss Levi bisa muncul di beberapa stasiun berbeda, atau di beberapa tempat, sekaligus.
· Saat stasiun kosong, Miss Levi diyakini menghilang sepenuhnya.


Anomaly Nexus:
Akses dibatasi.

Penilaian Risiko:
Miss Levi sangat ramah terhadap manusia. Agresinya terutama hanya ditujukan pada keluhan yang tidak masuk akal.

Status Containment:
Dijamin oleh Bureau of Anomaly Control.

Prosedur Containment:
Tidak perlu prosedur Containment.

Catatan Eksperimen:
/

Derivative Anomaly:
/

quote.en:
Anomaly Story
"Behave yourselves. These little ones are gentle, as warnings go. Get carried away, and something far worse may come next…"

An Anomaly group that appeared in Hethereau around the same time as "Justice Executioner." From the very beginning, they seemed intimately familiar with Hethereau Public Safety Ordinance, including every amendment and annotation. Not long after arriving uninvited, they brazenly attempted to blend in with the city's officers. Having already witnessed the oppressive presence of Justice Executioner, the Bureau did not let its guard down around these Anomalies. For a long time, they were treated as Anomalies associated with Justice Executioner and monitored with caution. During that period, "Officer Whisker" clumsily tried to act as street vigilantes while also enduring the Bureau's hasty containment attempts. This is not meant as criticism of those colleagues who are also members of the Circle.
Eventually, the Anomaly won the affection of most citizens and indirectly became an important turning point in Hethereau's acceptance of Anomalies after the Fifth Calamity. The Bureau was also forced to admit that Officer Whisker's motivation was truly simple: to keep Hethereau's public order at a high standard. Nothing more. Later, the Anomaly was officially incorporated into the public security office and received gear and uniforms designed specifically for them.

Although these Anomalies show great enthusiasm and endless patience for routine public security patrols, their appearance alone makes one thing clear: these small, rodent-like Anomalies are not built to intimidate potential criminals. Their combat ability is not especially impressive, either. Even so, Officer Whisker responds to every dispatch with extraordinary enthusiasm and accompanies other officers to the scene as quickly as possible.
Within this Anomaly group are three populations distinguished by body color: red, yellow, and green. Research from Zerogon Laboratory notes that the most commonly sighted "yellow" individuals seem to intentionally create a relaxed, easygoing atmosphere, which can reduce traffic accidents or violent conflicts caused by heightened emotions in the surrounding area. This population is also regarded as the most senior among Officer Whisker, and only they participate in handling incidents they consider "high-risk," such as traffic violations or public disturbances. Individuals from the "red" population show a strong fixation on maintaining current order. When they appear in public, nearby citizens may be affected by a level ▊ psychological suggestion, slightly increasing their respect for laws and regulations. The traits of the "green" population remain comparatively unclear, though they may be related to granting vitality or various positive emotions to others. Zerogon Laboratory has not disclosed the exact strength of these traits. Regardless, these traits do not change the fact that Officer Whisker has become an iconic symbol of the Hethereau Public Security Office, thanks to its ability to maintain officer morale and improve the office's image among citizens.

Their peculiar connection to Justice Executioner is another trait of Officer Whisker that warrants deeper investigation. For example, the oddly distinctive vehicles often noticed by observers are not provided by the public security office. Like the other tools they use, these vehicles appear to be cobbled together from materials gathered in Justice Executioner's Forest of Traffic Lights. How these absurd little pieces of equipment function, and where Officer Whisker acquired the knowledge to make them, remain unsolved mysteries.
Despite the impression given by their gentle, harmless appearance, Yggash Court has yet to record any credible report of their nullification. It should be noted that excessive attention to methods of nullifying Officer Whisker may be regarded as an act of hostility toward the entire city of Hethereau. When facing a single Officer Whisker, most adult citizens are capable of subduing it, and Esper criminals can easily repel groups of vehicle-riding Officer Whisker. However, records show that individuals who disappear after being defeated are not actually nullified. Instead, they retreat to the steel jungle where Justice Executioner resides to recover, then reappear after varying periods of time. In one observed case, an individual disappeared after being fed an excessive number of doughnuts by citizens. It has been confirmed that this, too, was not the corresponding Nexus of Officer Whisker. Rather, it appears that Justice Executioner interpreted "obesity caused by excessive sugar and fat intake" as a condition that made continued duty impossible, then recalled the overweight individual for mandatory exercise and weight loss.

There has long been a view within Yggash Court: while the intimidating rumors surrounding Justice Executioner continue to grow and spread, Officer Whisker is also softening the city's atmosphere in its own way. Deterring potential criminals is certainly important, but isn't it even more vital to give law-abiding citizens lasting confidence that their lives can remain peaceful? It is hard not to see this as an extremely sophisticated method of governance. Yet this raises an even more fundamental question: have people misunderstood which side is truly central to this symbiotic relationship? Which side was it that actively established this marvelous cooperation?

Characteristics
They often appear alongside Security Officers in armed form during unlawful incidents, but can also be seen patrolling the streets in a more relaxed manner.
·They carry a variety of nonlethal weapons and tools of uncertain origin, which they use to stop and pursue citizens who violate the law.
·They come in red, yellow, and green populations, with subtle differences in personality and appearance even among individuals of the same population.
·They appear to have some kind of symbiotic relationship with the unique Anomaly "Justice Executioner." Attacking Officer Whisker seems to greatly increase a criminal's so-called "Evil Index" in Justice Executioner's eyes.
·They are unquestionably closer to squirrels than hamsters. I will continue to stand by this view.

Anomaly Nexus
Insufficient clearance. Currently inaccessible.

Risk Assessment
Basically harmless. This Anomaly's behavior follows known fixed patterns. Officer Whisker will only stop citizens who are clearly caught committing unlawful acts, and their attacks are highly restrained and nonlethal. The only exception occurs when an offender causes excessive harm to an individual of this Anomaly. In such cases, the subsequent risk assessment must be raised by at least ▊ levels, and the consequences should be borne by the offender.

Containment/Guarantee Status
All are guaranteed by the Hethereau Security Office. At present, ▊▊▊▊ Officer Whisker individuals are active within Hethereau. This number fluctuates slightly, but all newly appearing individuals voluntarily report to Security Office headquarters for registration. No individuals have yet been observed outside the office's jurisdiction.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Record
Test: Intervene in random street disputes; station yellow-population Officer Whisker individuals at specific accident-prone road sections; request increased Security Office patrols in certain blocks with yellow-population individuals participating.
Result: Confrontational states eased in ▊▊% of observed subjects. Conflict-related dangerous driving incidents on the test road section decreased by ▊▊% compared with the control group. Crimes of passion in the test block are still being counted, but the overall trend is downward.
Note: A small increase in unlawful incidents appears to have occurred around the test block due to the transfer of yellow-population individuals for the test. The Security Office has now filed a formal protest with the laboratory.

Test: Simulate various extremely minor violations in daily situations. Invite red-population Officer Whisker individuals to participate and randomly place them in darkrooms near the experimental group sites.
Conclusion: The effect is equivalent to a level ▊ psychological suggestion. The number of test personnel showing clear resistance to unlawful behavior increased by ▊▊% compared with the control group, though this influence is largely ineffective on those who already lack reverence for authority.
Note: Site supervisors are advised to pay closer attention to members who displayed a challenging attitude toward authority during this experiment.

Test: Invite green-population Officer Whisker individuals to remain along the commuting route of staff at laboratory site ▊▊. Randomly select subjects at the start of work, at the end of work, and during sudden overtime, then assess their physical and mental vitality.
Result: The phenomenon's effect is approximately ▊‰... After further confirmation, observed subjects generally stated that their "mood improved slightly." However, it is difficult to determine whether this was due to the Anomaly traits of this population or simply because the Anomaly's appearance is endearing.
Note: After the experiment concluded, the participating green-population individual fell into a rather dejected state. Yellow-population Officer Whisker in the waiting area immediately expressed dissatisfaction toward the researchers. The test subject then began displaying behavior resembling mutual encouragement, and its mood improved again.

Test: Borrow individual No. ▊▊▊▊ from the Security Office. After obtaining its consent, attempt to reproduce the recovery-return process used by Officer Whisker and verify the principle behind it.
Result: The experiment triggered a reaction from Justice Executioner within site ▊▊. A total of ▊▊ personnel were injured, and the experiment was terminated.
Note: This project may only be restarted with joint authorization from more than ▊ site-supervisor-level personnel from Zerogon Laboratory, the Bureau of Anomaly Control, and Yggash Court.
quote.id:
Kisah Anomaly
"Jaga sikap kalian. Si kecil-kecil ini masih tergolong lembut sebagai peringatan. Kalau keterlaluan, sesuatu yang jauh lebih buruk bisa datang berikutnya…"

Kelompok Anomaly yang muncul di Hethereau hampir bersamaan dengan "Justice Executioner". Sejak awal, mereka tampak sangat paham Hethereau Public Safety Ordinance, termasuk setiap amandemen dan catatannya. Tak lama setelah datang tanpa diundang, mereka dengan berani mencoba berbaur dengan para petugas kota. Karena sudah menyaksikan sendiri kehadiran Justice Executioner yang menekan, Bureau tidak lengah terhadap Anomaly ini. Untuk waktu yang lama, mereka diperlakukan sebagai Anomaly yang terkait Justice Executioner dan diawasi dengan hati-hati. Selama masa itu, "Officer Whisker" dengan canggung mencoba bertindak sebagai penjaga jalanan sambil menghadapi upaya Containment yang terburu-buru dari Bureau. Ini bukan kritik terhadap rekan-rekan yang juga anggota Circle.
Pada akhirnya, Anomaly ini berhasil memikat hati sebagian besar warga dan secara tidak langsung menjadi titik balik penting penerimaan Anomaly di Hethereau setelah Fifth Calamity. Bureau juga terpaksa mengakui bahwa motivasi Officer Whisker sebenarnya sederhana: menjaga ketertiban umum Hethereau tetap tinggi. Tidak lebih. Belakangan, Anomaly ini resmi dimasukkan ke kantor keamanan publik dan mendapat perlengkapan serta seragam yang dirancang khusus untuk mereka.

Meski Anomaly ini menunjukkan semangat besar dan kesabaran tanpa batas dalam patroli keamanan rutin, penampilannya saja sudah menjelaskan satu hal: Anomaly kecil mirip hewan pengerat ini tidak diciptakan untuk menakut-nakuti calon pelaku kejahatan. Kemampuan tempurnya pun tidak terlalu mengesankan. Meski begitu, Officer Whisker menanggapi setiap panggilan tugas dengan antusiasme luar biasa dan menemani petugas lain ke lokasi secepat mungkin.
Dalam kelompok Anomaly ini ada tiga populasi yang dibedakan berdasarkan warna tubuh: merah, kuning, dan hijau. Penelitian Zerogon Laboratory mencatat bahwa individu "kuning" yang paling sering terlihat tampaknya sengaja menciptakan suasana santai dan rileks, yang bisa mengurangi kecelakaan lalu lintas atau konflik kekerasan akibat emosi yang memuncak di sekitarnya. Populasi ini juga dianggap paling senior di antara Officer Whisker, dan hanya mereka yang ikut menangani insiden yang mereka anggap "berisiko tinggi", seperti pelanggaran lalu lintas atau gangguan ketertiban umum. Individu dari populasi "merah" menunjukkan keterikatan kuat untuk menjaga ketertiban yang ada. Saat mereka muncul di tempat umum, warga di sekitarnya bisa terpengaruh sugesti psikologis tingkat ▊, sedikit meningkatkan rasa hormat mereka terhadap hukum dan peraturan. Sifat populasi "hijau" relatif masih belum jelas, meski mungkin berkaitan dengan memberikan semangat hidup atau berbagai emosi positif kepada orang lain. Zerogon Laboratory belum mengungkap kekuatan pasti sifat-sifat ini. Bagaimanapun, sifat-sifat ini tidak mengubah fakta bahwa Officer Whisker telah menjadi simbol ikonik Hethereau Public Security Office, berkat kemampuannya menjaga semangat petugas dan memperbaiki citra kantor di mata warga.

Hubungan aneh mereka dengan Justice Executioner adalah sifat lain Officer Whisker yang perlu diselidiki lebih dalam. Misalnya, kendaraan unik yang sering diperhatikan para pengamat tidak disediakan kantor keamanan publik. Seperti alat-alat lain yang mereka gunakan, kendaraan ini tampaknya dirakit dari bahan yang dikumpulkan di Forest of Traffic Lights milik Justice Executioner. Bagaimana perlengkapan kecil yang absurd ini bekerja, dan dari mana Officer Whisker mendapat pengetahuan untuk membuatnya, masih menjadi misteri.
Meski penampilannya terkesan lembut dan tidak berbahaya, Yggash Court belum pernah mencatat laporan yang bisa dipercaya tentang Nullification mereka. Perlu dicatat, perhatian berlebihan terhadap cara me-nullify Officer Whisker bisa dianggap sebagai tindakan bermusuhan terhadap seluruh kota Hethereau. Saat menghadapi satu Officer Whisker, sebagian besar warga dewasa mampu menaklukkannya, dan pelaku kejahatan Esper bisa dengan mudah mengusir sekelompok Officer Whisker yang berkendara. Namun, catatan menunjukkan bahwa individu yang menghilang setelah dikalahkan sebenarnya tidak ter-nullify. Mereka mundur ke hutan baja tempat Justice Executioner berada untuk memulihkan diri, lalu muncul kembali setelah jangka waktu yang berbeda-beda. Dalam satu kasus yang teramati, seekor individu menghilang setelah diberi terlalu banyak donat oleh warga. Sudah dipastikan bahwa ini juga bukan Nexus Officer Whisker. Sebaliknya, tampaknya Justice Executioner menafsirkan "obesitas akibat asupan gula dan lemak berlebih" sebagai kondisi yang membuatnya tak bisa lagi bertugas, lalu menarik individu yang kelebihan berat badan itu untuk olahraga dan diet wajib.

Sejak lama ada pandangan di Yggash Court: sementara rumor menakutkan seputar Justice Executioner terus berkembang dan menyebar, Officer Whisker juga melunakkan suasana kota dengan caranya sendiri. Mencegah calon pelaku kejahatan memang penting, tapi bukankah lebih penting lagi memberi warga yang taat hukum keyakinan abadi bahwa hidup mereka bisa tetap damai? Sulit untuk tidak melihat ini sebagai cara memerintah yang sangat canggih. Namun, ini memunculkan pertanyaan yang lebih mendasar: apakah orang-orang salah paham tentang pihak mana yang sebenarnya menjadi pusat hubungan simbiosis ini? Pihak mana yang secara aktif membangun kerja sama yang luar biasa ini?

Karakteristik
Mereka sering muncul bersama Security Officer dalam wujud bersenjata saat terjadi pelanggaran hukum, tapi juga bisa terlihat berpatroli di jalanan dengan lebih santai.
·Mereka membawa berbagai senjata tidak mematikan dan alat yang asal-usulnya tidak jelas, yang dipakai untuk menghentikan dan mengejar warga yang melanggar hukum.
·Mereka terdiri dari populasi merah, kuning, dan hijau, dengan perbedaan kepribadian dan penampilan yang halus bahkan di antara individu dalam populasi yang sama.
·Mereka tampaknya punya semacam hubungan simbiosis dengan Anomaly unik "Justice Executioner". Menyerang Officer Whisker tampaknya sangat menaikkan apa yang disebut "Evil Index" seorang pelaku kejahatan di mata Justice Executioner.
·Mereka jelas lebih mirip tupai daripada hamster. Aku akan tetap berpegang pada pendapat ini.

Anomaly Nexus
Izin akses tidak mencukupi. Saat ini tidak bisa diakses.

Penilaian Risiko
Pada dasarnya tidak berbahaya. Perilaku Anomaly ini mengikuti pola tetap yang sudah diketahui. Officer Whisker hanya akan menghentikan warga yang jelas tertangkap melakukan pelanggaran hukum, dan serangan mereka sangat terkendali serta tidak mematikan. Satu-satunya pengecualian terjadi saat pelanggar menyebabkan cedera berlebihan pada individu Anomaly ini. Dalam kasus seperti itu, penilaian risiko berikutnya harus dinaikkan setidaknya ▊ tingkat, dan akibatnya harus ditanggung pelanggar.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Semuanya dijamin oleh Hethereau Security Office. Saat ini, ada ▊▊▊▊ individu Officer Whisker yang aktif di Hethereau. Jumlah ini sedikit berubah-ubah, tapi semua individu yang baru muncul secara sukarela melapor ke markas Security Office untuk didaftarkan. Belum ada individu yang terlihat di luar wilayah kerja kantor tersebut.

Langkah Containment
/

Catatan Eksperimen
Uji: Melerai perselisihan jalanan secara acak; menempatkan individu Officer Whisker populasi kuning di ruas jalan tertentu yang rawan kecelakaan; meminta tambahan patroli Security Office di blok tertentu dengan melibatkan individu populasi kuning.
Hasil: Ketegangan mereda pada ▊▊% subjek yang diamati. Insiden mengemudi berbahaya akibat konflik di ruas jalan uji turun ▊▊% dibanding kelompok kontrol. Kejahatan akibat emosi sesaat di blok uji masih dihitung, tapi tren keseluruhannya menurun.
Catatan: Tampaknya terjadi sedikit peningkatan pelanggaran hukum di sekitar blok uji karena individu populasi kuning dipindahkan untuk pengujian. Security Office kini sudah mengajukan protes resmi kepada laboratorium.

Uji: Menyimulasikan berbagai pelanggaran yang sangat ringan dalam situasi sehari-hari. Mengajak individu Officer Whisker populasi merah ikut serta dan menempatkan mereka secara acak di ruang gelap dekat lokasi kelompok eksperimen.
Kesimpulan: Efeknya setara sugesti psikologis tingkat ▊. Jumlah personel uji yang menunjukkan penolakan jelas terhadap perilaku melanggar hukum naik ▊▊% dibanding kelompok kontrol, meski pengaruh ini nyaris tidak berefek pada mereka yang memang sudah tidak menghormati otoritas.
Catatan: Pengawas lokasi disarankan lebih memperhatikan anggota yang menunjukkan sikap menantang otoritas selama eksperimen ini.

Uji: Mengajak individu Officer Whisker populasi hijau tinggal di sepanjang rute pulang-pergi staf di lokasi laboratorium ▊▊. Memilih subjek secara acak saat mulai kerja, selesai kerja, dan saat lembur mendadak, lalu menilai semangat fisik dan mental mereka.
Hasil: Efek fenomena ini sekitar ▊‰... Setelah dikonfirmasi lebih lanjut, subjek yang diamati umumnya mengatakan "suasana hati sedikit membaik". Namun, sulit dipastikan apakah ini karena sifat Anomaly populasi tersebut atau sekadar karena penampilan Anomaly ini menggemaskan.
Catatan: Setelah eksperimen selesai, individu populasi hijau yang ikut serta jatuh ke kondisi agak murung. Officer Whisker populasi kuning di ruang tunggu langsung menunjukkan ketidakpuasan kepada para peneliti. Subjek uji lalu mulai menunjukkan perilaku seperti saling menyemangati, dan suasana hatinya membaik kembali.

Uji: Meminjam individu No. ▊▊▊▊ dari Security Office. Setelah mendapat persetujuannya, mencoba mereproduksi proses pemulihan dan kepulangan yang dipakai Officer Whisker dan membuktikan prinsip di baliknya.
Hasil: Eksperimen ini memicu reaksi Justice Executioner di lokasi ▊▊. Total ▊▊ personel terluka, dan eksperimen dihentikan.
Catatan: Proyek ini hanya boleh dimulai ulang dengan otorisasi bersama dari lebih dari ▊ personel setingkat pengawas lokasi dari Zerogon Laboratory, Bureau of Anomaly Control, dan Yggash Court.

quote.en: "Through rain and shine, the vines live on."
quote.id: "Hujan maupun cerah, sulur-sulur itu tetap hidup."

story.en:
.Roughly a dozen years ago, a forest fire broke out in the mountains near Hethereau. The flames spread with alarming speed, making the situation extremely difficult to control. At the same time, abnormal fluctuations in the Wertheimer Index were detected within the fire zone, making any reckless entry potentially dangerous. Just as the firefighters found themselves unable to advance or retreat, they saw a giant vine rise from the center of the burning area. What followed was a localized downpour that lasted more than ten hours. The fire was extinguished in time, but the rain was so heavy that the forest became marshland. After extensive experiments and research, scholars determined that the giant vine had been formed by many smaller vines of the same kind winding together and expanding. The vine-like Anomaly that had rendered such great service during the fire was therefore collectively named R-2340[Or], also known as "Weather Vine."
As its name suggests, Weather Vine can alter the weather in a small area according to its own condition. The fastest way to distinguish it from ordinary vines is to check whether one or more drop-shaped blue "Vine Pearls" grow on its tendrils. When it senses a lack of water, Weather Vine disregards the local geography and causes rain to fall in the surrounding area to water itself. Researchers found that the plant rapidly expands when burned by flame, increasing the range over which it can alter the weather. However, this behavior is undoubtedly devastating to Weather Vine itself. After the forest fire mentioned above, the giant Weather Vine gradually returned to its original size, but the exhausted plants permanently lost their Vine Pearls and became no different from ordinary vines. Some even withered away. Around those dried vines, however, people found new plants quietly taking root. This clever Anomaly had used cooperation to withstand disaster and protect the seeds of its group.
Weather Vine's remarkable ability allows it to survive almost anywhere it can take root. Even in barren places where living creatures are rarely seen, traces of its green can still be found. For this reason, Weather Vine has become a top choice for beginners interested in growing potted plants. After all, who wouldn't want a few evergreen plants on their balcony that never need watering? However, before raising one, be sure to report it to the local Bureau of Anomaly Control office and the fire department.

Characteristics
·Weather Vine is a vine-like Anomaly that can alter the weather in a small area based on its own condition. Its tendrils grow one or more drop-shaped blue "Vine Pearls." When it senses a lack of water, it disregards the local geography and causes rain to fall nearby.
When burned by flame, it rapidly expands to increase the range of rainfall. However, if the rain lasts too long, Weather Vine will lose its "Vine Pearls" afterward and become no different from an ordinary vine.

Anomaly Nexus
Continuous burning by flame.

Risk Assessment
Basically harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Three specimens are contained at the Celaeno Compound.

Containment Measures
Plant Weather Vine in a containment unit with ample soil and sunlight.

Experiment Record
Experiment 1:
Researchers cut off a Weather Vine tendril bearing a "Vine Pearl," then burned both the section with the "Vine Pearl" and the remaining section. The section with the "Vine Pearl" could still produce rain in its surroundings, while the other showed no response. Conclusion: the "Vine Pearl" is the key organ that allows Weather Vine to alter the weather.

Experiment 2:
Researchers attempted to separate the "Vine Pearl" from the main body. However, once removed from the vine, the "Vine Pearl" immediately evaporated, making further experiments impossible for now.
story.id:
Sekitar belasan tahun lalu, kebakaran hutan terjadi di pegunungan dekat Hethereau. Api menyebar dengan kecepatan mengkhawatirkan, membuat situasi sangat sulit dikendalikan. Pada saat yang sama, fluktuasi Wertheimer Index yang tidak normal terdeteksi di zona kebakaran, sehingga masuk dengan gegabah bisa berbahaya. Tepat saat para pemadam kebakaran terjebak tak bisa maju maupun mundur, mereka melihat sulur raksasa menjulang dari tengah area yang terbakar. Setelah itu turun hujan lokal yang berlangsung lebih dari sepuluh jam. Api berhasil dipadamkan tepat waktu, tapi hujannya begitu deras hingga hutan itu menjadi rawa. Setelah eksperimen dan penelitian yang ekstensif, para akademisi memastikan bahwa sulur raksasa itu terbentuk dari banyak sulur kecil sejenis yang saling membelit dan membesar. Anomaly mirip sulur yang sangat berjasa saat kebakaran itu pun secara kolektif dinamai R-2340[Or], juga dikenal sebagai "Weather Vine".
Sesuai namanya, Weather Vine bisa mengubah cuaca di area kecil sesuai kondisinya sendiri. Cara tercepat membedakannya dari sulur biasa adalah memeriksa apakah ada satu atau lebih "Vine Pearl" biru berbentuk tetesan yang tumbuh di sulur-sulurnya. Saat merasa kekurangan air, Weather Vine mengabaikan kondisi geografis setempat dan menurunkan hujan di sekitarnya untuk menyirami dirinya sendiri. Para peneliti mendapati bahwa tumbuhan ini cepat membesar saat terbakar api, memperluas jangkauan perubahan cuacanya. Namun, perilaku ini jelas sangat merugikan Weather Vine sendiri. Setelah kebakaran hutan di atas, Weather Vine raksasa itu perlahan kembali ke ukuran semula, tapi tumbuhan yang kelelahan itu kehilangan Vine Pearl-nya untuk selamanya dan menjadi tak berbeda dari sulur biasa. Sebagian bahkan layu. Namun, di sekitar sulur-sulur yang mengering itu, orang-orang menemukan tumbuhan baru yang diam-diam berakar. Anomaly yang cerdik ini memakai kerja sama untuk bertahan dari bencana dan melindungi benih kelompoknya.
Kemampuan Weather Vine yang luar biasa membuatnya bisa bertahan hampir di mana pun ia bisa berakar. Bahkan di tempat tandus yang jarang terlihat makhluk hidup, jejak hijaunya masih bisa ditemukan. Karena itu, Weather Vine menjadi pilihan utama bagi pemula yang tertarik menanam tanaman pot. Lagi pula, siapa yang tidak mau punya beberapa tanaman hijau abadi di balkon yang tak perlu disiram? Namun, sebelum memeliharanya, pastikan melapor ke kantor Bureau of Anomaly Control setempat dan dinas pemadam kebakaran.

Karakteristik
·Weather Vine adalah Anomaly mirip sulur yang bisa mengubah cuaca di area kecil sesuai kondisinya sendiri. Sulurnya menumbuhkan satu atau lebih "Vine Pearl" biru berbentuk tetesan. Saat merasa kekurangan air, ia mengabaikan kondisi geografis setempat dan menurunkan hujan di sekitarnya.
Saat terbakar api, ia cepat membesar untuk memperluas jangkauan hujan. Namun, jika hujan berlangsung terlalu lama, Weather Vine akan kehilangan "Vine Pearl"-nya setelahnya dan menjadi tak berbeda dari sulur biasa.

Anomaly Nexus
Dibakar api terus-menerus.

Penilaian Risiko
Pada dasarnya tidak berbahaya.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Tiga spesimen di-contain di Celaeno Compound.

Langkah Containment
Tanam Weather Vine di unit Containment dengan tanah dan sinar matahari yang cukup.

Catatan Eksperimen
Eksperimen 1:
Para peneliti memotong sulur Weather Vine yang memiliki "Vine Pearl", lalu membakar bagian yang ada "Vine Pearl"-nya dan bagian sisanya. Bagian dengan "Vine Pearl" masih bisa menurunkan hujan di sekitarnya, sementara bagian lainnya tidak bereaksi. Kesimpulan: "Vine Pearl" adalah organ kunci yang membuat Weather Vine bisa mengubah cuaca.

Eksperimen 2:
Para peneliti mencoba memisahkan "Vine Pearl" dari tubuh utamanya. Namun, begitu dilepas dari sulur, "Vine Pearl" langsung menguap, sehingga eksperimen lanjutan belum bisa dilakukan untuk saat ini.

quote.en: "Two eyes, one nose, one mouth… Mm-hmm. No doubt about it. I'm a genuine human!"
quote.id: "Dua mata, satu hidung, satu mulut… Hmm. Tidak salah lagi. Aku manusia asli!"

story.en:
Many years ago, just as a special recruitment fair hosted by the Bureau of Anomaly Control was about to end, an octopus-like Anomaly wearing a paper-bag hood came wobbling over. It had clearly done its best to disguise itself, but everyone could tell at a glance that it was not human. Under countless watchful eyes, the mysterious Anomaly extended a long, agile black tentacle and submitted its resume, making its intention to join the Bureau perfectly clear.
The interviewers were baffled, but they still gave it a chance. Since this Anomaly had hidden its true face beneath a paper bag for reasons unknown, it was obviously impossible to judge it by ordinary human standards. The interviewers gave it a standard interview, followed by several improvised assessments tailored to its abilities. The results were surprisingly impressive. The Anomaly proved highly skilled at clerical work, with remarkably nimble "hands and feet." In the spirit of fairness and impartiality, the Bureau of Anomaly Control ultimately decided to hire it.
This is the U-7646[Or], now known as "Mr. Bag:" an Anomaly with no Guarantor who found employment entirely through its own efforts and now works under the Bureau of Anomaly Control. True to its name, it always wears a hood made from a paper bag, along with a "shirt" made from the same material. Beneath that shirt are several long, flexible, shadow-like tentacles. "If you ignore the hood, it is actually very cool," one employee once commented. When no one is watching, Mr. Bag secretly changes its paper bag and draws expressions on it to show how it feels at that moment. No one has ever seen its true face, and no one knows where it came from. "Mr. Bag" is the name registered on its employment documents, while "Mr." is a title it insisted on adding itself. Clearly, Mr. Bag very much hopes to be respected as a human being. Perhaps that is one reason it chose to disguise itself and enter human society.
Since taking office, Mr. Bag has handled the tedious work of organizing and distributing documents inside and outside the Bureau. To let it work to its full potential, the Bureau assigned Mr. Bag enormous personal workspace, allowing it to wave its tentacles freely in an open environment and process tasks efficiently on multiple fronts. Its dedicated space contains countless mailboxes. One end of each mailbox connects to its office, while the other connects to Bureau of Anomaly Control offices throughout Hethereau and to certain government departments. Mr. Bag knows the location and owner of every mailbox. During work hours, it can be seen swiftly waving its "shadow tentacles," collecting documents sent from various places through the mailboxes, then sorting and filing them away. At times, it also uses the mailboxes to distribute documents. People unfamiliar with the mailboxes are often startled by the tentacles suddenly emerge from inside, but Mr. Bag has long since grown used to such reactions. Sometimes, after sending or retrieving the necessary files, it even offers a little greeting gesture before vanishing with a whoosh, retracting its tentacle just as suddenly as it appeared and closing the mailbox behind it.
Outside of its primary duties, Mr. Bag also manages "Mr. Bag Tips," a public broadcast channel run by the Bureau of Anomaly Control for all citizens. The channel usually broadcasts content such as "Anomaly Basics," sends out low-level Anomaly alerts, and serves as one way for Anomaly Hunters to obtain Anomaly bounty information. Even while handling clerical work with astonishing efficiency, Mr. Bag has never missed a single broadcast. Such astonishing work capability may be rivaled only by the one known as "Agent.LUCK."
Thanks to its outstanding performance, Mr. Bag became the only employee in the history of the Bureau of Anomaly Control to win "Employee of the Month" for fourteen consecutive months. "So, just treat Mr. Bag like any other colleague and get along with it. I am sure that's what it wants, too," said the then-deputy captain of ETD-6. To this day, the kind people around it have never exposed Mr. Bag's clumsy disguise, and the innocent Anomaly has long since come to think of itself as a member of humanity. As long as its colleagues treat it as human, then perhaps, in practice, there is no real difference. For Mr. Bag, that is enough.

Characteristics
Mr. Bag is an octopus-like Anomaly who wears a paper-bag hood and a shirt made from the same material. Beneath the shirt are several long, flexible, shadow-like tentacles. When no one is around, it secretly changes its paper bag and draws expressions on it to show how it feels.
·It excels at processing documents efficiently on multiple fronts. Since taking office, it has been responsible for centrally organizing and distributing many documents inside and outside the Bureau.
It believes it is a member of humanity and deeply hopes to be respected and treated as human.

Anomaly Nexus
Insufficient clearance. Currently inaccessible.

Risk Assessment
Generally harmless. Mr. Bag is quite capable in a fight, but very friendly toward humans. That said, please do not provoke him on purpose.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Unique Anomaly, guaranteed by the Bureau of Anomaly Control.
story.id:
Bertahun-tahun lalu, tepat saat bursa rekrutmen khusus yang diadakan Bureau of Anomaly Control hampir berakhir, sebuah Anomaly mirip gurita yang memakai tudung kantong kertas datang terhuyung-huyung. Ia jelas sudah berusaha sebaik mungkin menyamar, tapi semua orang langsung tahu bahwa ia bukan manusia. Di bawah tatapan banyak mata yang waspada, Anomaly misterius itu menjulurkan tentakel hitam yang panjang dan lincah lalu menyerahkan resumenya, menunjukkan dengan sangat jelas niatnya bergabung dengan Bureau.
Para pewawancara kebingungan, tapi tetap memberinya kesempatan. Karena Anomaly ini menyembunyikan wajah aslinya di balik kantong kertas entah karena apa, jelas mustahil menilainya dengan standar manusia biasa. Para pewawancara memberinya wawancara standar, disusul beberapa penilaian dadakan yang disesuaikan dengan kemampuannya. Hasilnya ternyata sangat mengesankan. Anomaly itu terbukti sangat terampil dalam pekerjaan administrasi, dengan "tangan dan kaki" yang luar biasa cekatan. Demi keadilan dan tanpa pilih kasih, Bureau of Anomaly Control akhirnya memutuskan mempekerjakannya.
Inilah U-7646[Or], yang kini dikenal sebagai "Mr. Bag": Anomaly tanpa penjamin yang mendapat pekerjaan sepenuhnya berkat usahanya sendiri dan kini bekerja di bawah Bureau of Anomaly Control. Sesuai namanya, ia selalu memakai tudung dari kantong kertas, beserta "kemeja" dari bahan yang sama. Di balik kemeja itu ada beberapa tentakel panjang dan lentur yang mirip bayangan. "Kalau tudungnya diabaikan, dia sebenarnya keren banget," komentar seorang pegawai suatu kali. Saat tak ada yang melihat, Mr. Bag diam-diam mengganti kantong kertasnya dan menggambar ekspresi di atasnya untuk menunjukkan perasaannya saat itu. Belum ada yang pernah melihat wajah aslinya, dan tak ada yang tahu dari mana ia berasal. "Mr. Bag" adalah nama yang terdaftar di dokumen kepegawaiannya, sementara "Mr." adalah gelar yang ia sendiri bersikeras tambahkan. Jelas, Mr. Bag sangat berharap dihormati sebagai manusia. Mungkin itu salah satu alasan ia memilih menyamar dan masuk ke masyarakat manusia.
Sejak menjabat, Mr. Bag menangani pekerjaan membosankan berupa menyusun dan mendistribusikan dokumen di dalam dan luar Bureau. Agar ia bisa bekerja dengan maksimal, Bureau memberi Mr. Bag ruang kerja pribadi yang sangat luas, sehingga ia bisa bebas melambaikan tentakelnya di lingkungan terbuka dan memproses tugas dengan efisien di berbagai lini sekaligus. Ruang khususnya berisi kotak surat yang tak terhitung jumlahnya. Satu ujung setiap kotak surat terhubung ke kantornya, sementara ujung lainnya terhubung ke kantor-kantor Bureau of Anomaly Control di seluruh Hethereau dan ke beberapa departemen pemerintahan. Mr. Bag tahu lokasi dan pemilik setiap kotak surat. Selama jam kerja, ia bisa terlihat cepat melambaikan "tentakel bayangannya", mengumpulkan dokumen yang dikirim dari berbagai tempat lewat kotak surat, lalu memilah dan mengarsipkannya. Terkadang, ia juga memakai kotak surat untuk membagikan dokumen. Orang yang belum terbiasa dengan kotak surat itu sering kaget melihat tentakel yang tiba-tiba muncul dari dalamnya, tapi Mr. Bag sudah lama terbiasa dengan reaksi seperti itu. Terkadang, setelah mengirim atau mengambil berkas yang diperlukan, ia bahkan memberi sedikit isyarat salam sebelum menghilang dengan cepat, menarik kembali tentakelnya semendadak ia muncul dan menutup kotak suratnya.
Di luar tugas utamanya, Mr. Bag juga mengelola "Mr. Bag Tips", saluran siaran publik yang dijalankan Bureau of Anomaly Control untuk seluruh warga. Saluran ini biasanya menyiarkan konten seperti "Dasar-Dasar Anomaly", mengirim peringatan Anomaly tingkat rendah, dan menjadi salah satu cara Anomaly Hunter mendapat informasi sayembara Anomaly. Bahkan sambil menangani pekerjaan administrasi dengan efisiensi yang mencengangkan, Mr. Bag tak pernah melewatkan satu siaran pun. Kemampuan kerja yang mencengangkan seperti itu mungkin hanya bisa disaingi yang dikenal sebagai "Agent.LUCK".
Berkat kinerjanya yang luar biasa, Mr. Bag menjadi satu-satunya pegawai dalam sejarah Bureau of Anomaly Control yang memenangkan "Pegawai Terbaik Bulan Ini" empat belas bulan berturut-turut. "Jadi, perlakukan saja Mr. Bag seperti rekan kerja lain dan berteman baik dengannya. Aku yakin itu juga yang dia mau," kata wakil kapten ETD-6 saat itu. Sampai hari ini, orang-orang baik di sekitarnya tak pernah membongkar penyamaran Mr. Bag yang canggung, dan Anomaly yang polos itu sudah lama menganggap dirinya bagian dari umat manusia. Selama rekan-rekannya memperlakukannya sebagai manusia, mungkin, dalam praktiknya, memang tidak ada bedanya. Bagi Mr. Bag, itu sudah cukup.

Karakteristik
Mr. Bag adalah Anomaly mirip gurita yang memakai tudung kantong kertas dan kemeja dari bahan yang sama. Di balik kemejanya ada beberapa tentakel panjang dan lentur mirip bayangan. Saat tak ada orang, ia diam-diam mengganti kantong kertasnya dan menggambar ekspresi di atasnya untuk menunjukkan perasaannya.
·Ia pandai memproses dokumen secara efisien di berbagai lini sekaligus. Sejak menjabat, ia bertanggung jawab menyusun dan mendistribusikan banyak dokumen di dalam dan luar Bureau secara terpusat.
Ia yakin dirinya bagian dari umat manusia dan sangat berharap dihormati serta diperlakukan sebagai manusia.

Anomaly Nexus
Izin akses tidak mencukupi. Saat ini tidak bisa diakses.

Penilaian Risiko
Umumnya tidak berbahaya. Mr. Bag cukup tangguh dalam pertarungan, tapi sangat ramah terhadap manusia. Meski begitu, tolong jangan sengaja memprovokasinya.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Anomaly unik, dijamin oleh Bureau of Anomaly Control.

story.en:
There have only been a handful of direct sightings of a "Leech Spawn". The puzzle of this Anomaly can only be pieced together from blurry footage and fragmented witness accounts. Due to the nature of the "Leech Spawn", in that they often attach themselves to objects or lurk in the shadows, they're incredibly difficult to catch.
A "Leech Spawn" is a type of "Protocore" Anomaly, with no stable physical form, and is thus classified as low-level Oddities. Their overall shape resembles a dog, but their head looks like two fists fused. Their tail is similar, in that it has the streamlined structure of a hand. Leech Spawns are composed of a mist-like substance that radiates cold temperatures, causing anything it touches to go numb.
Leech Spawn display a quasi-biological habit of attaching themselves to objects to conceal themselves. Because of this, Leech Spawn are incredibly difficult to contain or nullify.
According to most witness accounts, Leech Spawns often attach themselves to streetlights and create the illusion of malfunctions to lure in maintenance workers. They can also potentially utilize shadows beneath streetlights to mimic human silhouettes, while repeatedly emitting sounds that are similar to a baby's cry for help. It should be noted that this Anomaly merely mimics noises, and does not have the proper vocal organs to speak.
Multiple related incidents have already become urban legends among the public, and are discussed across many sections of online forums. The source for Leech Spawn is no longer reliable.

Anomaly Characteristics
- Leech Spawns are hound-like Bio Anomaly and a branch of "Protocore";
- Their true bodies are made of a mist-like substance and have no stable form;
- They possess visual organs that appear iridescent under different lighting angles;
- Their bodies have sleek, hand-like structures, allowing for rapid movement;
- Their behavior patterns show deliberate imitation of intelligent life;
- They often attach themselves to objects to camouflage themselves;

Anomaly Nexus
Create bright light to disrupt the Oddity's habitat.

Risk Assessment
Potential threat.

Containment Status
Most have been nullified. A small number are contained at the Celaeno Compound.

Containment Measures
Illuminate with light sources, ensuring there are no blind spots present.

Experiment Log
Test Objective: Determine how light affects Leech Spawn behavior.
The test team consisted of C.S.U. members with specialized Anomaly-handling training. With adequate protective measures in place, there was no risk to life or any other safety issues.

Variable Control: Illumination level—controlled through adjusting the lighting equipment.

Results:
- At 100% illumination, Leech Spawn showed almost no behavior, only occasionally pacing slowly with no clear, identifiable purpose.
- At 60% illumination, Leech Spawn were capable of running and moving about. They showed no obvious aggression, but remained wary of approaching organisms.
- At 30% illumination, Leech Spawn displayed clear aggressive behavior, and their behavior patterns shifted from vigilance to active aggression.
- With no illumination, Leech Spawn reverted to their pre-containment behavior patterns and aggression, posing a safety threat. Testing was conducted using inanimate dummies.

Derivative Anomaly
/
story.id:
Baru segelintir penampakan langsung "Leech Spawn" yang pernah tercatat. Teka-teki Anomaly ini hanya bisa dirangkai dari rekaman buram dan keterangan saksi yang terpotong-potong. Karena sifat "Leech Spawn" yang sering menempel pada benda atau bersembunyi dalam bayangan, mereka sangat sulit ditangkap.
"Leech Spawn" adalah sejenis Anomaly "Protocore" yang tidak punya wujud fisik stabil, sehingga digolongkan sebagai Oddity tingkat rendah. Bentuk keseluruhannya menyerupai anjing, tapi kepalanya seperti dua kepalan tangan yang menyatu. Ekornya juga serupa, punya struktur ramping seperti tangan. Leech Spawn tersusun dari zat mirip kabut yang memancarkan hawa dingin, membuat apa pun yang disentuhnya mati rasa.
Leech Spawn menunjukkan kebiasaan semi-biologis menempel pada benda untuk menyembunyikan diri. Karena itu, Leech Spawn sangat sulit di-contain atau di-nullify.
Menurut sebagian besar keterangan saksi, Leech Spawn sering menempel di lampu jalan dan menciptakan ilusi kerusakan untuk memancing petugas perawatan. Mereka juga bisa memanfaatkan bayangan di bawah lampu jalan untuk meniru siluet manusia, sambil berulang kali mengeluarkan suara mirip tangisan bayi minta tolong. Perlu dicatat bahwa Anomaly ini hanya meniru suara, dan tidak punya organ suara yang memadai untuk berbicara.
Beberapa insiden terkait sudah menjadi legenda urban di masyarakat, dan dibahas di banyak bagian forum daring. Sumber informasi tentang Leech Spawn kini tak lagi bisa diandalkan.

Karakteristik Anomaly
- Leech Spawn adalah Bio Anomaly mirip anjing pemburu dan cabang dari "Protocore";
- Tubuh aslinya terbuat dari zat mirip kabut dan tidak punya wujud stabil;
- Mereka punya organ penglihatan yang tampak berkilau pelangi di bawah sudut cahaya berbeda;
- Tubuh mereka punya struktur ramping seperti tangan, sehingga bisa bergerak cepat;
- Pola perilaku mereka menunjukkan peniruan makhluk cerdas yang disengaja;
- Mereka sering menempel pada benda untuk berkamuflase;

Anomaly Nexus
Ciptakan cahaya terang untuk mengganggu habitat Oddity ini.

Penilaian Risiko
Ancaman potensial.

Status Containment
Sebagian besar sudah di-nullify. Sejumlah kecil di-contain di Celaeno Compound.

Langkah Containment
Sinari dengan sumber cahaya, pastikan tidak ada titik buta.

Catatan Eksperimen
Tujuan Uji: Menentukan bagaimana cahaya memengaruhi perilaku Leech Spawn.
Tim uji terdiri dari anggota C.S.U. dengan pelatihan khusus penanganan Anomaly. Dengan langkah perlindungan yang memadai, tidak ada risiko terhadap nyawa atau masalah keamanan lainnya.

Kontrol Variabel: Tingkat pencahayaan, dikendalikan dengan mengatur peralatan penerangan.

Hasil:
- Pada pencahayaan 100%, Leech Spawn nyaris tidak menunjukkan perilaku apa pun, hanya sesekali mondar-mandir perlahan tanpa tujuan yang jelas.
- Pada pencahayaan 60%, Leech Spawn bisa berlari dan bergerak. Mereka tidak menunjukkan agresivitas yang jelas, tapi tetap waspada terhadap makhluk yang mendekat.
- Pada pencahayaan 30%, Leech Spawn menunjukkan perilaku agresif yang jelas, dan pola perilakunya bergeser dari waspada menjadi menyerang aktif.
- Tanpa pencahayaan, Leech Spawn kembali ke pola perilaku dan agresivitasnya sebelum di-contain, sehingga menjadi ancaman keamanan. Pengujian dilakukan dengan boneka uji tak bernyawa.

Derivative Anomaly
/

story.en:
Bloomhost Effigies are Anomalies formed from players being eliminated in the game, "Fogden". The items they once carried remain perfectly intact and usable. Instead, their flesh turns to stone, and small buds begin to sprout from their skin, blooming into blue flowers.

Characteristics
Bloomhost Effigies are scattered throughout Fogden's Hunt Zone.
The effigies themselves are inert. The only components considered "alive" are the clusters of small blue flowers sprouting from their body.


Anomaly Nexus
The Fogden Game's rules were broken; Fogden Space was destroyed.

Risk Assessment
No danger

Containment Status
Vanished alongside Fogden's collapse. No containment required.
story.id:
Bloomhost Effigy adalah Anomaly yang terbentuk dari pemain yang tersingkir dalam permainan "Fogden". Barang-barang yang dulu mereka bawa tetap utuh sempurna dan bisa dipakai. Sebaliknya, daging mereka berubah menjadi batu, dan tunas-tunas kecil mulai tumbuh dari kulit mereka, mekar menjadi bunga biru.

Karakteristik
Bloomhost Effigy tersebar di seluruh Hunt Zone Fogden.
Patung-patung itu sendiri tak bergerak. Satu-satunya bagian yang dianggap "hidup" adalah gerombolan bunga biru kecil yang tumbuh dari tubuhnya.


Anomaly Nexus
Aturan Fogden Game dilanggar; Fogden Space hancur.

Penilaian Risiko
Tidak berbahaya

Status Containment
Lenyap bersama runtuhnya Fogden. Tidak perlu Containment.

quote.id: "Di tengah siklus tanpa akhir, siapa yang bisa mendengar tangisan mereka?"

story.en:
The Fogden-Wright is, by far, the most dangerous Derivative Anomaly in Fogden. Within a valley contained in the Hunt Zone, two participants encountered an Oddity that appeared similar to a giant serpent. It was described as "enormous, immensely strong, and with lightning-fast reflexes." At the bottom of the valley, the two participants found multiple remains of other Oddities, alongside a record log left behind by someone who had once defeated the Fogden-Wright. The record log describes the original individual as having a head that imitated the silhouette of a human face, sounds that are similar to those of a snake, scaled wings, a serpentine body, and eye-like markings spread all over its skin. Based on these descriptions, it's been inferred that the Fogden-Wright is not a naturally occurring creature, but a transformed, composite beast pieced together from the remains of previous participants. Following this transformation, none of the participants seem to retain their initial personalities or memories.

Characteristics
Form: A giant serpent-like entity over 65 feet long. Several halo-like rings surround its body.
Behavior: Attacks any living thing that enters its territory.

Anomaly Nexus
Defeated

Risk Assessment
Highly dangerous

Containment Status
Eradicated
story.id:
Fogden-Wright sejauh ini adalah Derivative Anomaly paling berbahaya di Fogden. Di sebuah lembah di dalam Hunt Zone, dua peserta bertemu Oddity yang tampak mirip ular raksasa. Ia digambarkan "besar sekali, luar biasa kuat, dan refleksnya secepat kilat". Di dasar lembah, kedua peserta menemukan banyak sisa Oddity lain, beserta log catatan yang ditinggalkan seseorang yang pernah mengalahkan Fogden-Wright. Log itu menggambarkan individu aslinya punya kepala yang meniru siluet wajah manusia, suara mirip ular, sayap bersisik, tubuh seperti ular, dan tanda-tanda mirip mata di seluruh kulitnya. Berdasarkan gambaran ini, diduga Fogden-Wright bukan makhluk yang muncul secara alami, melainkan binatang gabungan hasil perubahan yang dirangkai dari sisa-sisa peserta sebelumnya. Setelah perubahan ini, tak satu pun peserta tampaknya masih mempertahankan kepribadian atau ingatan awalnya.

Karakteristik
Wujud: Entitas mirip ular raksasa sepanjang lebih dari 65 kaki. Beberapa cincin mirip lingkaran cahaya mengelilingi tubuhnya.
Perilaku: Menyerang makhluk hidup apa pun yang memasuki wilayahnya.

Anomaly Nexus
Dikalahkan

Penilaian Risiko
Sangat berbahaya

Status Containment
Sudah dimusnahkan
