story.en:
St. Arbor is a place name that no longer appears on modern maps. According to historical records, the town was destroyed during a "witch trial," and the Inquisitor, who presided over the trial, disappeared. The historical records surrounding the incident are riddled with inconsistencies, with different versions of the chronicles even contradicting one another on certain points. However, they all agree that the incident marked a major turning point in the surrounding regions' attitudes toward the witch-hunt. Following the incident, witch trials in the surrounding areas gradually declined until they disappeared altogether.
What no one could have expected was that the Inquisitor, who disappeared during the trial, would return to the world in the form of an anomaly.

Anomaly C-8782-6-2[Or], the Inquisitor, was once a human named Cotton. He later became the host of Inquisitor the oddity, and this anomaly is preliminarily identified as one of the derivative anomalies of the anomaly Witch-Hunt. In the unenlightened age when the Inquisitor first emerged, witch trials were commonplace, and people generally attributed their misfortunes to witches. It was in this environment that the unprecedentedly powerful witch-hunt anomaly came into being. Under the influence of the witch-hunt anomaly, those who traveled from place to place in the name of faith, putting witches on trial, were humans who wielded the authority of judgment. Not all of these people became hosts of the anomaly. Most were merely apostles who spread the witch-hunt anomaly among the populace. The trial that took place in St. Arbor, however, not only implicated a great many people but was also disrupted by a "special circumstance," causing the human Cotton to suffer severe Encroachment and become the host of the Inquisitor.
The Inquisitor is the embodiment of humanity's obsession with "judging witches." It can also draw nourishment from people's accusations and attacks, growing ever stronger. It possesses the ability to control flames and uses them to burn those it deems witches. No ordinary human can withstand the Inquisitor's flames, meaning its judgment can continue without end.
The Inquisitor, born in St. Arbor, was imprisoned by the power of ■■■■ and was therefore recorded as missing. Inquisitor recently broke free of its imprisonment and appeared in the real world, bringing the witch-hunt anomaly of that era back with it. However, times have changed, and modern society no longer provides the conditions necessary for the Inquisitor to survive. After the Anomalous Realm was broken, Inquisitor also weakened and was ultimately nullified.

Power breeds desire, and even the exercise of power itself can become a form of desire. Unlike the masses influenced by the witch-hunt anomaly, judges did not have to fear becoming the targets of judgment themselves. Instead, they possessed the power to decide whether ordinary people should live or die. They were not corrupt from the outset. Many genuinely believed that they could protect the people by putting witches on trial. But such beliefs were twisted and exploited by the witch-hunt anomaly, until eventually, the trials themselves became the objective.

Editor's Note: Yggash Court has reviewed and redacted sensitive information.

Characteristics
Possesses both human and non-human biological forms.
Possesses the ability to control flames.
As a derivative of the witch-hunt anomaly, it takes physical form and incites the negative emotions within people.

Anomaly Nexus
Weakens after the witch-hunt anomaly is nullified, and defeating it will lead to its nullification.

Risk Assessment
Moderate risk.

Contain/Guarantee Status
Already Nullified.
story.id:
St. Arbor adalah nama tempat yang tak lagi muncul di peta modern. Menurut catatan sejarah, kota ini hancur dalam sebuah "pengadilan penyihir", dan Inquisitor yang memimpin pengadilan itu menghilang. Catatan sejarah seputar insiden ini penuh ketidakcocokan, bahkan berbagai versi kronik saling bertentangan di beberapa poin. Namun, semuanya sepakat bahwa insiden ini menjadi titik balik besar dalam sikap wilayah sekitarnya terhadap perburuan penyihir. Setelah insiden itu, pengadilan penyihir di daerah sekitarnya perlahan berkurang sampai hilang sama sekali.
Yang tak pernah disangka siapa pun, Inquisitor yang menghilang saat pengadilan itu akan kembali ke dunia dalam wujud Anomaly.

Anomaly C-8782-6-2[Or], Inquisitor, dulunya manusia bernama Cotton. Ia kemudian menjadi inang Oddity Inquisitor, dan Anomaly ini sementara diidentifikasi sebagai salah satu Derivative Anomaly dari Anomaly Witch-Hunt. Di zaman kegelapan saat Inquisitor pertama kali muncul, pengadilan penyihir adalah hal biasa, dan orang-orang umumnya menyalahkan penyihir atas kemalangan mereka. Di lingkungan inilah Anomaly perburuan penyihir yang kekuatannya belum pernah ada sebelumnya lahir. Di bawah pengaruh Anomaly perburuan penyihir, mereka yang berkelana dari satu tempat ke tempat lain atas nama iman untuk mengadili penyihir adalah manusia yang memegang wewenang penghakiman. Tidak semua orang ini menjadi inang Anomaly. Sebagian besar hanyalah rasul yang menyebarkan Anomaly perburuan penyihir di tengah masyarakat. Namun, pengadilan di St. Arbor bukan hanya menyeret banyak sekali orang, tapi juga terganggu oleh sebuah "keadaan khusus", sehingga manusia bernama Cotton mengalami Encroachment parah dan menjadi inang Inquisitor.
Inquisitor adalah perwujudan obsesi manusia untuk "mengadili penyihir". Ia juga bisa menyerap kekuatan dari tuduhan dan serangan orang-orang, sehingga makin kuat. Ia punya kemampuan mengendalikan api dan memakainya untuk membakar mereka yang ia anggap penyihir. Tak ada manusia biasa yang sanggup menahan api Inquisitor, artinya penghakimannya bisa terus berlanjut tanpa akhir.
Inquisitor, yang lahir di St. Arbor, dipenjarakan oleh kekuatan ■■■■ dan karena itu dicatat sebagai hilang. Inquisitor baru-baru ini lepas dari penjaranya dan muncul di dunia nyata, membawa kembali Anomaly perburuan penyihir dari zaman itu. Namun, zaman sudah berubah, dan masyarakat modern tak lagi menyediakan kondisi yang dibutuhkan Inquisitor untuk bertahan. Setelah Anomalous Realm-nya hancur, Inquisitor juga melemah dan akhirnya ter-nullify.

Kekuasaan melahirkan hasrat, bahkan menjalankan kekuasaan itu sendiri bisa menjadi semacam hasrat. Tidak seperti rakyat yang terpengaruh Anomaly perburuan penyihir, para hakim tak perlu takut menjadi sasaran penghakiman. Sebaliknya, mereka punya kuasa menentukan hidup atau mati orang biasa. Mereka tidak korup sejak awal. Banyak yang sungguh-sungguh percaya bisa melindungi rakyat dengan mengadili penyihir. Tapi keyakinan semacam itu diputarbalikkan dan dimanfaatkan Anomaly perburuan penyihir, sampai akhirnya pengadilan itu sendiri yang menjadi tujuan.

Catatan Editor: Yggash Court telah meninjau dan menyensor informasi sensitif.

Karakteristik
Punya wujud manusia sekaligus wujud makhluk non-manusia.
Punya kemampuan mengendalikan api.
Sebagai turunan Anomaly perburuan penyihir, ia mengambil wujud fisik dan memicu emosi negatif dalam diri orang-orang.

Anomaly Nexus
Melemah setelah Anomaly perburuan penyihir di-nullify, dan mengalahkannya akan membuatnya ter-nullify.

Penilaian Risiko
Risiko sedang.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Sudah di-nullify.

quote.en:
Anomaly Story

"A banquet that abducts but not invites is destined to welcome only reluctant guests."

There are many legends about the origin of Anomaly C-1704, commonly known as the "Expired Invitation." The following is the most widely circulated:

Long, long ago, as a wealthy merchant was nearing the end of his life, he reflected on his years: mountains of wealth, countless honors, and though he had no children, he was always surrounded by people wherever he went. The merchant was quite satisfied. "I have no regrets in this life," he thought.
Just then, laughter drifted in from outside his enormous floor-to-ceiling window. He struggled to sit up and peered through, spotting a family was holding a party across the street. Children chased each other, laughing and playing. When they grew tired, they climbed onto their elders' laps to beg for sweets. The dishes on the table were modest, but the flickering candlelight looked so warm and bright… Meanwhile, in the vast bedroom where the merchant lay, how cold the light from the crystal chandelier seemed!
The merchant's banquet hall had once been packed with guests, but none of those gatherings had ever felt so warm. Every wine glass held invisible interests, exchanged with each gentle clink of the rim. Yes, the merchant thought: I want to hold a "true banquet."
And so, he ordered countless invitations to be sent out. The next day, the merchant forced himself out of his sickbed, changed into a loose evening suit, and had his Butler wheel him to the banquet hall. But when he opened the doors, not a soul was in attendance…
The merchant refused to believe that perhaps he was not as beloved as he had imagined. That night, he tossed and turned, making a silent promise: If anyone comes to my banquet tomorrow, I will open my mansion, my gardens, and my treasury to them, and let them choose any gift they should so desire.
Still, not one soul came.
On the second night, the merchant thought: If anyone comes to my banquet tomorrow, I will give them my most precious thing… my wealth!
Still, no one came.
On the third night, the merchant thought: If anyone comes to my banquet tomorrow, I will do everything in my power to grant all their seemingly impossible wishes!
Still, the halls were empty.

Time passed, and the merchant's illness worsened in his solitude. At last, he no longer had the strength to rise from bed. Hearing the footsteps of death's approach, he felt regret, rage, and resentment churn and swell within his cooling body. With his final breath before dawn, the merchant uttered a curse: Whoever opens my invitation shall never leave my "banquet."


The truth of this legend remains unknown as I record this profile. What we can confirm is this: the merchant's dying curse may be one of the most destructive "curses" in human history, so much so that even when people use it as a swear, they cannot help but feel a twinge of dread.
Now, although the gardens of eternal spring have long fallen to ruin and the magnificent mansion has changed hands, those expired invitations still bear the merchant's curse. They appear to be nothing more than an oversized golden wax seal, unremarkable aside from their size… but the moment someone accidentally touches one, they are forced to become an "invitee" of the Expired Invitation and "visit" a dim courtyard constructed entirely of cardboard.
The cardboard castle folded within the invitation dutifully despises every guest, unfurling a malicious red carpet eager to devour all that approach, simultaneously raising weapons fit for a siege. The tardy guests flee in panic, barely escaping with their lives. The bell announcing the end of the banquet should be its Nexus, but as if to punish these late arrivals, it too is always fashionably late. Beyond that, unless the entire Anomaly is violently subjected to nullification, nothing can stop it from toying with the next passerby who is forcibly invited.
In recent years, thanks to the joint efforts of the Circle and Anomaly Hunters, the quantity of Expired Invitations has been greatly reduced. However, some may still lurk in streets and alleyways… Since the total number cannot be determined, we have no way of knowing how long this prolonged vengeance will continue, nor whether new invitations might be born should another host somewhere harbor similar resentments toward guests who refused to attend.
Perhaps the way these invitations come into being has never been truly understood. A long-told story may simply be repeated to perpetuate itself. The more I study, the more I realize how little humanity knows about anomalies.
However, at least one thing is certain: when you go for a walk, remember to watch your step.

Anomaly Characteristics

· Appears as a large golden wax seal, typically found on flat ground.
· Humans who directly touch the wax seal are drawn into a pop-up book-style Anomalous Realm, forced to attend an "expired banquet."
· The seemingly fairytale-like Anomalous Realm is actually hostile toward intruders. Once inside, visitors will certainly be attacked by the cardboard castle and the cardboard red carpet.
· The total quantity is unknown, the locations are unknown, and the duration after triggering is unknown. After a guest escapes the Anomalous Realm, it folds back into the form of a wax seal. The Anomaly can be triggered multiples.
· After nullification, the wax seal burns itself out completely, leaving behind a treasure chest in its place. This is perhaps the party favor originally prepared for guests.

Anomaly Nexus

The bell announcing "the end of the banquet"

Risk Assessment

Before Activation: Stable. After Activation: Highly aggressive toward humans who enter the Anomalous Realm.

Containment/Guarantee Status

5 specimens in long-term containment at Celaeno Compound.

Containment Measures

No special measures required. Simply ensure containment in an environment where ordinary people cannot make contact and the Anomaly cannot be accidentally triggered.

Experiment Records

Experiment 1
Dispatched one test subject with sufficient supplies into the Expired Invitation's space to observe the time required for the Anomaly to naturally undergo nullification.
After 119 hours, the experiment was terminated out of concern for the test subject's physical and mental endurance. The Expired Invitation showed zero signs of natural nullification.

Experiment 2
Test subject entered the space carrying multiple timing devices, playing bell sounds and announcing "the banquet is over" at different intervals to observe the Anomalous Realm's response.
The Expired Invitation did not respond to any of the sounds. Preliminary assessment: objective changes in and external announcements cannot trigger nullification of the Expired Invitation.

Derivative Anomaly

/
quote.id:
Kisah Anomaly

"Pesta yang menculik alih-alih mengundang ditakdirkan hanya menyambut tamu yang terpaksa."

Ada banyak legenda tentang asal-usul Anomaly C-1704, yang dikenal sebagai "Expired Invitation". Berikut yang paling banyak beredar:

Dahulu kala, saat seorang saudagar kaya mendekati akhir hidupnya, ia merenungkan tahun-tahun yang telah berlalu: kekayaan menggunung, kehormatan tak terhitung, dan meski tak punya anak, ia selalu dikelilingi orang ke mana pun ia pergi. Sang saudagar cukup puas. "Aku tidak punya penyesalan dalam hidup ini," pikirnya.
Saat itu juga, suara tawa terdengar dari luar jendelanya yang tinggi menjulang dari lantai ke langit-langit. Ia bersusah payah duduk dan mengintip keluar, melihat sebuah keluarga sedang berpesta di seberang jalan. Anak-anak berkejaran sambil tertawa dan bermain. Saat lelah, mereka naik ke pangkuan orang tua untuk minta permen. Hidangan di meja sederhana, tapi cahaya lilin yang berkedip tampak begitu hangat dan terang… Sementara itu, di kamar tidur luas tempat sang saudagar berbaring, betapa dinginnya cahaya dari lampu gantung kristal itu!
Aula pesta sang saudagar dulu selalu penuh tamu, tapi tak satu pun pertemuan itu pernah terasa sehangat ini. Setiap gelas anggur menyimpan kepentingan tersembunyi yang dipertukarkan di setiap denting lembut bibir gelas. Ya, pikir sang saudagar: aku ingin mengadakan "pesta yang sesungguhnya".
Maka ia memerintahkan agar undangan yang tak terhitung jumlahnya dikirim. Keesokan harinya, sang saudagar memaksakan diri bangun dari ranjang sakitnya, mengenakan setelan malam yang longgar, dan meminta butler-nya mendorong kursi rodanya ke aula pesta. Tapi saat ia membuka pintu, tak seorang pun hadir…
Sang saudagar menolak percaya bahwa mungkin ia tidak sedicintai yang ia bayangkan. Malam itu, ia gelisah tak bisa tidur dan membuat janji dalam diam: Jika ada yang datang ke pestaku besok, akan kubuka rumah besarku, tamanku, dan gudang hartaku untuk mereka, dan mereka boleh memilih hadiah apa pun yang mereka inginkan.
Tetap saja, tak seorang pun datang.
Pada malam kedua, sang saudagar berpikir: Jika ada yang datang ke pestaku besok, akan kuberikan milikku yang paling berharga… kekayaanku!
Tetap saja, tak ada yang datang.
Pada malam ketiga, sang saudagar berpikir: Jika ada yang datang ke pestaku besok, akan kulakukan segala upaya untuk mengabulkan semua keinginan mereka yang tampak mustahil!
Tetap saja, aula itu kosong.

Waktu berlalu, dan penyakit sang saudagar makin parah dalam kesendiriannya. Akhirnya, ia tak lagi punya tenaga untuk bangun dari ranjang. Mendengar langkah kematian yang mendekat, ia merasakan penyesalan, amarah, dan dendam bergolak dan membuncah di tubuhnya yang mendingin. Dengan napas terakhirnya sebelum fajar, sang saudagar mengucapkan kutukan: Siapa pun yang membuka undanganku tak akan pernah bisa meninggalkan "pesta"-ku.


Kebenaran legenda ini masih belum diketahui saat aku mencatat profil ini. Yang bisa kami pastikan adalah: kutukan terakhir sang saudagar mungkin salah satu "kutukan" paling merusak dalam sejarah manusia, sampai-sampai saat orang memakainya sebagai sumpah serapah pun, mereka tetap merasa sedikit ngeri.
Kini, meski taman musim semi abadi itu sudah lama menjadi reruntuhan dan rumah besar yang megah itu sudah berganti pemilik, undangan-undangan kedaluwarsa itu masih membawa kutukan sang saudagar. Wujudnya hanyalah segel lilin emas berukuran besar, tak ada yang istimewa selain ukurannya… tapi begitu seseorang tak sengaja menyentuhnya, ia dipaksa menjadi "tamu undangan" Expired Invitation dan "berkunjung" ke halaman remang yang seluruhnya terbuat dari kardus.
Kastel kardus yang terlipat di dalam undangan itu dengan setia membenci setiap tamu, membentangkan karpet merah jahat yang siap melahap siapa pun yang mendekat, sambil mengangkat senjata yang pantas untuk pengepungan. Para tamu yang terlambat lari ketakutan, nyaris tak lolos dengan selamat. Lonceng yang menandakan akhir pesta seharusnya menjadi Nexus-nya, tapi seolah ingin menghukum para tamu terlambat itu, lonceng itu pun selalu datang terlambat. Selain itu, kecuali seluruh Anomaly di-nullify dengan paksa, tak ada yang bisa menghentikannya mempermainkan orang berikutnya yang dipaksa datang.
Beberapa tahun terakhir, berkat kerja sama Circle dan Anomaly Hunter, jumlah Expired Invitation sudah berkurang drastis. Namun, sebagian mungkin masih bersembunyi di jalan-jalan dan gang… Karena jumlah totalnya tidak bisa dipastikan, kami tak punya cara mengetahui berapa lama dendam berkepanjangan ini akan berlanjut, atau apakah undangan baru bisa lahir jika ada tuan rumah lain di suatu tempat yang menyimpan dendam serupa terhadap tamu yang menolak datang.
Mungkin cara undangan-undangan ini tercipta tak pernah benar-benar dipahami. Sebuah kisah yang sudah lama diceritakan mungkin hanya terus diulang untuk melestarikan dirinya. Semakin banyak aku meneliti, semakin aku sadar betapa sedikit yang diketahui umat manusia tentang Anomaly.
Namun, setidaknya satu hal pasti: saat kamu berjalan-jalan, ingatlah untuk memperhatikan langkahmu.

Karakteristik Anomaly

· Berwujud segel lilin emas berukuran besar, biasanya ditemukan di tanah yang datar.
· Manusia yang menyentuh segel lilin secara langsung akan tertarik ke Anomalous Realm bergaya buku pop-up, dipaksa menghadiri "pesta kedaluwarsa".
· Anomalous Realm yang tampak seperti dongeng ini sebenarnya bermusuhan terhadap penyusup. Begitu masuk, pengunjung pasti akan diserang kastel kardus dan karpet merah kardus.
· Jumlah totalnya tidak diketahui, lokasinya tidak diketahui, dan durasinya setelah terpicu juga tidak diketahui. Setelah tamu lolos dari Anomalous Realm, ia terlipat kembali ke wujud segel lilin. Anomaly ini bisa terpicu berkali-kali.
· Setelah Nullification, segel lilin terbakar habis dengan sendirinya, meninggalkan peti harta karun di tempatnya. Mungkin ini oleh-oleh pesta yang awalnya disiapkan untuk para tamu.

Anomaly Nexus

Lonceng yang menandakan "akhir pesta"

Penilaian Risiko

Sebelum Aktif: Stabil. Setelah Aktif: Sangat agresif terhadap manusia yang memasuki Anomalous Realm.

Status Containment/Penjaminan

5 spesimen di-contain jangka panjang di Celaeno Compound.

Langkah Containment

Tidak perlu langkah khusus. Cukup pastikan di-contain di lingkungan yang tidak bisa disentuh orang biasa dan Anomaly-nya tidak bisa terpicu secara tidak sengaja.

Catatan Eksperimen

Eksperimen 1
Mengirim satu subjek uji dengan perbekalan yang cukup ke dalam ruang Expired Invitation untuk mengamati waktu yang dibutuhkan Anomaly agar ter-nullify secara alami.
Setelah 119 jam, eksperimen dihentikan karena khawatir akan daya tahan fisik dan mental subjek uji. Expired Invitation sama sekali tidak menunjukkan tanda Nullification alami.

Eksperimen 2
Subjek uji masuk ke ruang tersebut membawa beberapa alat pengatur waktu, memutar suara lonceng dan mengumumkan "pesta sudah selesai" pada interval berbeda untuk mengamati respons Anomalous Realm.
Expired Invitation tidak merespons suara apa pun. Penilaian awal: perubahan objektif dan pengumuman dari luar tidak bisa memicu Nullification Expired Invitation.

Derivative Anomaly

/

story.en:
Deep into your desk drawer, you might find a notebook buried among old papers. It probably has a dark cover (most likely cheap synthetic leather), decorated with cryptic symbols or pretentious quotes. Flip through the yellowed pages, and you'll find records of adolescent fantasies, embarrassing incantations you would never want anyone else to see. Most people go through a phase in their teens when they believe they are unique, a chosen one burdened with a special destiny, but they are too self-conscious to tell anyone… and so they stay up late at night, pouring their hearts out to a notebook.
…If you know what I'm talking about, then you probably already have a good idea of what the Anomaly known as the "Black Tome" looks like.

C-7111(Ob) Black Tome typically appears as a book with a black cover, and a piercing purple eye in the center. Legend has it that the Black Tome contains powerful spells that allow one to cast "magic." In reality, most of what's written inside is nonsensical teenage rambling, and reciting these so-called "incantations" does nothing at all. However, the claim that the Black Tome can grant magical powers isn't entirely false… which brings us to its abilities.
The Black Tome thrives off the power of belief. The more someone believes the Black Tome has powers, the more powerful it actually becomes. Stronger faith grants greater power to the Black Tome, and in turn, this power flows back to its believers: after reciting the incantations written in the Black Tome, believers can achieve nullification of some low threat anomalies. However, it is not the person reciting the spell who nullifies the Anomaly, but the Black Tome itself. The stronger the Black Tome becomes, the more powerful the targets it can nullify.
After first using an incantation from the Black Tome, another ability gradually manifests. It applies mental suggestion to users, causing them to treat their faith in the Black Tome as absolute truth. In pursuit of greater power, they are compelled to attract more people to believe in the Black Tome, eventually becoming a puppet with the sole purpose of spreading the Black Tome's faith. Those influenced and converted to believing in the Black Tome are also subjected to this blind faith, but do not gain the Black Tome's power. Additionally, the Black Tome sometimes uses its abilities to enslave and control low threat anomalies to serve itself.
When the Black Tome is opened by a non-believer, it generates an Anomalous Realm called the "Library," pulling the reader inside to face the Black Tome's true form. Its appearance within is a black humanoid figure, with the original book forming the head, surrounded by twisted limbs. Its behavior seems driven by wrath against non-believers, and it attempts to eliminate anyone who enters the Library. In battle, the Black Tome employs various magic-like methods, such as chains, flames, and beams appearing out of thin air, mostly stemming from believers' imagination of its power. Additionally, the Black Tome's close-range attacks using its own limbs should not be underestimated.
When the Black Tome is nullified, its mental influence disappears along with it. Based on current observations, no lingering aftereffects have been found. However, whether long-term belief in the Black Tome can cause permanent psychological distortion or even encroachment remains unknown. Anomalies that manipulate minds are undoubtedly among the most dangerous and insidious types.

Believing you are unique is a good thing, but being unique does not mean possessing extraordinary abilities, nor does it require pursuing great power. Ordinary yet unique… that probably sounds like something from a self-help book. However, if you equate "unique" with "powerful," you will embark on a tedious and endless path. The Black Tome exploits the confusion that people, especially young people, experience in understanding themselves, deceiving them in ways that are nearly impossible to guard against. I hope everyone can understand: we don't need to be powerful, we don't need to be geniuses, we don't need Esper Abilities to be irreplaceable individuals to those around us.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as a black book. Its true form is a twisted humanoid object with a book for a head.
· Can absorb the power of "belief" to strengthen itself and apply mental suggestion to its believers.
· Can nullify or control low threat anomalies.
· The contents recorded in the book are mostly phrases born from adolescent fantasy and have no practical meaning.

Anomaly Nexus
The faith of believers is shaken. Suppressing and defeating the Black Tome within the Anomalous Realm can significantly weaken its mental influence on believers.

Risk Assessment
High hazard. Due to its inherent covertness, involvement of mental suggestion, and strong capacity for spreading and growth, it poses extreme potential danger to society. If discovered, it should be nullified immediately.

Containment/Guarantee Status
The only known specimen has been nullified.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/
story.id:
Jauh di dalam laci mejamu, kamu mungkin menemukan sebuah buku catatan yang terkubur di antara kertas-kertas lama. Sampulnya mungkin gelap (kemungkinan besar kulit sintetis murahan), dihiasi simbol-simbol misterius atau kutipan sok keren. Bolak-balik halamannya yang menguning, dan kamu akan menemukan catatan khayalan masa remaja, mantra memalukan yang tak ingin kamu tunjukkan kepada siapa pun. Kebanyakan orang mengalami fase di masa remaja saat mereka merasa unik, sang terpilih yang memikul takdir istimewa, tapi terlalu malu untuk memberi tahu siapa pun… jadi mereka begadang larut malam, mencurahkan isi hati ke sebuah buku catatan.
…Kalau kamu paham maksudku, kamu mungkin sudah bisa membayangkan seperti apa wujud Anomaly yang dikenal sebagai "Black Tome".

C-7111(Ob) Black Tome biasanya berwujud buku bersampul hitam, dengan mata ungu yang tajam di tengahnya. Konon, Black Tome berisi mantra-mantra kuat yang memungkinkan seseorang mengeluarkan "sihir". Kenyataannya, sebagian besar isinya hanyalah ocehan remaja yang tak masuk akal, dan membacakan apa yang disebut "mantra" itu sama sekali tak berefek. Namun, klaim bahwa Black Tome bisa memberi kekuatan sihir tidak sepenuhnya salah… yang membawa kita ke kemampuannya.
Black Tome hidup dari kekuatan kepercayaan. Semakin seseorang percaya Black Tome punya kekuatan, semakin kuat ia sebenarnya. Kepercayaan yang lebih kuat memberi Black Tome kekuatan lebih besar, dan sebaliknya, kekuatan ini mengalir kembali ke para pengikutnya: setelah membacakan mantra yang tertulis di Black Tome, para pengikut bisa me-nullify beberapa Anomaly berancaman rendah. Namun, bukan orang yang membacakan mantra yang me-nullify Anomaly itu, melainkan Black Tome sendiri. Semakin kuat Black Tome, semakin kuat pula sasaran yang bisa di-nullify-nya.
Setelah pertama kali memakai mantra dari Black Tome, kemampuan lain perlahan muncul. Ia memberikan sugesti mental kepada pemakainya, membuat mereka menganggap kepercayaan pada Black Tome sebagai kebenaran mutlak. Demi mengejar kekuatan lebih besar, mereka terdorong menarik lebih banyak orang untuk percaya pada Black Tome, hingga akhirnya menjadi boneka yang satu-satunya tujuannya menyebarkan kepercayaan Black Tome. Mereka yang terpengaruh dan beralih percaya pada Black Tome juga terkena kepercayaan buta ini, tapi tidak mendapat kekuatan Black Tome. Selain itu, Black Tome terkadang memakai kemampuannya untuk memperbudak dan mengendalikan Anomaly berancaman rendah agar melayaninya.
Saat Black Tome dibuka oleh orang yang tidak percaya, ia menciptakan Anomalous Realm bernama "Library", menarik pembacanya ke dalam untuk menghadapi wujud asli Black Tome. Wujudnya di dalam berupa sosok manusia hitam, dengan buku aslinya sebagai kepala, dikelilingi anggota tubuh yang terpelintir. Perilakunya tampak didorong amarah terhadap orang yang tidak percaya, dan ia berusaha menyingkirkan siapa pun yang memasuki Library. Dalam pertarungan, Black Tome memakai berbagai cara mirip sihir, seperti rantai, api, dan sinar yang muncul entah dari mana, yang sebagian besar berasal dari bayangan para pengikut tentang kekuatannya. Selain itu, serangan jarak dekat Black Tome dengan anggota tubuhnya sendiri juga tak boleh diremehkan.
Saat Black Tome di-nullify, pengaruh mentalnya ikut lenyap. Berdasarkan pengamatan saat ini, belum ditemukan efek samping yang tersisa. Namun, apakah kepercayaan jangka panjang pada Black Tome bisa menyebabkan penyimpangan psikologis permanen bahkan Encroachment masih belum diketahui. Anomaly yang memanipulasi pikiran jelas termasuk jenis yang paling berbahaya dan licik.

Percaya bahwa dirimu unik itu hal baik, tapi menjadi unik tidak berarti punya kemampuan luar biasa, juga tidak mengharuskanmu mengejar kekuatan besar. Biasa saja tapi unik… mungkin terdengar seperti isi buku pengembangan diri. Namun, jika kamu menyamakan "unik" dengan "kuat", kamu akan menempuh jalan yang melelahkan dan tak berujung. Black Tome memanfaatkan kebingungan yang dialami orang-orang, terutama anak muda, dalam memahami diri mereka sendiri, menipu mereka dengan cara yang nyaris mustahil diwaspadai. Aku harap semua orang bisa mengerti: kita tidak perlu kuat, tidak perlu jenius, tidak perlu Esper Ability untuk menjadi pribadi yang tak tergantikan bagi orang-orang di sekitar kita.

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Berwujud buku hitam. Wujud aslinya adalah objek mirip manusia yang terpelintir dengan buku sebagai kepala.
· Bisa menyerap kekuatan "kepercayaan" untuk memperkuat dirinya dan memberikan sugesti mental kepada para pengikutnya.
· Bisa me-nullify atau mengendalikan Anomaly berancaman rendah.
· Isi yang tercatat di buku itu sebagian besar kalimat yang lahir dari khayalan masa remaja dan tak punya makna praktis.

Anomaly Nexus
Kepercayaan para pengikut goyah. Menekan dan mengalahkan Black Tome di dalam Anomalous Realm bisa sangat melemahkan pengaruh mentalnya terhadap para pengikut.

Penilaian Risiko
Bahaya tinggi. Karena sifatnya yang tersembunyi, melibatkan sugesti mental, dan punya kemampuan menyebar serta berkembang yang kuat, ia berpotensi sangat berbahaya bagi masyarakat. Jika ditemukan, harus segera di-nullify.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Satu-satunya spesimen yang diketahui sudah di-nullify.

Langkah Containment
/

Catatan Eksperimen
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

quote.en: "He will keep on laughing."
quote.id: "Ia akan terus tertawa."

story.en:
There was once a famous clown named Lar. Every show he appeared in was packed to the rafters, and audiences were always moved by his hilarious performances and witty jokes, laughing until they doubled over. However, after his final performance before retirement, he was found dead in the backstage dressing room. He sat quietly in his chair, as if he had simply fallen asleep. His mask had melted into a pool of black liquid, and his true face bore no comical smile, only the tired, pale features of an aging man… A subsequent investigation revealed that his life had been filled with countless misfortunes, so much so that he had long grown weary of living. Yet he persisted in performing, for the smiles of his audience were the only remedy for his bitter existence. That melted mask became the first Anomaly known as "Lar," a name given in memory of that performer.

N-0502(Ob) Lar is an Anomaly occasionally found backstage at comedy venues. It appears as a pool of viscous black liquid, with every instance of Lar measures exactly 502 milliliters. Lar can be stored in any sealed container that can hold it, though to avoid accidents, containers of at least 1 liter capacity are recommended. Gloves should be worn when handling Lar to avoid direct skin contact. Upon contact with human skin, Lar will climb from the point of contact and spread across the user's body, which can look somewhat alarming, though the process is harmless. Users may feel a slight tightness on their skin, but once Lar has fully covered the user, they can adjust their appearance, voice, and even alter their body shape and physical features through mental visualization. We strongly recommend using a mirror as an aid. Please do not go outside with a terrifying face. After approximately 2 hours, the Lar covering the user's skin will gradually peel off and return to its liquid state, and the disguise will disappear along with it.
Some users claim that using Lar has a subtle influence on the mind. Users may develop tendencies toward theatrical personalities, attention-seeking behavior, risk-taking, and uncontrollable actions, along with a reduced sense of shame. There is no proof that these effects are caused by Lar, but we have slightly raised its potential hazard rating and are monitoring the effects of long-term use.

Smile! Even a fake smile can be medicine for the soul.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as a pool of 502 milliliters of viscous black liquid. Can be stored in any container.
· Forms a thin film covering the user's body upon skin contact. The user can adjust their appearance and body features.
· Gradually peels off after approximately 2 hours of use, and the disguise disappears.

Anomaly Nexus
Comes in contact with someone who has absolutely no worries, or someone who has absolutely no happiness. When used by the former, Lar evaporates and disperses. When used by the latter, Lar crumbles into fine sand and soon disappears. Neither outcome causes harm to the user.

Risk Assessment
Harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Most specimens are contained at Celaeno Compound. Guarantees are permitted. A small number circulate among the public.

Containment Measures
When not in use, store in any sealed container with a capacity over 1 liter. Letting it bask in the sun occasionally can make it seem less gloomy, but this is not necessary.

Experiment Records
Research on the Potential Psychological Effects of the Anomaly Lar
Experiment 1: A patient with social anxiety was given Lar to use, allowing her to attend social events in an appearance she preferred.
Conclusion: Lar does not improve the user's social skills.

Experiment 2: An ordinary person with no acting experience was given Lar to use and participated in a stage play.
Conclusion: Lar does not improve the user's acting ability.

Experiment 3: An agent used Lar before confessing their feelings to someone they had secretly admired for a long time but never had the courage to approach.
Conclusion: Lar will not turn an introverted and gloomy person into someone bright and cheerful. Not one bit.
Note: I really need to do something about your habit of misusing safe anomalies. You three, come to my office tomorrow.

Derivative Anomaly
/
story.id:
Dulu ada seorang badut terkenal bernama Lar. Setiap pertunjukan yang ia bintangi selalu penuh sesak, dan penonton selalu tersentuh oleh penampilannya yang kocak dan leluconnya yang jenaka, tertawa sampai terpingkal-pingkal. Namun, setelah pertunjukan terakhirnya sebelum pensiun, ia ditemukan tewas di ruang rias belakang panggung. Ia duduk diam di kursinya, seolah hanya tertidur. Topengnya meleleh menjadi genangan cairan hitam, dan wajah aslinya tak menunjukkan senyum lucu sedikit pun, hanya raut lelah dan pucat seorang pria yang menua… Penyelidikan berikutnya mengungkap bahwa hidupnya penuh kemalangan yang tak terhitung, sampai-sampai ia sudah lama lelah hidup. Namun ia tetap tampil, karena senyum penontonnya adalah satu-satunya obat bagi hidupnya yang getir. Topeng yang meleleh itu menjadi Anomaly pertama yang dikenal sebagai "Lar", nama yang diberikan untuk mengenang sang penghibur.

N-0502(Ob) Lar adalah Anomaly yang sesekali ditemukan di belakang panggung tempat pertunjukan komedi. Wujudnya genangan cairan hitam kental, dengan setiap Lar berukuran tepat 502 mililiter. Lar bisa disimpan di wadah tertutup apa pun yang muat, tapi untuk menghindari kecelakaan, disarankan wadah berkapasitas minimal 1 liter. Pakai sarung tangan saat menangani Lar agar tidak bersentuhan langsung dengan kulit. Saat bersentuhan dengan kulit manusia, Lar akan merambat dari titik sentuh dan menyebar ke seluruh tubuh pemakainya, yang mungkin terlihat agak mengkhawatirkan, meski prosesnya tidak berbahaya. Pemakai mungkin merasakan kulitnya sedikit tertarik, tapi begitu Lar menutupi tubuh sepenuhnya, pemakai bisa mengatur penampilan, suara, bahkan mengubah bentuk tubuh dan ciri fisiknya lewat visualisasi pikiran. Kami sangat menyarankan memakai cermin sebagai alat bantu. Tolong jangan keluar rumah dengan wajah menyeramkan. Setelah sekitar 2 jam, Lar yang menutupi kulit pemakai akan perlahan mengelupas dan kembali ke wujud cairnya, dan penyamarannya pun hilang.
Sebagian pemakai mengaku memakai Lar memberi pengaruh halus pada pikiran. Pemakai bisa cenderung berkepribadian teatrikal, suka mencari perhatian, berani ambil risiko, dan bertindak tak terkendali, disertai berkurangnya rasa malu. Tidak ada bukti bahwa efek ini disebabkan Lar, tapi kami sedikit menaikkan peringkat potensi bahayanya dan memantau efek pemakaian jangka panjang.

Tersenyumlah! Senyum palsu pun bisa menjadi obat bagi jiwa.

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Berwujud genangan cairan hitam kental sebanyak 502 mililiter. Bisa disimpan di wadah apa pun.
· Membentuk lapisan tipis yang menutupi tubuh pemakai saat bersentuhan dengan kulit. Pemakai bisa mengatur penampilan dan ciri tubuhnya.
· Perlahan mengelupas setelah sekitar 2 jam dipakai, dan penyamarannya hilang.

Anomaly Nexus
Bersentuhan dengan seseorang yang sama sekali tidak punya kekhawatiran, atau seseorang yang sama sekali tidak punya kebahagiaan. Saat dipakai orang pertama, Lar menguap dan menghilang. Saat dipakai orang kedua, Lar hancur menjadi pasir halus dan segera lenyap. Kedua hasil itu tidak mencelakai pemakainya.

Penilaian Risiko
Tidak berbahaya.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Sebagian besar spesimen di-contain di Celaeno Compound. Penjaminan diizinkan. Sejumlah kecil beredar di masyarakat.

Langkah Containment
Saat tidak dipakai, simpan di wadah tertutup apa pun berkapasitas lebih dari 1 liter. Sesekali menjemurnya di bawah matahari bisa membuatnya tampak tidak terlalu murung, tapi ini tidak wajib.

Catatan Eksperimen
Penelitian Potensi Efek Psikologis Anomaly Lar
Eksperimen 1: Seorang pasien kecemasan sosial diberi Lar untuk dipakai, sehingga ia bisa menghadiri acara sosial dengan penampilan yang ia sukai.
Kesimpulan: Lar tidak meningkatkan kemampuan sosial pemakainya.

Eksperimen 2: Seorang biasa tanpa pengalaman akting diberi Lar untuk dipakai dan ikut dalam sebuah pentas drama.
Kesimpulan: Lar tidak meningkatkan kemampuan akting pemakainya.

Eksperimen 3: Seorang agen memakai Lar sebelum menyatakan perasaan kepada orang yang sudah lama ia kagumi diam-diam tapi tak pernah berani ia dekati.
Kesimpulan: Lar tidak akan mengubah orang yang tertutup dan murung menjadi ceria dan riang. Sama sekali tidak.
Catatan: Aku benar-benar harus melakukan sesuatu soal kebiasaan kalian menyalahgunakan Anomaly yang aman. Kalian bertiga, datang ke kantorku besok.

Derivative Anomaly
/

quote.en: "Smile, hold still… Don't move! Don't blink!"
quote.id: "Senyum, diam… Jangan bergerak! Jangan berkedip!"

story.en:
N-0683(Ob), commonly known as "Cheese," is an Anomaly that occasionally appears in places with a high concentration of photography equipment, such as camera shops, film sets, or large conventions. It blends in with ordinary photography gear, posing as a camera. When a scene catches its fancy, Cheese takes a photo on its own. Click! Then, everything within the frame falls into a state of stasis, unable to move. The duration of this effect varies from person to person, ranging from a few minutes to several dozen minutes. However, those who recover from the stasis seem to have no memory of what happened during that, and show no other abnormalities. By then, Cheese has already undergone nullification, satisfied with the photo it captured.
If you discover a camera that turns out to be Cheese, you can call yourself a "Photographer," which allows you to direct Cheese to capture what you want. Cheese will not include the Photographer in the frame when shooting, however, if none of the photos turn out to its satisfaction, it will turn around and freeze the Photographer before undergoing nullification on its own.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears similar to an ordinary camera.
· When taking a photo, everything within a certain range in front of the lens enters a state of stasis.
· The duration of stasis varies by individual, ranging from a few minutes to several dozen minutes. The effect on Espers is relatively weaker.
· Claiming to be a "Photographer" to Cheese allows control over what Cheese photographs.

Anomaly Nexus
Undergoes nullification after capturing a satisfying photo.

Risk Assessment
Low hazard.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Celaeno Compound has a certain quantity in containment. Public guarantees are permitted.

Containment Measures
Contain in a darkroom, ensuring the lens' field of view is completely dark.

Experiment Records
Research on the Duration of the Stasis Effect of the Anomaly Cheese
Experiment 1: Have the same person photographed by Cheese in different environments.
Conclusion: Significant variation in stasis duration.

Experiment 2: Photograph different people with Cheese in the same environment.
Conclusion: Significant variation in stasis duration.

Experiment 3: Photograph the same person with different instances of Cheese in the same environment.
Conclusion: Significant variation in stasis duration.
Note: That's it. I'm not falling for this again. You're not doing this for research at all. You're just trying to draw on my face while I'm frozen.

Derivative Anomaly
/

Extended Info
/
story.id:
N-0683(Ob), yang umum dikenal sebagai "Cheese", adalah Anomaly yang sesekali muncul di tempat dengan banyak peralatan fotografi, seperti toko kamera, lokasi syuting, atau konvensi besar. Ia berbaur dengan peralatan fotografi biasa, menyamar sebagai kamera. Saat sebuah pemandangan menarik perhatiannya, Cheese memotret sendiri. Cekrek! Lalu, segala sesuatu di dalam bingkai foto membeku, tak bisa bergerak. Lamanya efek ini berbeda-beda tiap orang, mulai dari beberapa menit hingga puluhan menit. Namun, mereka yang pulih dari kondisi beku tampaknya tak ingat apa yang terjadi selama itu, dan tidak menunjukkan keanehan lain. Saat itu, Cheese sudah ter-nullify, puas dengan foto yang diambilnya.
Jika kamu menemukan kamera yang ternyata Cheese, kamu bisa menyebut dirimu "Fotografer", yang memungkinkanmu mengarahkan Cheese memotret apa yang kamu inginkan. Cheese tidak akan memasukkan Fotografer ke dalam bingkai saat memotret, tapi jika tak satu pun foto memuaskannya, ia akan berbalik dan membekukan Fotografer sebelum ter-nullify dengan sendirinya.

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Wujudnya mirip kamera biasa.
· Saat memotret, segala sesuatu dalam jangkauan tertentu di depan lensa membeku.
· Lamanya pembekuan berbeda tiap individu, mulai dari beberapa menit hingga puluhan menit. Efeknya pada Esper relatif lebih lemah.
· Mengaku sebagai "Fotografer" kepada Cheese memungkinkan kendali atas apa yang dipotret Cheese.

Anomaly Nexus
Ter-nullify setelah mengambil foto yang memuaskan.

Penilaian Risiko
Bahaya rendah.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Celaeno Compound meng-contain sejumlah Cheese. Penjaminan oleh publik diizinkan.

Langkah Containment
Contain di kamar gelap, pastikan jarak pandang lensa benar-benar gelap.

Catatan Eksperimen
Penelitian Lamanya Efek Pembekuan Anomaly Cheese
Eksperimen 1: Orang yang sama difoto Cheese di lingkungan berbeda.
Kesimpulan: Lamanya pembekuan sangat bervariasi.

Eksperimen 2: Orang yang berbeda difoto Cheese di lingkungan yang sama.
Kesimpulan: Lamanya pembekuan sangat bervariasi.

Eksperimen 3: Orang yang sama difoto Cheese yang berbeda di lingkungan yang sama.
Kesimpulan: Lamanya pembekuan sangat bervariasi.
Catatan: Cukup. Aku tidak akan tertipu lagi. Kalian sama sekali bukan melakukan ini untuk penelitian. Kalian cuma mau mencoret-coret wajahku saat aku membeku.

Derivative Anomaly
/

Informasi Lain
/

quote.en: "The old school building you thought you'd never return to appears before you once more."
quote.id: "Gedung sekolah lama yang kamu kira tak akan pernah kamu datangi lagi muncul sekali lagi di hadapanmu."

story.en:
If only the school building could mysteriously vanish, then there would be no need for school to start! Surely many of us had such daydreams during our student days. But… what if this was more than just a daydream?
Many students from Clement Academy's Class of ■■■ still remember that day at the start of the semester. Everyone dragged their reluctant feet to the school gates, only to have their jaws drop at the sight before them: their grand and beautiful school building had vanished without a trace! There was nothing but a massive crater of staggering proportions in its wake… The entirety of Building D, which housed the library, had mysteriously vanished into thin air.
Recently, it was discovered that the mysterious school building connected through the Anomaly known as the Red Door bears a striking resemblance to Building D in its layout and furnishings. According to an Anomaly Hunter who visited the site, he found homework from his childhood in one of the classrooms, half finished and half torn up. This confirms that the space beyond the Red Door is indeed Clement Academy's missing school building. However, the halls no longer echo with the sounds of students reading aloud… Only the gentle sound of dust settling can be heard.
Why did the school building disappear? Why does the Red Door connect our world to this building? These questions remain unsolved mysteries, but one theory seems to have gained widespread acceptance among graduates: the building returned to this world because of our longing and nostalgia for our school days. Despite this, it exists only as a place for reminiscence and visitation, never to be truly used as it once was. No matter how much you wish to stay, you cannot stop the space from gradually crumbling, collapsing, and ultimately vanishing before your eyes. Inevitably, everything dissolves into nothingness once more, as if it never truly existed.
Some say the red color of the Red Door carries strong metaphorical meaning, and that the space beyond the red is the true reality. For details, see the film ■■■■. This theory has no factual basis, and is noted here only for reference.

The blackboard you were too lazy to erase that day. The failed test you deliberately "forgot" in your desk drawer. The little notes filled with the secrets of teenage boys and girls… Do you still remember?


Anomaly Characteristics
· This Anomaly is a door of an unusually bright and vivid red color. It typically appears on a wall composed of common objects such as trash cans, vending machines, and similar fixtures. The objects forming the wall usually depend on the miscellaneous items near the location where it manifests, including but not limited to trash cans, abandoned furniture, manhole covers, and other items.
· The Red Door appears in an open state. The Anomalous Realm connected to the Red Door bears a strong resemblance to the missing Building D of Clement Academy in Hethereau. Some claim this space is Building D itself.
· The specific and location patterns governing the appearance of the Red Door have not yet been determined.

Anomaly Nexus
The Red Door itself. Grasping the door handle allows one to leave the Anomalous Realm.

Risk Assessment
There is minor Surge Anomaly activity within the Anomalous Realm, which exhibits aggression.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Cannot be contained.

Containment Measures
Not in containment.

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

Extended Info
/
story.id:
Andai gedung sekolah bisa lenyap secara misterius, pasti sekolah tak perlu dimulai! Pasti banyak dari kita pernah berkhayal seperti itu semasa sekolah. Tapi… bagaimana kalau ini lebih dari sekadar khayalan?
Banyak siswa Clement Academy Angkatan ■■■ masih ingat hari itu di awal semester. Semua orang menyeret kaki dengan malas ke gerbang sekolah, lalu ternganga melihat pemandangan di depan mereka: gedung sekolah mereka yang megah dan indah lenyap tanpa jejak! Yang tersisa hanyalah kawah raksasa berukuran mencengangkan… Seluruh Gedung D, tempat perpustakaan berada, lenyap begitu saja secara misterius.
Baru-baru ini, ditemukan bahwa gedung sekolah misterius yang terhubung lewat Anomaly bernama Red Door sangat mirip Gedung D dalam tata letak dan perabotannya. Menurut seorang Anomaly Hunter yang mengunjungi lokasi itu, ia menemukan PR masa kecilnya di salah satu ruang kelas, setengah dikerjakan dan setengah sobek. Ini memastikan bahwa ruang di balik Red Door memang gedung sekolah Clement Academy yang hilang. Namun, lorong-lorongnya tak lagi bergema dengan suara siswa membaca nyaring… Yang terdengar hanyalah suara lembut debu yang mengendap.
Kenapa gedung sekolah itu lenyap? Kenapa Red Door menghubungkan dunia kita dengan gedung ini? Pertanyaan-pertanyaan ini masih menjadi misteri, tapi satu teori tampaknya diterima luas di kalangan alumni: gedung itu kembali ke dunia ini karena kerinduan dan nostalgia kita akan masa sekolah. Meski begitu, ia hanya ada sebagai tempat untuk mengenang dan dikunjungi, tak pernah benar-benar dipakai seperti dulu. Seberapa pun kamu ingin tinggal, kamu tak bisa menghentikan ruang itu perlahan runtuh, ambruk, dan akhirnya lenyap di depan matamu. Pada akhirnya, semuanya kembali larut ke ketiadaan, seolah tak pernah benar-benar ada.
Ada yang bilang warna merah Red Door punya makna kiasan yang kuat, dan bahwa ruang di balik warna merah itulah kenyataan yang sesungguhnya. Untuk detailnya, lihat film ■■■■. Teori ini tidak punya dasar fakta, dan dicatat di sini hanya sebagai referensi.

Papan tulis yang malas kamu hapus hari itu. Ulangan gagal yang sengaja kamu "lupakan" di laci meja. Catatan-catatan kecil penuh rahasia anak laki-laki dan perempuan remaja… Masih ingat?


Karakteristik Anomaly
· Anomaly ini berupa pintu berwarna merah yang luar biasa terang dan mencolok. Ia biasanya muncul di dinding yang tersusun dari benda-benda umum seperti tempat sampah, mesin penjual otomatis, dan perlengkapan serupa. Benda-benda pembentuk dinding biasanya tergantung barang-barang di sekitar lokasi kemunculannya, termasuk tapi tidak terbatas pada tempat sampah, furnitur bekas, tutup gorong-gorong, dan barang lainnya.
· Red Door muncul dalam keadaan terbuka. Anomalous Realm yang terhubung dengan Red Door sangat mirip Gedung D Clement Academy di Hethereau yang hilang. Ada yang mengklaim ruang ini adalah Gedung D itu sendiri.
· Pola waktu dan lokasi kemunculan Red Door belum bisa dipastikan.

Anomaly Nexus
Red Door itu sendiri. Menggenggam gagang pintunya memungkinkan seseorang keluar dari Anomalous Realm.

Penilaian Risiko
Ada sedikit aktivitas Surge Anomaly di dalam Anomalous Realm, yang menunjukkan agresivitas.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Tidak bisa di-contain.

Langkah Containment
Tidak di-contain.

Catatan Eksperimen
/

Informasi Lain

quote.en: "A weapon to kill the sea."
quote.id: "Senjata untuk membunuh laut."

story.en:
Some say the harpoon is humanity's weapon of defiance against the sea. It is used to hunt majestic creatures like panicked boars in a common hunting ground. R-1851-1(Ob) Pequod may well be the very embodiment of humanity's will to conquer the sea, encompassing ambition and courage, but also greed and arrogance alike. It appears as a massively oversized version of a common whaling harpoon, covered in bloodstains and rust, lodged in the back of the Anomaly Sea Prisoner. Aside from causing the Sea Prisoner immense pain, no other special properties have been observed.

In earlier times, whaling was a thriving industry driven by commercial demand. Even today, such hunts are still ongoing, though not commonplace. Harpooners were highly respected aboard whaling ships, considering that they were the key to a successful hunt. They would approach beasts a hundred times their size in small boats, drive harpoons into their flesh to draw blood, then begin the long chase, tethered by a simple rope. Some whalers died in this process, claimed by storms, by the thrashing of the great beasts, or perhaps by three too many swigs of rum… But most of the time, the whales lacked the tenacity to outlast the humans. These giants would be hoisted up and dismantled. Useless flesh would be cast into the sea as a feast for scavenger fish, while the blubber was rendered in pots until dry and fed into furnaces as fuel. In the end, only thick oil and white bones remained.
From the accounts of some sailors, we know this "process" left a thick stench of blood and burning on the ship, like the smell of hell itself. It follows that the harpoon must be a weapon from hell, then. The dying songs of those ocean giants were so sorrowful… so profoundly moving… The conflict between the demands of industrial development in the past and the natural world is difficult to judge as right or wrong, but now that we no longer need to sacrifice their flesh as fuel for industry, may these creatures of the sea never again become victims of mere greed and ignorance…

Anomaly Characteristics
· Causes immense pain to the Anomaly Sea Prisoner and provokes its aggression.

Anomaly Nexus
Undergoes nullification together with the Sea Prisoner.

Risk Assessment
Low hazard. However, under its stimulation, the Sea Prisoner exhibits heightened aggression.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Not contained. Guarantee not permitted.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/
