story.en:
At a certain research facility, a containment breach caused the entire facility to go into lockdown. All power and water to the entire facility were completely cut off, and the Anomaly that had breached containment blocked rescue teams from entering. If this continued, the research team inside would suffer significant losses… At that moment, one of the researcher team's doctors picked up an unremarkable crowbar from a toolbox and began his story: First, he pried open the vents. Then he pried open the sealed laboratory doors. Next, he pried open the facility's security passages. And finally, he even pried open the entire realm itself… Heaven knows how he managed that! His heroic actions allowed the rescue team to enter, re-contain the breached Anomaly, and save the research team. Strangely, after this incident, the savior mysteriously vanished! Even more odd, his colleagues forgot what he looked like and what his name was, and the facility's personnel roster showed no record of him ever existing. And it was after his disappearance that the Anomaly "Picky" began to appear…

T-0847(Ob) Picky. Its appearance is that of a plain, unremarkable… crowbar. The kind you could pull out of any toolbox. As an Anomaly, its ability and instinct are to "open." As long as Picky exists, it will continuously attempt to pry open anything "locked" around it, whether it be a suitcase, a safe, or an Anomaly containment unit. Given enough leverage, it can pry open anything. When someone witnesses it opening objects around it, it becomes extremely aggressive and begins attacking the witness, though its strength is no different from an ordinary crowbar. Getting hit will hurt, but it is not lethal. Defeat Picky and stop it from continuing to open objects around it, and Picky will undergo nullification.

I would rather believe that this "Dr. Freeman" was merely a product of collective imagination. After all, how could anyone possibly break through an entire realm with just a crowbar? But scattered records confirm that this actually happened, and the legendary crowbar in the legendary doctor's hands carved out a path to survival for the research team. Picky, however, does not care about the meaning behind actions. It only retains that sense of urgency and obsession with opening things.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as a metal crowbar partially painted red, floating at approximately one meter above the ground.
· This Anomaly will continuously "open" any "locked" objects within a certain range.
· After its "opening" behavior is witnessed, this Anomaly will attack the witness. Its strength is no different from an ordinary crowbar.

Anomaly Nexus
After witnessing this Anomaly's "opening" behavior, defeat it to stop its intent to "open."

Risk Assessment
Low hazard.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Private guarantee not permitted. A small number are contained within the Celaeno Compound.

Containment Measures
Contain it together with locked objects. The Celaeno Compound has prepared a "self-locking device" for containing Picky, which automatically returns to a locked state a period after being opened. Note: This device must be kept fully powered at all times, otherwise it may trigger a chain containment breach!

Experiment Records
Experiment on the Performance of Anomaly Picky
Experiment 1: Picky was placed together with a cardboard box, a simple combination lock, and a vault safe, respectively.
Conclusion: There was a significant difference in the time Picky took to open different objects. The more complex the locking mechanism, the longer it took to open.

Experiment 2: Picky was contained in a standard containment unit.
Conclusion: Picky opened the containment unit on its own after approximately 15 hours, and caused structural damage to the containment unit.

Experiment 3: Picky was contained in a standard containment unit along with a self-locking device.
Conclusion: The required time to open the self-locking device is longer than its self-locking interval. This containment measure is effective.

Derivative Anomaly
/
story.id:
Di sebuah fasilitas penelitian, sebuah Anomaly lepas dari Containment dan membuat seluruh fasilitas dikunci. Semua listrik dan air ke seluruh fasilitas terputus total, dan Anomaly yang lepas itu menghalangi tim penyelamat masuk. Jika terus begini, tim peneliti di dalam akan menderita kerugian besar… Saat itu, salah satu dokter tim peneliti mengambil sebuah linggis biasa dari kotak perkakas dan memulai kisahnya: pertama, ia mencongkel lubang ventilasi. Lalu ia mencongkel pintu laboratorium yang tersegel. Berikutnya, ia mencongkel lorong keamanan fasilitas. Dan akhirnya, ia bahkan mencongkel seluruh ranah itu sendiri… Entah bagaimana caranya! Aksi heroiknya memungkinkan tim penyelamat masuk, meng-contain kembali Anomaly yang lepas, dan menyelamatkan tim peneliti. Anehnya, setelah insiden ini, sang penyelamat menghilang secara misterius! Lebih aneh lagi, rekan-rekannya lupa wajah dan namanya, dan daftar personel fasilitas tidak menunjukkan catatan bahwa ia pernah ada. Dan setelah ia menghilang, Anomaly "Picky" mulai muncul…

T-0847(Ob) Picky. Penampilannya berupa… linggis biasa yang tidak istimewa. Jenis yang bisa kamu temukan di kotak perkakas mana pun. Sebagai Anomaly, kemampuan dan nalurinya adalah "membuka". Selama Picky ada, ia akan terus berusaha mencongkel apa pun yang "terkunci" di sekitarnya, entah koper, brankas, atau unit Containment Anomaly. Dengan tumpuan yang cukup, ia bisa mencongkel apa saja. Saat seseorang melihatnya membuka benda di sekitarnya, ia menjadi sangat agresif dan mulai menyerang saksi itu, meski kekuatannya tak berbeda dari linggis biasa. Dipukul memang sakit, tapi tidak mematikan. Kalahkan Picky dan hentikan ia membuka benda-benda di sekitarnya, maka Picky akan ter-nullify.

Aku lebih suka percaya bahwa "Dr. Freeman" ini hanyalah hasil imajinasi kolektif. Lagi pula, bagaimana mungkin seseorang menembus seluruh ranah hanya dengan sebatang linggis? Tapi catatan yang tersebar membenarkan bahwa hal ini benar-benar terjadi, dan linggis legendaris di tangan sang dokter legendaris membuka jalan selamat bagi tim peneliti. Namun, Picky tidak peduli makna di balik tindakan. Ia hanya mempertahankan rasa mendesak dan obsesi untuk membuka sesuatu.

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Berwujud linggis logam yang sebagian dicat merah, melayang sekitar satu meter di atas tanah.
· Anomaly ini akan terus "membuka" benda "terkunci" apa pun dalam jangkauan tertentu.
· Setelah perilaku "membuka"-nya disaksikan, Anomaly ini akan menyerang saksinya. Kekuatannya tak berbeda dari linggis biasa.

Anomaly Nexus
Setelah menyaksikan perilaku "membuka" Anomaly ini, kalahkan ia untuk menghentikan niatnya "membuka".

Penilaian Risiko
Bahaya rendah.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Penjaminan pribadi tidak diizinkan. Sejumlah kecil di-contain di Celaeno Compound.

Langkah Containment
Contain bersama benda-benda terkunci. Celaeno Compound sudah menyiapkan "alat pengunci otomatis" untuk meng-contain Picky, yang otomatis kembali terkunci beberapa saat setelah dibuka. Catatan: Alat ini harus selalu dialiri daya penuh, kalau tidak bisa memicu lepasnya Containment beruntun!

Catatan Eksperimen
Eksperimen Kinerja Anomaly Picky
Eksperimen 1: Picky diletakkan bersama kardus, gembok kombinasi sederhana, dan brankas, secara bergantian.
Kesimpulan: Ada perbedaan signifikan dalam waktu yang dibutuhkan Picky untuk membuka benda yang berbeda. Semakin rumit mekanisme kuncinya, semakin lama waktu membukanya.

Eksperimen 2: Picky di-contain di unit Containment standar.
Kesimpulan: Picky membuka unit Containment dengan sendirinya setelah sekitar 15 jam, dan menyebabkan kerusakan struktural pada unit Containment tersebut.

Eksperimen 3: Picky di-contain di unit Containment standar bersama alat pengunci otomatis.
Kesimpulan: Waktu yang dibutuhkan untuk membuka alat pengunci otomatis lebih lama dari interval penguncian otomatisnya. Langkah Containment ini efektif.

Derivative Anomaly
/

quote.en: "Home is the source of our strength."
quote.id: "Rumah adalah sumber kekuatan kita."

story.en:
Long, long ago, a count signed a contract with the devil, gaining all the world's riches and glory, and in exchange becoming a vampire who sustained eternal youth by drinking human blood. As the price, he could never leave his own domain. The count soon grew weary of the familiar flora and fauna, birds and beasts, fish and insects on his land. Even the blood offered by his trembling subjects became difficult to swallow down. He devised a solution: using soil from his domain, he crafted a perfect miniature castle model, then used magic to shrink himself down and live inside it. This way, as long as he carried his "castle" with him, he could venture anywhere beyond the walls he had long been confined to. Four hundred years later, he chanced upon a beautiful lady…
These Legendary tales are of course fabricated by later generations, but the castle at the root of this legend, the "Hospitable House," does exist. Records and legends about the "Hospitable House" date back centuries. Very few Anomalies can persist across such a long span of time without undergoing nullification. The origins of the "Hospitable House" can no longer be traced. It has continuously changed hands among collectors, and currently belongs to the collection of the antique shop "Eibon."

The Hospitable House appears to be a miniature castle model. Its interior is exquisitely decorated with complete sets of furniture. Setting aside its size, it is practically a fully livable castle. The appearance and decor of the Hospitable House change slightly with the times, making it impossible to deduce its era of origin from its architectural design or interior decoration style. Today's Hospitable House has complete water, electricity, and lighting facilities for "guests" who enter to use freely. How these facilities operate without any actual utility connections remains an unsolved mystery.
After opening the door to the Hospitable House, humans within a certain range (as well as certain Oddities) are recognized as "guests" by the Hospitable House. "Guests" are shrunk to a size matching the Hospitable House and can temporarily enter for a tour. During this process, the guests' personal items are also shrunk along with them and continue to function normally. The shrinking effect lasts for 7 minutes, after which "guests" are teleported outside the Hospitable House and restored to their original size. Opening the door again allows another tour, but each visit is limited to 7 minutes. This has caused no end of frustration for directors hoping to use the Hospitable House's interior for filming.
The shrinking limit does not apply to those the Hospitable House recognizes as "masters" or "enemies." These individuals do not automatically return to normal size after shrinking, and only the "master" knows how to restore them. The Hospitable House is as sturdy as a real castle, allowing this otherwise harmless Anomaly to protect its "master" or trap "enemies" when necessary. Once, a thief accidentally touched the door of the Hospitable House and remained shrunk for an entire night. Only after swearing to the Hospitable House's "master" that he would turn over a new leaf, he was restored to his original size.

The Hospitable House's long existence without nullification has piqued the curiosity of some scholars: what is its Nexus? One theory, drawing from the legend, suggests that the Hospitable House's Nexus is its "homeland," the place where it was first born. Though unverifiable, the Hospitable House's "homeland" is likely a settlement that still exists. Until that place is destroyed, the Hospitable House will continue to exist. This also explains why the Hospitable House's decor and facilities keep up with the times. The development of its homeland is reflected in the Hospitable House, and it delights in showing visitors the progress of its hometown.
This theory has not been confirmed, but in this writer's opinion, it is quite romantic. For an Anomaly with many legends that is safe and harmless, maintaining its mystique and leaving room for imagination may be the best outcome.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as an exquisite miniature castle model.
· After opening the door to the Hospitable House, humans within a certain range (as well as certain Oddities) are recognized as "guests" by the Hospitable House and shrunk to a size that allows them to tour the castle.
· The shrinking effect lasts for 7 minutes. Playing the pipe organ inside the Hospitable House can end the tour early and restore visitors to their original size.
· The 7-minute time limit does not apply to those the Hospitable House recognizes as "masters" or "enemies." Only the "master" of the Hospitable House knows how to restore them.

Anomaly Nexus
Unknown

Risk Assessment
Harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Given that the Hospitable House does not move on its own and poses no danger, it was decided after evaluation not to contain it. Currently part of the Eibon Antique Shop Collection.

Containment Measures
No special containment measures required.

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/
story.id:
Dahulu kala, seorang bangsawan menandatangani kontrak dengan iblis, mendapatkan seluruh kekayaan dan kejayaan dunia, dan sebagai gantinya menjadi vampir yang menjaga awet mudanya dengan meminum darah manusia. Sebagai harganya, ia tak pernah bisa meninggalkan wilayahnya sendiri. Sang bangsawan segera bosan dengan tumbuhan, satwa, burung, binatang buas, ikan, dan serangga yang sudah akrab di tanahnya. Bahkan darah yang dipersembahkan rakyatnya yang gemetar pun sulit ia telan. Ia menemukan jalan keluar: dengan tanah dari wilayahnya, ia membuat miniatur kastel yang sempurna, lalu memakai sihir untuk mengecilkan dirinya dan tinggal di dalamnya. Dengan begitu, selama ia membawa "kastel"-nya, ia bisa pergi ke mana saja melewati tembok yang sudah lama mengurungnya. Empat ratus tahun kemudian, ia bertemu seorang wanita cantik…
Kisah-kisah legendaris ini tentu dikarang generasi berikutnya, tapi kastel yang menjadi akar legenda ini, "Hospitable House", memang ada. Catatan dan legenda tentang "Hospitable House" sudah ada sejak berabad-abad lalu. Sangat sedikit Anomaly yang bisa bertahan selama itu tanpa ter-nullify. Asal-usul "Hospitable House" tak lagi bisa dilacak. Ia terus berpindah tangan di antara para kolektor, dan kini menjadi bagian koleksi toko antik "Eibon".

Hospitable House berwujud miniatur kastel. Bagian dalamnya dihias dengan indah dan berisi satu set furnitur lengkap. Kalau ukurannya diabaikan, ia praktis kastel yang benar-benar bisa ditinggali. Penampilan dan dekorasi Hospitable House sedikit berubah mengikuti zaman, sehingga mustahil menebak era asalnya dari desain arsitektur atau gaya dekorasi interiornya. Hospitable House masa kini punya fasilitas air, listrik, dan penerangan lengkap yang bebas dipakai "tamu" yang masuk. Bagaimana fasilitas ini bekerja tanpa sambungan utilitas sungguhan masih menjadi misteri.
Setelah pintu Hospitable House dibuka, manusia dalam jangkauan tertentu (juga Oddity tertentu) dikenali sebagai "tamu" oleh Hospitable House. "Tamu" dikecilkan seukuran Hospitable House dan bisa masuk sementara untuk berkeliling. Selama proses ini, barang pribadi tamu ikut mengecil dan tetap berfungsi normal. Efek pengecilan bertahan selama 7 menit, setelah itu "tamu" diteleportasi ke luar Hospitable House dan kembali ke ukuran semula. Membuka pintu lagi memungkinkan berkeliling lagi, tapi setiap kunjungan dibatasi 7 menit. Ini membuat frustrasi para sutradara yang ingin memakai interior Hospitable House untuk syuting.
Batasan pengecilan ini tidak berlaku bagi mereka yang dikenali Hospitable House sebagai "tuan" atau "musuh". Orang-orang ini tidak otomatis kembali ke ukuran normal setelah dikecilkan, dan hanya "tuan" yang tahu cara mengembalikan mereka. Hospitable House sekokoh kastel sungguhan, sehingga Anomaly yang sebenarnya tidak berbahaya ini bisa melindungi "tuan"-nya atau menjebak "musuh" saat diperlukan. Pernah seorang pencuri tak sengaja menyentuh pintu Hospitable House dan tetap mengecil semalaman. Baru setelah bersumpah kepada "tuan" Hospitable House bahwa ia akan bertobat, ia dikembalikan ke ukuran semula.

Keberadaan Hospitable House yang begitu lama tanpa Nullification membuat beberapa akademisi penasaran: apa Nexus-nya? Salah satu teori, yang mengambil dari legenda, menyebut bahwa Nexus Hospitable House adalah "kampung halaman"-nya, tempat ia pertama kali lahir. Meski tak bisa dibuktikan, "kampung halaman" Hospitable House kemungkinan adalah permukiman yang masih ada. Selama tempat itu belum hancur, Hospitable House akan terus ada. Ini juga menjelaskan kenapa dekorasi dan fasilitas Hospitable House selalu mengikuti zaman. Perkembangan kampung halamannya tercermin di Hospitable House, dan ia senang memamerkan kemajuan kampung halamannya kepada pengunjung.
Teori ini belum terbukti, tapi menurut penulis, cukup romantis. Untuk Anomaly dengan banyak legenda yang aman dan tidak berbahaya, menjaga misterinya dan menyisakan ruang untuk imajinasi mungkin adalah hasil terbaik.

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Berwujud miniatur kastel yang indah.
· Setelah pintu Hospitable House dibuka, manusia dalam jangkauan tertentu (juga Oddity tertentu) dikenali sebagai "tamu" oleh Hospitable House dan dikecilkan ke ukuran yang memungkinkan mereka berkeliling kastel.
· Efek pengecilan bertahan 7 menit. Memainkan organ pipa di dalam Hospitable House bisa mengakhiri kunjungan lebih awal dan mengembalikan pengunjung ke ukuran semula.
· Batas waktu 7 menit tidak berlaku bagi mereka yang dikenali Hospitable House sebagai "tuan" atau "musuh". Hanya "tuan" Hospitable House yang tahu cara mengembalikan mereka.

Anomaly Nexus
Tidak diketahui

Penilaian Risiko
Tidak berbahaya.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Karena Hospitable House tidak bergerak sendiri dan tidak berbahaya, setelah dinilai diputuskan untuk tidak di-contain. Saat ini menjadi bagian Koleksi Eibon Antique Shop.

Langkah Containment
Tidak perlu langkah Containment khusus.

Catatan Eksperimen
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

quote.en: "Right here… the Ghost of art."
quote.id: "Di sini… hantu seni."

story.en:
T-1881(Ob) Scarlet Phantom is an Anomaly that occasionally appears in performance venues such as concert halls, theaters, or cinemas. It takes the form of evening gowns in black and white, with female and male styles appearing in pairs. Though no one wears them, they float in midair, dancing gracefully together. Since Scarlet Phantoms are drawn to grand performances and naturally undergo nullification when the performance ends, they are often considered harmless. However, any attempt to disrupt the performance or stop the Scarlet Phantom's dance will provoke retaliation. When attacking, the Anomaly transforms dance steps into attacks. Though not particularly threatening to experienced Anomaly Hunters, Scarlet Phantoms often appear in groups, which significantly increases their danger level.
Some artists consider the appearance of Scarlet Phantoms a sign of success. This notion is not entirely wrong, as these entities are actually quite picky about their tastes. However, given the danger they pose to ordinary people, it would be best to notify the Bureau of Anomaly Control as soon as they are spotted, wouldn't it?

Anomaly Characteristics
· Drawn to grand performances; Attacks anyone who attempts to stop the performance using their dance.

Anomaly Nexus
The performance that drew them ends, or their dance disrupted by external force.

Risk Assessment
Low hazard. When appearing in groups, hazard level may increase to moderate.

Containment/Guarantee Status
A small number are contained at the Celaeno Compound.

Containment Measures
The containment unit should provide sufficient space for dancing. Since this Anomaly naturally undergoes nullification when the performance that attracted them ends, a large screen continuously playing classic performances that have previously attracted Scarlet Phantoms is sufficient. The playlist should be updated according to their appearance records.

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/
story.id:
T-1881(Ob) Scarlet Phantom adalah Anomaly yang sesekali muncul di tempat pertunjukan seperti gedung konser, teater, atau bioskop. Wujudnya gaun malam hitam dan putih, dengan model wanita dan pria yang selalu muncul berpasangan. Meski tak ada yang memakainya, mereka melayang di udara, berdansa bersama dengan anggun. Karena Scarlet Phantom tertarik pada pertunjukan megah dan ter-nullify secara alami saat pertunjukan berakhir, mereka sering dianggap tidak berbahaya. Namun, setiap upaya mengganggu pertunjukan atau menghentikan dansa Scarlet Phantom akan memancing pembalasan. Saat menyerang, Anomaly ini mengubah langkah dansa menjadi serangan. Meski tidak terlalu mengancam bagi Anomaly Hunter berpengalaman, Scarlet Phantom sering muncul berkelompok, yang sangat meningkatkan tingkat bahayanya.
Sebagian seniman menganggap kemunculan Scarlet Phantom sebagai tanda kesuksesan. Anggapan ini tidak sepenuhnya salah, karena makhluk-makhluk ini sebenarnya cukup pemilih soal selera. Namun, mengingat bahayanya bagi orang biasa, sebaiknya segera beri tahu Bureau of Anomaly Control begitu mereka terlihat, bukan?

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Tertarik pada pertunjukan megah; menyerang siapa pun yang mencoba menghentikan pertunjukan dengan dansa mereka.

Anomaly Nexus
Pertunjukan yang menarik mereka berakhir, atau dansa mereka terganggu kekuatan dari luar.

Penilaian Risiko
Bahaya rendah. Saat muncul berkelompok, tingkat bahaya bisa naik menjadi sedang.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Sejumlah kecil di-contain di Celaeno Compound.

Langkah Containment
Unit Containment harus menyediakan ruang yang cukup untuk berdansa. Karena Anomaly ini ter-nullify secara alami saat pertunjukan yang menarik mereka berakhir, layar besar yang terus memutar pertunjukan klasik yang pernah menarik Scarlet Phantom sudah cukup. Daftar putarnya harus diperbarui sesuai catatan kemunculan mereka.

Catatan Eksperimen
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

quote.en:
An opened package of "film" with strips extending and drifting like tentacles around the core.
This anomaly's main abilities are freeze and replay. The first ability turns photographed objects into pictures, as well as weakens the humans it photographs and pulls them into a Space Anomaly. The second ability allows scenes, objects, oddities, and even characters Film - MANISH photographed to reappear as duplicates within its Space Anomaly. For more details about its characteristics, see Appendix 1.

Back in the days of film photography, film was popular due to its unique textures and color tones. However, the skills involved were not something just anyone could master. From shutter speed, mixing reagents, developing and fixing, to the final post-processing touches, one's skill level was evident at every stage. When it comes to film photography, one cannot overlook the darkroom that blocks out light, protects film rolls, and facilitates developing and processing.
At Film Orbit Studio was a mysterious dim room stacked with bottles and jars containing unknown reagents, reminiscent of witchcraft and alchemy. In the early days of the studio, film photography was still mainstream, and the owner attracted the first group of customers through excellent film photography skills. But digital photography soon began disrupting the market. Portable, user-friendly, and forgiving, digital cameras quickly replaced film cameras as the new standard. Pressure from increased customer traffic, progression in editing software, along with considerations of labor costs and technical challenges, Film Orbit Studio was compelled to completely shift to digital. One particular film roll, not yet an anomaly at that time, was placed in a corner of the warehouse, never to see the light of day. The darkroom was also abandoned. Days turned to months, months turned to years, but no one ever remembered the film roll.
The film roll did not want to be forgotten. It did not want the light, shadow, and colors it had captured to gather dust. At some point, the film roll became Film - MANISH, which continued to fulfill its mission as a photography equipment, displaying everything it captured in the most uninhibited manner, until its eventual nullification.
…However, after nullification, the owner used film photography techniques for another set of photos, which were given to the anomaly hunter responsible for resolving the incident. Some would say the film roll's wish came true. In the end, this case highlights how civilization thrives by welcoming the future and bidding farewell to the past.

Characteristics
Appendix 1: Detailed Report on the Characteristics of Anomaly R-5791Ob
This anomaly's main abilities are freeze and replay. Before encountering its main body, there are no obvious patterns for these abilities.
When using freeze, a camera lens appears behind the target and lets out a countdown sound before shooting. When the countdown ends, objects within the camera's range will be frozen and become photographs. After a period of time, humans regain mobility, though they will feel sick and weak. Consecutive freezing may cause irreversible harm. It's easy to avoid being frozen: stay out of the camera's range before the countdown ends.
Film - MANISH's second ability allows it to replay things previously photographed by film cameras within its influence, including those recorded by its own freeze ability. This second ability can replay scenes, often creating bizarre spaces. In some cases, these spaces appear as properly colored positives, while in others, they appear as negatives with colors inverted from reality. Sometimes, creatures frozen by this anomaly are dragged into an Anomalous Space, which also greatly increases the difficulty of locating the anomaly's main body. Within the space replayed by Film - MANISH comes with aggressive surge oddities, possibly from previously recorded images. One must be aware of such oddities when the scene suddenly changes.
After approaching Film - MANISH's main body, the anomaly will protect itself by ramming, slamming, and whipping enemies with film strips, as well as use its replay ability to unleash items it captured before. At this stage, Film - MANISH will also replay previously frozen humans to assist it. However, this method has limitations: while duplicates are present, Film - MANISH's main body cannot move. After duplicates are defeated, the anomaly's main body also enters a weakened state.
Film - MANISH's range of influence is limited to the photo studio. When common people encounter this anomaly, they can stay safe by refraining from provocation, and watch out for camera lenses that appear randomly, as well as leave the affected area as soon as they can.

Anomaly Nexus
Conquer everything it recorded—enter the Anomalous Space it forms and defeat it.

Risk Assessment
Hazardous but controllable. Studios with long-term unused film photography equipment should receive security training and follow additional anomaly response guidelines.

Containment/Guarantee Status
/

Containment
/

Experiment Record
/

Derivative Anomaly
/
quote.id:
Sebuah paket "film" yang terbuka, dengan pita-pita yang terjulur dan melayang seperti tentakel di sekitar intinya.
Kemampuan utama Anomaly ini adalah membekukan dan memutar ulang. Kemampuan pertama mengubah objek yang dipotret menjadi gambar, sekaligus melemahkan manusia yang dipotretnya dan menarik mereka ke Space Anomaly. Kemampuan kedua membuat pemandangan, objek, Oddity, bahkan karakter yang pernah dipotret Film - MANISH muncul kembali sebagai duplikat di dalam Space Anomaly-nya. Untuk detail karakteristiknya, lihat Lampiran 1.

Di masa fotografi film, film populer karena tekstur dan nada warnanya yang unik. Namun, keterampilannya tidak bisa dikuasai sembarang orang. Mulai dari kecepatan rana, mencampur bahan kimia, mencuci dan memfiksasi, hingga sentuhan akhir, tingkat keahlian seseorang terlihat di setiap tahap. Bicara soal fotografi film, tak bisa melewatkan kamar gelap yang menghalangi cahaya, melindungi gulungan film, dan memudahkan proses pencucian.
Di Film Orbit Studio ada sebuah ruangan remang misterius yang dipenuhi botol dan stoples berisi bahan kimia tak dikenal, mengingatkan pada ilmu sihir dan alkimia. Di masa awal studio itu, fotografi film masih menjadi arus utama, dan pemiliknya menarik pelanggan pertama berkat keahlian fotografi filmnya yang luar biasa. Namun, fotografi digital segera mengguncang pasar. Praktis, mudah dipakai, dan memaafkan kesalahan, kamera digital dengan cepat menggantikan kamera film sebagai standar baru. Karena tekanan dari bertambahnya pelanggan, kemajuan perangkat lunak penyuntingan, serta pertimbangan biaya tenaga kerja dan tantangan teknis, Film Orbit Studio terpaksa beralih sepenuhnya ke digital. Satu gulungan film, yang saat itu belum menjadi Anomaly, diletakkan di sudut gudang dan tak pernah lagi melihat cahaya. Kamar gelap pun ditinggalkan. Hari berganti bulan, bulan berganti tahun, tapi tak seorang pun ingat gulungan film itu.
Gulungan film itu tidak ingin dilupakan. Ia tidak ingin cahaya, bayangan, dan warna yang pernah ia tangkap berdebu. Pada suatu saat, gulungan film itu menjadi Film - MANISH, yang terus menjalankan misinya sebagai alat fotografi, menampilkan semua yang ia tangkap dengan cara paling bebas, sampai akhirnya ter-nullify.
…Namun, setelah Nullification, sang pemilik memakai teknik fotografi film untuk membuat satu set foto lagi, yang diberikan kepada Anomaly Hunter yang menyelesaikan insiden tersebut. Ada yang bilang keinginan gulungan film itu akhirnya terkabul. Pada akhirnya, kasus ini menunjukkan bagaimana peradaban berkembang dengan menyambut masa depan dan mengucapkan selamat tinggal pada masa lalu.

Karakteristik
Lampiran 1: Laporan Rinci Karakteristik Anomaly R-5791Ob
Kemampuan utama Anomaly ini adalah membekukan dan memutar ulang. Sebelum bertemu tubuh utamanya, kemampuan ini tidak punya pola yang jelas.
Saat memakai kemampuan membekukan, lensa kamera muncul di belakang target dan mengeluarkan suara hitung mundur sebelum memotret. Saat hitung mundur selesai, objek dalam jangkauan kamera akan membeku dan menjadi foto. Setelah beberapa waktu, manusia bisa bergerak lagi, meski akan merasa mual dan lemas. Dibekukan berturut-turut bisa menyebabkan cedera permanen. Menghindari pembekuan itu mudah: keluarlah dari jangkauan kamera sebelum hitung mundur selesai.
Kemampuan kedua Film - MANISH memungkinkannya memutar ulang hal-hal yang pernah dipotret kamera film dalam jangkauan pengaruhnya, termasuk yang direkam lewat kemampuan membekukannya sendiri. Kemampuan kedua ini bisa memutar ulang pemandangan, sering kali menciptakan ruang-ruang yang ganjil. Dalam beberapa kasus, ruang ini tampil sebagai positif dengan warna normal, sementara dalam kasus lain tampil sebagai negatif dengan warna terbalik dari kenyataan. Terkadang, makhluk yang dibekukan Anomaly ini diseret ke Anomalous Space, yang juga sangat mempersulit pencarian tubuh utama Anomaly. Di dalam ruang yang diputar ulang Film - MANISH muncul surge Oddity yang agresif, kemungkinan dari gambar yang pernah direkam. Waspadai Oddity semacam ini saat pemandangan tiba-tiba berubah.
Setelah mendekati tubuh utama Film - MANISH, Anomaly ini akan melindungi diri dengan menyeruduk, membanting, dan mencambuk musuh dengan pita film, serta memakai kemampuan memutar ulang untuk mengeluarkan benda-benda yang pernah ia tangkap. Di tahap ini, Film - MANISH juga akan memutar ulang manusia yang pernah dibekukan untuk membantunya. Namun, cara ini ada batasnya: selama duplikat masih ada, tubuh utama Film - MANISH tidak bisa bergerak. Setelah duplikat dikalahkan, tubuh utama Anomaly juga masuk ke kondisi lemah.
Jangkauan pengaruh Film - MANISH terbatas pada studio foto. Saat orang biasa bertemu Anomaly ini, mereka bisa tetap aman dengan tidak memprovokasinya, mewaspadai lensa kamera yang muncul secara acak, dan segera meninggalkan area yang terdampak.

Anomaly Nexus
Taklukkan semua yang pernah direkamnya: masuk ke Anomalous Space yang ia bentuk dan kalahkan ia.

Penilaian Risiko
Berbahaya tapi bisa dikendalikan. Studio yang punya peralatan fotografi film yang lama tidak terpakai sebaiknya mendapat pelatihan keamanan dan mengikuti panduan penanganan Anomaly tambahan.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
/

Containment
/

Catatan Eksperimen

Derivative Anomaly

quote.en: "Lights out."
quote.id: "Lampu padam."

story.en:
The story begins in an abandoned ancient castle. No one knows its exact history anymore, but residents of the nearby villages all agree that the castle was "haunted." Light sources in the hands of anyone who entered would unnaturally extinguish, and those who remained in the castle's darkness for too long would be taken away by ghosts, never to return. This rumor spread among niche paranormal enthusiasts, and a group of curious young people gathered together to explore the castle, only to vanish without a trace… Their parents hired an Anomaly Hunter skilled at operating in darkness to search the castle for the missing persons, but in the end, that Anomaly Hunter never located the missing people. They only retrieved the culprit behind everything: a lamp.

Anomaly U-2016(Ob) is a lamp we call "After Lights Out." Its craftsmanship bears traces of different eras. It has no power cord, yet it can still be switched on. When illuminated, it appears no different from a common lamp. However, after being lit for a period, it gradually begins to flicker and eventually goes out. Afterward, within a certain radius centered on it, all light sources gradually extinguish, forming an unnatural "dark zone." Such a zone is its Anomalous Realm, within which, the brightness of all light sources is severely limited and will extinguish after a short time. From outside the dark zone, it is nearly impossible to see what is happening inside. After entering the dark zone, a person will unknowingly transform into a blurry "Shadow" creature. Only by relighting After Lights Out can the surroundings return to brightness and the Shadows be restored to their original human forms. However, if someone remains in Shadow form within the dark zone for too long, when the lamp is relit and the dark zone disappears, the Shadow will disappear along with it… Those poor souls are forever lost in the realm of Shadows.

Fear of the dark is instinctive, as is curiosity about the unknown. Whether to prove we are fearless or to discover what truly hides in the darkness, we are always driven by instinct to step into the dark. After Lights Out is like an anglerfish with an extinguished lure, lying in wait for the next batch of curious explorers…

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as a Common lamp.
· After extinguishing, the surroundings are gradually devoured by darkness, and light sources within range go out one by one.
· People in the dark zone transform into Shadows, only being restored after After Lights Out is relit. Those who remain in Shadow form for too long may be unable to recover.

Anomaly Nexus
Light the lamp. This is not a permanent nullification method; it can only eliminate its effects. However, unless Ebisu agrees, we cannot forcibly nullify it.

Risk Assessment
Moderate hazard.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Guaranteed by the Ebisu Auction House.

Containment Measures
Maintain surveillance on this Anomaly. When it begins to flicker, immediately pull the switch to relight it.

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/
story.id:
Kisahnya dimulai di sebuah kastel kuno yang terbengkalai. Tak ada lagi yang tahu sejarah pastinya, tapi warga desa-desa di sekitarnya sepakat bahwa kastel itu "berhantu". Sumber cahaya di tangan siapa pun yang masuk akan padam secara tidak wajar, dan mereka yang terlalu lama berada di kegelapan kastel akan dibawa pergi hantu, tak pernah kembali. Rumor ini menyebar di kalangan penggemar paranormal, dan sekelompok anak muda yang penasaran berkumpul untuk menjelajahi kastel itu, lalu lenyap tanpa jejak… Orang tua mereka menyewa Anomaly Hunter yang mahir beroperasi dalam gelap untuk mencari orang-orang hilang itu di kastel, tapi pada akhirnya, Anomaly Hunter itu tak pernah menemukan mereka. Ia hanya membawa pulang dalang di balik semuanya: sebuah lampu.

Anomaly U-2016(Ob) adalah lampu yang kami sebut "After Lights Out". Pengerjaannya menunjukkan jejak berbagai zaman. Ia tidak punya kabel listrik, tapi tetap bisa dinyalakan. Saat menyala, ia tampak tak berbeda dari lampu biasa. Namun, setelah menyala beberapa lama, ia perlahan mulai berkedip lalu padam. Setelah itu, dalam radius tertentu dengan lampu itu sebagai pusatnya, semua sumber cahaya perlahan padam, membentuk "zona gelap" yang tidak wajar. Zona inilah Anomalous Realm-nya, di mana terang semua sumber cahaya sangat terbatas dan akan padam setelah sebentar. Dari luar zona gelap, nyaris mustahil melihat apa yang terjadi di dalamnya. Setelah memasuki zona gelap, seseorang tanpa sadar akan berubah menjadi makhluk "Shadow" yang samar. Hanya dengan menyalakan kembali After Lights Out sekelilingnya bisa kembali terang dan para Shadow kembali ke wujud manusianya. Namun, jika seseorang terlalu lama dalam wujud Shadow di zona gelap, saat lampu dinyalakan kembali dan zona gelap menghilang, Shadow itu akan ikut lenyap… Jiwa-jiwa malang itu hilang selamanya di alam Shadow.

Takut gelap adalah naluri, begitu pula rasa penasaran pada hal yang tak diketahui. Entah untuk membuktikan diri tak kenal takut atau untuk mencari tahu apa yang sebenarnya bersembunyi dalam kegelapan, kita selalu terdorong naluri untuk melangkah ke dalam gelap. After Lights Out bagaikan ikan anglerfish dengan umpan cahaya yang padam, menunggu rombongan penjelajah penasaran berikutnya…

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Berwujud lampu biasa.
· Setelah padam, sekitarnya perlahan ditelan kegelapan, dan sumber cahaya dalam jangkauannya padam satu per satu.
· Orang di zona gelap berubah menjadi Shadow, dan baru pulih setelah After Lights Out dinyalakan kembali. Mereka yang terlalu lama dalam wujud Shadow mungkin tak bisa pulih.

Anomaly Nexus
Nyalakan lampunya. Ini bukan cara Nullification permanen; hanya bisa menghilangkan efeknya. Namun, kecuali Ebisu setuju, kami tidak bisa me-nullify-nya secara paksa.

Penilaian Risiko
Bahaya sedang.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Dijamin oleh Ebisu Auction House.

Langkah Containment
Terus awasi Anomaly ini. Saat mulai berkedip, segera tarik sakelarnya untuk menyalakannya kembali.

Catatan Eksperimen
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

quote.en: "Revenge, revenge… Teehee hee!!!"
quote.id: "Balas dendam, balas dendam… Hihihi!!!"

story.en:
The childhood companion Anomaly "Huggy Bear" could not accept the fact that its child had grown up and no longer needed it… or worse, had forgotten about it. Instead of naturally fading away through nullification, it transformed into a more dangerous and cunning Anomaly: the "Teehee Bear."
As a branching Anomaly derived from "Huggy Bear," the "Teehee Bear" is considerably rarer.
These anomalies believe that an abandoned and forgotten bear is a coward if it does not seek revenge! After all, those little brats say things like "I love you the most!" but after a period, they just toss whatever they have to the wayside… No matter how innocent or pitiful it looks, it will never receive another glance from its former "companion." As such, the Teehee Bear will use every means necessary to make those hateful children taste the terror of being utterly alone. Whatever the children love, it becomes to lure them in. Whatever the children fear, it makes them witness… Truly terrifying.

Anomaly Characteristics
Unlike "Saddy Teddy," another branching Anomaly of "Huggy Bear" that hates all adults, the Teehee Bear hates all children. They appear as plush toy Oddities that easily win children's affection, leading them astray and even destroying them.
Childhood companion anomalies that transform into this branch are extremely difficult to deal with. They excel at appearing harmless and endearing. Each one tailors its appearance to the specific child it targets, making it often impossible to identify the Anomaly's true name.
It possesses three forms:
(1) A cute appearance used for deception (appears different to each child)
(2) A harmless version seen by adults (a teddy bear plush)
(3) An evil version revealing its true nature (the malevolent core that tears through the plush exterior, a chaotic Anomaly fusing different species)

Anomaly Nexus
Find the child who originally forgot or abandoned it, and have the child apologize to the Teehee Bear.

Risk Assessment
Hazard level is uncontrollable. Nullification should be carried out as soon as possible upon discovery.

Containment/Guarantee Status
No Containment method has been discovered. Cannot be guaranteed.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/
story.id:
Anomaly teman masa kecil "Huggy Bear" tak bisa menerima kenyataan bahwa anaknya sudah dewasa dan tak lagi membutuhkannya… atau lebih buruk lagi, sudah melupakannya. Alih-alih memudar secara alami lewat Nullification, ia berubah menjadi Anomaly yang lebih berbahaya dan licik: "Teehee Bear".
Sebagai Anomaly cabang yang diturunkan dari "Huggy Bear", "Teehee Bear" jauh lebih langka.
Anomaly ini percaya bahwa beruang yang ditelantarkan dan dilupakan adalah pengecut jika tidak membalas dendam! Bagaimanapun, bocah-bocah itu bilang "Aku paling sayang kamu!", tapi setelah beberapa waktu, mereka membuang apa pun yang mereka punya begitu saja… Seberapa pun polos atau menyedihkan penampilannya, ia tak akan pernah lagi dilirik "teman"-nya dulu. Karena itu, Teehee Bear akan memakai segala cara untuk membuat anak-anak menyebalkan itu merasakan teror kesendirian yang total. Apa pun yang disukai anak-anak, ia menjadi itu untuk memancing mereka. Apa pun yang ditakuti anak-anak, ia membuat mereka menyaksikannya… Benar-benar mengerikan.

Karakteristik Anomaly
Tidak seperti "Saddy Teddy", Anomaly cabang lain dari "Huggy Bear" yang membenci semua orang dewasa, Teehee Bear membenci semua anak-anak. Mereka berwujud Oddity boneka yang mudah memikat hati anak-anak, menyesatkan bahkan mencelakai mereka.
Anomaly teman masa kecil yang berubah ke cabang ini sangat sulit ditangani. Mereka pandai tampil tak berbahaya dan menggemaskan. Masing-masing menyesuaikan penampilannya dengan anak yang diincarnya, sehingga sering mustahil mengetahui nama asli Anomaly tersebut.
Ia punya tiga wujud:
(1) Penampilan lucu untuk menipu (tampak berbeda bagi setiap anak)
(2) Versi tidak berbahaya yang dilihat orang dewasa (boneka teddy bear)
(3) Versi jahat yang menunjukkan hakikat aslinya (inti jahat yang merobek lapisan boneka, Anomaly kacau yang memadukan berbagai spesies)

Anomaly Nexus
Temukan anak yang dulu melupakan atau menelantarkannya, lalu buat anak itu meminta maaf kepada Teehee Bear.

Penilaian Risiko
Tingkat bahaya tak terkendali. Harus segera di-nullify begitu ditemukan.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Belum ditemukan cara Containment. Tidak bisa dijamin.

Langkah Containment
/

Catatan Eksperimen
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

story.en:
The Imaginadough is an Anomaly Product released by DSD POP. After being shaped, it can take on the appearance of nearly any material imaginable based on the creator's thoughts alone! These materials include wood, metal, gem, ceramic, and more. It is widely used in Home Decor. Notably, regardless of what material Imaginadough is shaped into, only its appearance and texture change, but its physical properties remain that of a soft dough. When exposed to extreme temperatures, pH levels, or physical impact, Imaginadough loses its form and may gradually lose its Anomaly characteristics. Under the aforementioned conditions, or after repeated use, Imaginadough loses its Anomaly characteristics and transforms into a substance similar to normal dough, composed mainly of starch and various organic compounds that are harmless to humans.

When Imaginadough is shaped into a Bio Appearance, it does not exhibit biological characteristics, but signs of instability appear. In most cases, it eventually softens back into its original dough form. In a few unverified reports, shaped creatures were said to possess brief mobility. For personal safety and mental health considerations, such attempts are not recommended.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Can take on various colors and materials according to the user's thoughts.
· Regardless of the material it is shaped into, it remains essentially a soft dough. Under extreme conditions, it will lose its shape or even its Anomaly characteristics.
· Shows signs of instability when shaped into a Bio Appearance.

Anomaly Nexus
Even though it can be freely shaped into various materials, its essence remains as soft as dough. Under extreme temperatures, extreme pH levels, or after excessive repeated use, it gradually loses its characteristics and ultimately transforms into a harmless organic dough without Anomaly characteristics.

Risk Assessment
Guaranteed by DSD POP. Sold in public circulation.

Containment/Guarantee Status
/

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
1. Experiment: Placing Imaginadough in boiling water.
Result: Imaginadough melted immediately. After approximately 5 minutes, it lost its Anomaly characteristics. We obtained a bowl of thick starch soup.
2. Experiment: Placing Imaginadough in a flash freezing environment.
Result: After approximately 5 minutes, Imaginadough had lost its Anomaly characteristics and became a normal block of starch.
3. Experiment: Placing Imaginadough in strong acid solution and strong alkaline solution respectively.
Result: Upon contact, Imaginadough lost its Anomaly characteristics. The remaining organic matter reacted with the solutions.
4. Experiment: Using high pressure to flatten Imaginadough.
Result: Even when flattened into a thin sheet, Imaginadough could still recover and maintain its Anomaly characteristics. After exceeding a certain threshold, however, it lost its Anomaly characteristics.
5. Experiment: Using a blender to break apart Imaginadough.
Result: After being kneaded back together, Imaginadough maintained its Anomaly characteristics. After repeated blending for a period, its Anomaly characteristics weakened and the materials it presented became unrealistic. After continued blending for another period, it lost its Anomaly characteristics.

Derivative Anomaly
/

Extended Info
/
story.id:
Imaginadough adalah Anomaly Product yang dirilis DSD POP. Setelah dibentuk, ia bisa meniru penampilan hampir semua bahan yang bisa dibayangkan hanya berdasarkan pikiran pembuatnya! Bahan-bahan ini termasuk kayu, logam, permata, keramik, dan lainnya. Ia banyak dipakai untuk Dekorasi Rumah. Perlu dicatat, apa pun bahan yang dibentuk dari Imaginadough, hanya penampilan dan teksturnya yang berubah, sementara sifat fisiknya tetap seperti adonan lunak. Saat terkena suhu, tingkat pH, atau benturan fisik yang ekstrem, Imaginadough kehilangan bentuknya dan perlahan bisa kehilangan sifat Anomaly-nya. Dalam kondisi di atas, atau setelah dipakai berulang kali, Imaginadough kehilangan sifat Anomaly-nya dan berubah menjadi zat mirip adonan biasa, yang terutama terdiri dari pati dan berbagai senyawa organik yang tidak berbahaya bagi manusia.

Saat Imaginadough dibentuk menjadi Wujud Makhluk Hidup, ia tidak menunjukkan ciri biologis, tapi muncul tanda-tanda ketidakstabilan. Dalam kebanyakan kasus, ia akhirnya melunak kembali ke wujud adonan aslinya. Dalam beberapa laporan yang belum terverifikasi, makhluk yang dibentuk konon sempat bisa bergerak sebentar. Demi keselamatan pribadi dan kesehatan mental, percobaan seperti itu tidak disarankan.

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Bisa meniru berbagai warna dan bahan sesuai pikiran pemakainya.
· Apa pun bahan yang dibentuk, pada dasarnya tetap adonan lunak. Dalam kondisi ekstrem, ia akan kehilangan bentuk bahkan sifat Anomaly-nya.
· Menunjukkan tanda-tanda ketidakstabilan saat dibentuk menjadi Wujud Makhluk Hidup.

Anomaly Nexus
Meski bisa bebas dibentuk menjadi berbagai bahan, hakikatnya tetap selunak adonan. Pada suhu ekstrem, tingkat pH ekstrem, atau setelah dipakai berulang kali secara berlebihan, ia perlahan kehilangan sifatnya dan akhirnya berubah menjadi adonan organik tidak berbahaya tanpa sifat Anomaly.

Penilaian Risiko
Dijamin oleh DSD POP. Dijual dan beredar bebas di masyarakat.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
/

Langkah Containment
/

Catatan Eksperimen
1. Eksperimen: Memasukkan Imaginadough ke air mendidih.
Hasil: Imaginadough langsung meleleh. Setelah sekitar 5 menit, ia kehilangan sifat Anomaly-nya. Kami mendapat semangkuk sup pati kental.
2. Eksperimen: Memasukkan Imaginadough ke lingkungan pembekuan kilat.
Hasil: Setelah sekitar 5 menit, Imaginadough kehilangan sifat Anomaly-nya dan menjadi bongkahan pati biasa.
3. Eksperimen: Memasukkan Imaginadough ke larutan asam kuat dan larutan basa kuat secara bergantian.
Hasil: Begitu bersentuhan, Imaginadough kehilangan sifat Anomaly-nya. Bahan organik yang tersisa bereaksi dengan larutan tersebut.
4. Eksperimen: Memakai tekanan tinggi untuk memipihkan Imaginadough.
Hasil: Bahkan saat dipipihkan menjadi lembaran tipis, Imaginadough masih bisa pulih dan mempertahankan sifat Anomaly-nya. Namun, setelah melewati ambang tertentu, ia kehilangan sifat Anomaly-nya.
5. Eksperimen: Memakai blender untuk menghancurkan Imaginadough.
Hasil: Setelah diuleni kembali menjadi satu, Imaginadough mempertahankan sifat Anomaly-nya. Setelah diblender berulang kali selama beberapa waktu, sifat Anomaly-nya melemah dan bahan yang ditampilkannya menjadi tidak realistis. Setelah terus diblender selama beberapa waktu lagi, ia kehilangan sifat Anomaly-nya.

story.en:
R-9843(Ob) Paper Squadron is an Anomaly consisting of multiple paper planes. Typically, this anomaly will nest in the mailboxes of suburban homes. If startled, they'll swarm and repeatedly circle in the sky.

"Reporting to the Captain! Lightwing is prepped and ready, requesting takeoff!"
"Request received, Lightwing. You're cleared for takeoff!"
The child on the rooftop blew onto the paper plane in his hands, throwing the plane towards the sky with all his might. The paper plane made a soft arc in the air before finally fluttering down into the yard. "Lightwing, you did your best! Skywing can handle the rest." The child grabbed another paper plane, preparing for its next "sortie".
His mother yells from the house down below, "Come and clean up your toys from the yard!"
"Okay, Mom! Paper Squadron, listen up! Today's mission was a complete success—begin your orderly return to base!" The kid dashed downstairs, picking up each paper plane one by one, carefully dusting off their wings. He began to delicately put them back in a cardboard box labeled, "Fleet's Secret Hangar".

As time progressed, the child continued to grow, eventually attending school and beyond. The Paper Squadron was launched less and less. Instead, they remained in base, patiently waiting for their Captain's orders.
One day, the child, now a grown man, discovered a box caked in dust while clearing out the attic. Inside, he found the paper planes that had loyally followed his every order as a child. He noticed that the paper was no longer crisp white, but instead a creased yellow. Their markings had faded, and he could no longer distinguish one plane from the other. In hopes of captaining one more flight, the man dragged the box out to the yard and tossed one of the planes into the air. Far from its prime, the plane wobbled for a few moments in the air before dropping entirely. The man stared at the paper plane on the ground. Silently, he picked it up, dusted it off, and placed it back within the box.

Before leaving his childhood home, the man climbed to the roof and tried to send the paper plane into the air for the last time. He blew on it gently and, with a flick of his wrist, sent the plane flying. However, instead of its usual flight pattern, the paper plane caught wind and actually began to… hover. The man was frozen in shock. He quickly grabbed another plane and repeated his previous action. The second plane replicated the same behavior, soaring into the air before hovering, as if awaiting an order. The man finally understood: his childhood Paper Plane Fleet had awakened. Only, he was no longer qualified to be their Captain. A strong gust of wind swept across the rooftop, catching the paper planes and carrying them off onto the horizon.

From that moment on, the Paper Squadron lost its Captain—leaving only a flock of paper planes, forever flying with no direction nor commands in mind.

Characteristics:
· An Anomaly comprised of multiple paper planes, collectively referred to as the "Paper Plane Fleet".
· Under normal circumstances, the Anomaly shows no active hostility. However, if their flight path is interfered with, there is a chance they will initiate a counterattack.


Anomaly Nexus:
Forcing the fleet to ground itself will result in nullification.

Low Risk.

story.id:
R-9843(Ob) Paper Squadron adalah Anomaly yang terdiri dari beberapa pesawat kertas. Biasanya, Anomaly ini bersarang di kotak surat rumah-rumah pinggiran kota. Jika dikagetkan, mereka akan berkerumun dan terus berputar-putar di langit.

"Lapor, Kapten! Lightwing sudah siap, minta izin lepas landas!"
"Permintaan diterima, Lightwing. Kamu diizinkan lepas landas!"
Anak di atap itu meniup pesawat kertas di tangannya, lalu melemparkannya ke langit sekuat tenaga. Pesawat kertas itu membuat lengkungan lembut di udara sebelum akhirnya melayang turun ke halaman. "Lightwing, kamu sudah berusaha keras! Sisanya serahkan pada Skywing." Anak itu meraih pesawat kertas lain, bersiap untuk "misi" berikutnya.
Ibunya berteriak dari dalam rumah di bawah, "Ayo, bereskan mainanmu di halaman!"
"Oke, Bu! Paper Squadron, dengarkan! Misi hari ini sukses besar, mulai kembali ke markas dengan tertib!" Anak itu berlari turun, memungut pesawat kertas satu per satu, dengan hati-hati membersihkan debu dari sayapnya. Ia mulai memasukkannya dengan lembut ke dalam kardus berlabel "Hanggar Rahasia Armada".

Seiring waktu, anak itu terus tumbuh, akhirnya bersekolah dan seterusnya. Paper Squadron makin jarang diterbangkan. Mereka tetap di markas, dengan sabar menunggu perintah Kapten mereka.
Suatu hari, anak itu, yang kini sudah dewasa, menemukan sebuah kotak berdebu tebal saat membersihkan loteng. Di dalamnya, ia menemukan pesawat-pesawat kertas yang dengan setia mengikuti setiap perintahnya saat kecil. Ia melihat kertasnya tak lagi putih bersih, melainkan kuning dan kusut. Tanda-tandanya sudah pudar, dan ia tak lagi bisa membedakan satu pesawat dari yang lain. Berharap bisa memimpin satu penerbangan lagi, pria itu menyeret kotak ke halaman dan melempar salah satu pesawat ke udara. Jauh dari masa jayanya, pesawat itu bergoyang beberapa saat di udara sebelum jatuh sepenuhnya. Pria itu menatap pesawat kertas di tanah. Diam-diam, ia memungutnya, membersihkan debunya, dan memasukkannya kembali ke kotak.

Sebelum meninggalkan rumah masa kecilnya, pria itu naik ke atap dan mencoba menerbangkan pesawat kertas untuk terakhir kalinya. Ia meniupnya pelan dan, dengan sentakan pergelangan tangan, melepaskannya terbang. Namun, alih-alih terbang seperti biasa, pesawat kertas itu tertiup angin dan benar-benar mulai… melayang diam. Pria itu terpaku kaget. Ia buru-buru meraih pesawat lain dan mengulangi tindakan sebelumnya. Pesawat kedua melakukan hal yang sama, membubung ke udara lalu melayang, seolah menunggu perintah. Pria itu akhirnya mengerti: Armada Pesawat Kertas masa kecilnya telah bangkit. Hanya saja, ia tak lagi pantas menjadi Kapten mereka. Embusan angin kencang menyapu atap, menangkap pesawat-pesawat kertas itu dan membawanya pergi ke cakrawala.

Sejak saat itu, Paper Squadron kehilangan Kaptennya, hanya menyisakan sekawanan pesawat kertas yang terbang selamanya tanpa arah maupun perintah.

Karakteristik:

· Dalam keadaan normal, Anomaly ini tidak menunjukkan permusuhan aktif. Namun, jika jalur terbangnya diganggu, ada kemungkinan mereka akan menyerang balik.

quote.id: Hihi… tidak usah takut, aku cuma layang-layang kecil…

story.en:
That night, like always, I was on my rooftop, taking in Hethereau's skyline. Suddenly, an orange kite appeared, hanging midair, backlit by the city lights.
I thought to myself, "If I were that kite, I could probably see all of Hethereau from that height…"
The thought flitted through my mind, and before I even registered what I was doing, my body jumped off the edge of the roof: I didn't fall, however… I had actually grabbed onto the kite in midair. The kite maneuvered through the sky as if I were as light as a feather.
"Hethereau really is breathtaking…" I whispered to myself.
At that moment, something lightly brushed my shoulder. I turned my head to look; it turned out to be the streamer trailing behind the kite—at some point, it had gotten tangled in the wind. Lit up by the city's neon lights, I noticed two dark spots and a twisted arc that had, at some point, emerged on the kite's fabric. It bore an uncanny resemblance to a human face. Straight after, the tip of the kite's streamer clutched onto my shoulder, like a pseudo-hand, with brutal force. The markings on the kite began to warp and stretch, forming a bizarre face that cackled hideously: "Heehee!"
"H-help… Help me!" 
Without thinking straight, I let go of the kite, forgetting I was still thousands of feet in the sky. Just as I braced myself to become a contemporary art piece on the pavement, there was a violent tug on my wrist. That same streamer that had initially gripped my shoulder was now tightly wrapped around my wrist. Fearing the worst, I grabbed onto the streamer and held on for dear life. At that moment, something even crazier occurred: The eerie face and behavior of the kite were wiped away entirely. Its maniacal laughter also stopped. Instead, the gentle sound of the wind was all that filled my ears. The kite no longer flew erratically or tried to scare me. Rather, it continued to softly glide through the sky.
"Can… can you take me back?" I asked tentatively.
The kite fluttered tenderly, as if nodding its head. Following my guidance, the kite wove through the towering buildings and high-rises before finally bringing me safely back to the rooftop I was standing on previously. The moment my feet touched solid ground, the kite streamer lingered in my hand, as if reluctant to let go. Eventually, it slipped away from my palm and flew off. I turned my head to watch it gradually fly off into the distance. For a fleeting moment, I had believed that the kite was entirely ordinary, nothing more.

The above constitutes an oral testimony of an anonymous passerby who encountered R-4205(Ob) Ghostly Kite.
Perhaps the Ghostly Kite isn't as evil as previously believed. Its frightening facial expressions and gestures were, maybe, a clumsy way of seeking attention. When its streamers were held tightly by human hands, it might have felt a subtle feeling of human connection. In that "connected" state, the Ghostly Kite might actually serve as a reliable air transport vehicle.

Characteristics:
· An Anomaly that tends to partake in mischief and trickery. Typically, it disguises itself as an ordinary kite, but once a human gets close, the kite's "face" distorts into a mocking expression, letting out a high-pitched cackle.
· The tail streamers seemingly possess tremendous strength. Observers have claimed that it has extreme dexterity and strength, and the ability to fly through the air at high speeds.
· However, if physical contact is made with a human, all mischievous or aggressive behavior immediately ceases, and the kite instead becomes obedient and compliant.

Anomaly Nexus:
Initiate physical contact to establish a "connection" with the kite.

Risk Assessment:
Low Risk.

story.id:
Malam itu, seperti biasa, aku berada di atap rumah, menikmati pemandangan langit Hethereau. Tiba-tiba, sebuah layang-layang oranye muncul, tergantung di udara, disinari lampu-lampu kota dari belakang.
Aku berpikir, "Kalau aku jadi layang-layang itu, mungkin aku bisa melihat seluruh Hethereau dari ketinggian itu…"
Pikiran itu melintas sekilas, dan sebelum aku sadar apa yang kulakukan, tubuhku melompat dari tepi atap. Tapi aku tidak jatuh… aku ternyata berhasil meraih layang-layang itu di udara. Layang-layang itu meliuk di langit seolah aku seringan bulu.
"Hethereau benar-benar memukau…" bisikku pada diri sendiri.
Saat itu, sesuatu menyentuh pundakku pelan. Aku menoleh; ternyata itu pita ekor layang-layang yang entah kapan terbelit angin. Diterangi lampu neon kota, aku melihat dua bintik gelap dan sebuah lengkungan terpelintir yang entah kapan muncul di kain layang-layang. Bentuknya sangat mirip wajah manusia. Seketika, ujung pita layang-layang mencengkeram pundakku seperti tangan palsu, dengan kekuatan yang kasar. Tanda-tanda di layang-layang mulai melengkung dan meregang, membentuk wajah ganjil yang tertawa mengerikan: "Hihi!"
"T-tolong… Tolong aku!"
Tanpa berpikir jernih, aku melepaskan layang-layang itu, lupa bahwa aku masih ribuan kaki di udara. Tepat saat aku bersiap menjadi karya seni kontemporer di trotoar, ada tarikan keras di pergelangan tanganku. Pita yang tadi mencengkeram pundakku kini melilit erat pergelangan tanganku. Takut akan hal terburuk, aku berpegangan pada pita itu sekuat tenaga. Saat itu, hal yang lebih gila lagi terjadi: wajah menyeramkan dan tingkah layang-layang itu lenyap sama sekali. Tawa gilanya juga berhenti. Yang terdengar di telingaku hanyalah desir angin yang lembut. Layang-layang itu tak lagi terbang sembarangan atau mencoba menakutiku. Sebaliknya, ia terus melayang lembut di langit.
"Bisa… bisa antar aku pulang?" tanyaku ragu.
Layang-layang itu berkibar lembut, seolah mengangguk. Mengikuti arahanku, layang-layang itu meliuk di antara gedung-gedung tinggi sebelum akhirnya membawaku kembali dengan selamat ke atap tempatku berdiri tadi. Begitu kakiku menyentuh tanah yang kokoh, pita layang-layang itu masih tertinggal di tanganku, seolah enggan berpisah. Akhirnya, ia lepas dari genggamanku dan terbang pergi. Aku menoleh, melihatnya perlahan terbang menjauh. Untuk sesaat, aku percaya layang-layang itu benar-benar biasa, tidak lebih.

Di atas adalah kesaksian lisan seorang warga tanpa nama yang bertemu R-4205(Ob) Ghostly Kite.
Mungkin Ghostly Kite tidak sejahat yang dikira sebelumnya. Ekspresi wajah dan gerak-geriknya yang menakutkan mungkin hanyalah cara canggung untuk mencari perhatian. Saat pitanya digenggam erat tangan manusia, ia mungkin merasakan semacam ikatan halus dengan manusia. Dalam kondisi "terhubung" itu, Ghostly Kite mungkin justru bisa menjadi kendaraan udara yang bisa diandalkan.

Karakteristik:
· Anomaly yang suka berbuat jahil dan usil. Biasanya, ia menyamar sebagai layang-layang biasa, tapi begitu manusia mendekat, "wajah" layang-layang itu berubah menjadi ekspresi mengejek, mengeluarkan tawa melengking.
· Pita ekornya tampaknya punya kekuatan luar biasa. Para pengamat mengaku pita itu sangat lincah dan kuat, serta bisa terbang di udara dengan kecepatan tinggi.
· Namun, jika terjadi kontak fisik dengan manusia, semua perilaku jahil atau agresifnya langsung berhenti, dan layang-layang itu malah menjadi penurut dan patuh.

Anomaly Nexus:
Lakukan kontak fisik untuk menjalin "hubungan" dengan layang-layang itu.

Penilaian Risiko:
Risiko Rendah.

Status Containment:
Saat ini, beberapa spesimen di-contain di Celaeno Compound. Ada beberapa yang di-contain secara pribadi di kota, dan penampilannya menjadi inspirasi desain glider.

story.en:
The obsession with immortality seems baked into human nature. Out of fear of death, refusal to accept a short, fleeting life, or a desire for more, be it knowledge, money, or power, the hunger for youth and longer lifespans has never ceased. The Anomaly known as "Eternal Present" is that desire made manifest. Its origin has long since vanished from the written records, and most of its past beneficiaries remain shrouded in mystery. Yet, after millennia, Eternal Present still shines brightly.

The Anomaly itself presents as a brilliant, dazzling gem—but its true form is rarely seen. Only once it forges a contract with a host will it reveal itself. From then on, the Contract Bearer can no longer perceive the passage of time.
However, signing the contract poses a significant risk. Because the contract signer's perception of time is completely shattered, they eventually become numb and apathetic towards their existence.

Escaping Eternal Present is, in theory, very simple: as long as the Contract Bearer utters the words, "Free me of my immortal prison", Eternal Present will sever the contract and lie in wait for a new host. The previous host loses every privilege they once had and resumes life normally.

As of right now, the last Contract Bearer reported was Dolores Constantine. With Eternal Present, she attempted to revive the fading Constantine family. In the end, however, she abandoned the Anomaly and embraced her own mortality. After her passing, the Constantine name quickly sank into obscurity, and Eternal Present vanished without a trace.
(Record Update)
Dolores Constantine passed Eternal Present onto her "daughter"—a puppet she herself had given life to—in an attempt to dodge the pursuit of the Anomaly known as the "Debt Collector".

Characteristics:
· Appears as a dazzling gem.
· For any Contract Bearer of this Anomaly, the consequences of time decrease dramatically, granting them an immortal existence.
· Eventually, the Contract Bearer will begin to develop an apathetic worldview.
· To break free of this Anomaly, the signer must personally declare, "Free me of my immortal prison".

Anomaly Nexus:
When there's no one left to desire more time—or when time itself is swallowed into oblivion—Eternal Present will undergo nullification.

Risk Assessment:
Low Risk.

story.id:
Obsesi akan keabadian seolah sudah tertanam dalam sifat manusia. Karena takut mati, menolak menerima hidup yang singkat dan sekejap, atau menginginkan lebih, entah pengetahuan, uang, atau kekuasaan, rasa lapar akan masa muda dan umur panjang tak pernah berhenti. Anomaly yang dikenal sebagai "Eternal Present" adalah perwujudan hasrat itu. Asal-usulnya sudah lama hilang dari catatan tertulis, dan sebagian besar penerima manfaatnya di masa lalu masih diselimuti misteri. Namun, setelah ribuan tahun, Eternal Present masih bersinar terang.

Anomaly ini berwujud permata yang cemerlang dan menyilaukan, tapi wujud aslinya jarang terlihat. Hanya setelah menjalin kontrak dengan inang ia akan menampakkan diri. Sejak saat itu, pemegang kontrak tak lagi bisa merasakan berlalunya waktu.
Namun, menandatangani kontrak ini membawa risiko besar. Karena persepsi penanda tangan kontrak tentang waktu benar-benar hancur, pada akhirnya ia menjadi mati rasa dan acuh terhadap keberadaannya sendiri.

Lepas dari Eternal Present secara teori sangat mudah: selama pemegang kontrak mengucapkan kata-kata "Bebaskan aku dari penjara keabadianku", Eternal Present akan memutus kontrak dan menunggu inang baru. Inang sebelumnya kehilangan semua hak istimewa yang pernah dimilikinya dan kembali hidup normal.

Saat ini, pemegang kontrak terakhir yang dilaporkan adalah Dolores Constantine. Dengan Eternal Present, ia berusaha membangkitkan kembali keluarga Constantine yang memudar. Namun, pada akhirnya, ia melepaskan Anomaly itu dan menerima kefanaannya sendiri. Setelah kepergiannya, nama Constantine cepat tenggelam dalam ketidakjelasan, dan Eternal Present lenyap tanpa jejak.
(Catatan Terbaru)
Dolores Constantine mewariskan Eternal Present kepada "putri"-nya, sebuah boneka yang ia hidupkan sendiri, dalam upaya menghindari kejaran Anomaly yang dikenal sebagai "Debt Collector".

Karakteristik:
· Berwujud permata yang menyilaukan.
· Bagi pemegang kontrak Anomaly ini, dampak waktu berkurang drastis, memberinya keberadaan yang abadi.
· Pada akhirnya, pemegang kontrak mulai memiliki pandangan hidup yang acuh.
· Untuk lepas dari Anomaly ini, penanda tangan kontrak harus menyatakan sendiri, "Bebaskan aku dari penjara keabadianku".

Anomaly Nexus:
Saat tak ada lagi yang menginginkan waktu lebih, atau saat waktu itu sendiri ditelan ketiadaan, Eternal Present akan ter-nullify.

Penilaian Risiko:
Risiko Rendah.

Status Containment:
Belum di-contain.

Prosedur Containment:
/

Catatan Eksperimen:
/

Derivative Anomaly:
/

quote.en: "Tonight, expect to see heavy rainfall with a chance of thunderstorms. For those that need to go out, be sure to prepare accordingly, and, please… be on the lookout for Rainmen."
quote.id: "Malam ini, diperkirakan akan turun hujan lebat disertai kemungkinan badai petir. Bagi yang harus keluar rumah, pastikan bersiap dengan baik, dan tolong… waspadai Rainmen."

story.en:
It's a late, rainy night. An exhausted white-collar worker, having finally escaped the office, begins to walk through the downpour. Though their clothes are soaked and their feet are numb, they continue walking—completely unaware of the dark, gloomy stare watching their every move. Thin tendrils begin to wrap around their throat…
Cut!
Well, if this were one of those horror flicks, the scene would've ended there. Unfortunately, this office worker wasn't so lucky.
Clad in black, holding a black umbrella, prowling the streets on rainy nights—the Rainman roams back and forth through obscure alleyways, waiting to ambush any poor souls who left their umbrellas at home. So, as long as you have your raingear, you're safe, right? Guess again.
Hypotheses like "the Rainman only manifests on rainy nights" or "the Rainman is a Bio Anomaly" are just that: hypotheses. Recent research on Rainmen has destroyed both assumptions. Even on a clear, sunny day, you might spot an "umbrella" in some back alley that gives off an uncanny vibe—potentially a Rainman in its "umbrella" form.
In reality, that neatly dressed figure in a business suit is nothing but a puppet: a human silhouette molded from long, dangling tentacles hanging down from the umbrella canopy. Its real form is the umbrella proper.
The Rainman is only openly hostile on rainy nights. However, that doesn't mean that their activity is strictly limited to certain times and weather patterns. Even in broad daylight, approaching an unclaimed umbrella could potentially lead a victim to the Rainman's domain: a grim, damp alleyway, with an aggressive Rainman waiting at the other end.
The reasons behind the Rainman's behavior are still insufficiently researched. The leading theory claims that, when under adverse weather conditions like a thunderstorm, the city resembles the Rainman's domain almost one-to-one, thus encouraging the Rainman's territorial instinct. If so, simulating an umbrella with a bag or jacket might be your barrier between life and death. Even so, for your safety and the safety of the public, please remember your umbrella.

Characteristics:
· The Rainman is not a "person", nor is it an Oddity. It is an Object Anomaly whose true form resembles a black umbrella.
· A Rainman does not have a preferred method of attack. Confrontations head-on or from behind are common. Because of this, the Rainman poses extreme danger to ordinary civilians.
· During periods of high Rainman activity, new Rainman sightings are reported consistently. As of right now, there has been no discernible correlation discovered between Rainman observation points and places with high humidity and rainfall.
Recently, some Anomaly Hunters have reported seeing Rainmen use Weather Vines to alter surrounding environments, therefore expanding their "territory". Whether Rainmen possess true intelligence and sentience remains to be confirmed by Zerogon Laboratory.

Anomaly Nexus:
Destroy the "umbrella".

Risk Assessment:
Extremely High Risk. Ordinary citizens who approach Rainmen recklessly face severe danger. During high-activity periods, it is recommended that the Bureau of Anomaly Control dispatch specialists to carry out focused purges of Rainmen.

Containment Status:
Four specimens are contained at the Celaeno Compound.

Containment Procedures:
Use rack‑shaped containment units to fold and store the "umbrella" form.

Experiment Record:
Experiment Objective:
To verify how umbrella‑like "cover structures" affect Rainman's targeting behavior and aggression.

Experiment Method:
In a district with a confirmed Rainman presence, three groups were sent in for a controlled test. All personnel were CSU members with professional Anomaly training.
Group A held umbrellas fully open over their heads, completely covering the top of their heads.
Group B held backpacks, coats, and similar items over their heads, forming an umbrella‑like cover.
Group C held open umbrellas at their sides, not covering their heads.
The three groups each approached a Rainman in their "umbrella" state, observing and synchronously recording its reactions.

Experiment Results:
All three groups triggered hostile behavior from the Rainmen. However, in Group A, only 20% of personnel were actually attacked; in Group B, 60% were attacked; in Group C, every single member was attacked. This indicates that "whether the umbrella‑shaped cover fully shields the head" is the key factor in how Rainmen choose their targets.

Derivative Anomaly:
/
story.id:
Malam hujan yang larut. Seorang pekerja kantoran yang kelelahan, akhirnya lepas dari kantor, mulai berjalan di bawah hujan deras. Meski bajunya basah kuyup dan kakinya mati rasa, ia terus berjalan, sama sekali tidak sadar ada tatapan gelap dan suram yang mengawasi setiap geraknya. Sulur-sulur tipis mulai melilit lehernya…
Cut!
Yah, kalau ini salah satu film horor itu, adegannya akan berakhir di situ. Sayangnya, pekerja kantoran ini tidak seberuntung itu.
Berbalut hitam, memegang payung hitam, berkeliaran di jalanan saat malam hujan: Rainman mondar-mandir di gang-gang sepi, menunggu menyergap jiwa-jiwa malang yang lupa membawa payung. Jadi, selama kamu membawa perlengkapan hujan, kamu aman, kan? Salah.
Hipotesis seperti "Rainman hanya muncul di malam hujan" atau "Rainman adalah Bio Anomaly" hanyalah hipotesis. Penelitian terbaru tentang Rainman sudah mematahkan kedua anggapan itu. Bahkan di hari yang cerah tanpa awan, kamu mungkin melihat "payung" di sebuah gang belakang yang terasa janggal, yang mungkin saja Rainman dalam wujud "payung"-nya.
Kenyataannya, sosok berjas rapi itu hanyalah boneka: siluet manusia yang dibentuk dari tentakel panjang yang menjuntai dari kanopi payung. Wujud aslinya adalah payung itu sendiri.
Rainman hanya bermusuhan secara terang-terangan di malam hujan. Namun, bukan berarti aktivitasnya terbatas pada waktu dan cuaca tertentu. Bahkan di siang bolong, mendekati payung tanpa pemilik bisa membawa korban ke wilayah Rainman: gang yang suram dan lembap, dengan Rainman agresif yang menunggu di ujung lainnya.
Alasan di balik perilaku Rainman masih belum cukup diteliti. Teori utamanya menyebut bahwa saat cuaca buruk seperti badai petir, kota nyaris sama persis dengan wilayah Rainman, sehingga memicu naluri teritorialnya. Kalau begitu, meniru payung dengan tas atau jaket mungkin bisa menjadi pembatas antara hidup dan mati. Meski begitu, demi keselamatanmu dan publik, ingatlah membawa payung.

Karakteristik:
· Rainman bukan "manusia", juga bukan Oddity. Ia adalah Object Anomaly yang wujud aslinya menyerupai payung hitam.
· Rainman tidak punya cara menyerang yang khas. Serangan dari depan maupun belakang sama-sama umum. Karena itu, Rainman sangat berbahaya bagi warga biasa.
· Saat aktivitas Rainman sedang tinggi, penampakan Rainman baru terus dilaporkan. Sampai saat ini, belum ditemukan hubungan yang jelas antara titik pengamatan Rainman dan tempat dengan kelembapan serta curah hujan tinggi.
Belakangan, beberapa Anomaly Hunter melaporkan melihat Rainman memakai Weather Vine untuk mengubah lingkungan sekitarnya, sehingga memperluas "wilayah" mereka. Apakah Rainman punya kecerdasan dan kesadaran sejati masih menunggu konfirmasi Zerogon Laboratory.

Anomaly Nexus:
Hancurkan "payung"-nya.

Penilaian Risiko:
Risiko Sangat Tinggi. Warga biasa yang gegabah mendekati Rainman menghadapi bahaya serius. Saat aktivitasnya tinggi, disarankan Bureau of Anomaly Control mengirim spesialis untuk melakukan pembersihan Rainman secara terfokus.

Status Containment:
Empat spesimen di-contain di Celaeno Compound.

Prosedur Containment:
Gunakan unit Containment berbentuk rak untuk melipat dan menyimpan wujud "payung"-nya.

Catatan Eksperimen:
Tujuan Eksperimen:
Membuktikan bagaimana "struktur penutup" mirip payung memengaruhi perilaku Rainman dalam memilih sasaran dan agresivitasnya.

Metode Eksperimen:
Di distrik yang dipastikan ada Rainman, tiga kelompok dikirim untuk uji terkendali. Semua personel adalah anggota CSU dengan pelatihan Anomaly profesional.
Kelompok A memegang payung yang terbuka penuh di atas kepala, menutupi bagian atas kepala sepenuhnya.
Kelompok B memegang ransel, mantel, dan barang serupa di atas kepala, membentuk penutup mirip payung.
Kelompok C memegang payung terbuka di samping badan, tidak menutupi kepala.
Ketiga kelompok masing-masing mendekati Rainman dalam wujud "payung", mengamati dan mencatat reaksinya secara bersamaan.

Hasil Eksperimen:
Ketiga kelompok sama-sama memicu perilaku bermusuhan dari Rainman. Namun, di Kelompok A, hanya 20% personel yang benar-benar diserang; di Kelompok B, 60% diserang; di Kelompok C, setiap anggota diserang. Ini menunjukkan bahwa "apakah penutup berbentuk payung sepenuhnya melindungi kepala" adalah faktor kunci bagaimana Rainman memilih sasarannya.

Derivative Anomaly:
/
