quote.id: "Kalau kamu sedang di kereta tapi tiba-tiba lupa mau ke mana, bantu dirimu sendiri: turunlah."

story.en:
Sometime ago, a train pulled into an underground station that had suddenly appeared out of nowhere on the outskirts of the city. Its model matched an old railcar series Hethereau retired years ago, but it had no train number, and its interior designs were unlike anything that had been produced prior. The most noticeable detail of the train was its eerie blue glow, which inevitably led to its name: the "Ghost Train".
For the most part, the Ghost Train is entirely harmless. In fact, it was ignored entirely when it first appeared. However, this changed when a famous urban explorer, Karen Wilde, launched a campaign named the "Ghost Train Dare", encouraging young daredevils and thrillseekers to camp in the station overnight to prove their fearlessness. Eventually, one young explorer attempted to board the train. His friends watched as the conductorless railcar suddenly awakened, rolled out of the station, and then, a while later, returned—noticeably without the young explorer it had left with initially. That single disappearance was enough to kick the BAC into action, leading to the lockdown of the "Ghost Train Station".
When the Bureau began studying the Ghost Train's characteristics, an owl-shaped Oddity suddenly fluttered out of the empty conductor's cab. According to this Oddity, otherwise known as Miss Levi, the Ghost Train wants something very simple: a desire to deliver passengers to their destination. After a full round of tests, experiments, and verification, the Bureau of Anomaly Control reached a conclusion: the Ghost Train did indeed wish to resemble the common metro.
After extensive safety measures were placed, the BAC eventually decided to open the Ghost Train to the public. Alongside the Zerogon Laboratory and the Ghost Train (represented by Miss Levi, the Conductor), the BAC drafted the Passenger Manual to ensure passenger safety. Any traveler who wishes to take the Ghost Train must adhere to and fully understand the Passenger Manual and pass the Ghost Train Qualification Exam at the Bureau.
The Ghost Train does not discriminate when allowing passengers aboard. It runs diligently around the clock, and always arrives almost instantaneously at the station whenever a passenger steps onto the platform. Since the train runs through the Anomalous Realm, it will sometimes mistakenly appear at the wrong station, dropping bewildered passengers off at places swarming with Surge Anomalies, which is the probable reason for the many earlier disappearances.
Miss Levi does not condone any behavior from Anomaly Hunters purposefully trying to arrive at the wrong station, and, out of a deep respect for professionalism, assists any passengers who "accidentally" end up in the wrong place. All in all, the safety of the Ghost Train, due to the BAC's efforts, has been increased considerably. Nowadays, the Ghost Train can be considered a fast, uncrowded method of traveling around the city.

Characteristics:
· The Ghost Train is a retro railcar, with its entire body shrouded in a blue glow. It doesn't require any physical tracks; instead, it opens an Anomalous Realm and travels within it.
Because of this, the Ghost Train may occasionally drop passengers off at the wrong station.
· Surprisingly, the Ghost Train exhibits both determined and stubborn behavior patterns. Records show it refusing to assist passengers who violate the Passenger Manual.
· Whenever a Wednesday lands on the same day as a full moon, the train will suspend all service for maintenance.
· Possibly due to the Train Conductor being a bird-type Oddity, the Ghost Train tends to avoid any cat-like passengers.
Therefore, as a rule, all feline animals, Oddities, or Espers with feline traits are advised not to board.

Anomaly Nexus:
Access denied.

Risk Assessment:
As long as the Passenger Manual is followed and the train is used normally, the Ghost Train is harmless.

Containment Status:
Guaranteed by the Bureau of Anomaly Control. As an officially certified anomalous transit service, it is open for public use to all citizens of Hethereau.

Containment Procedures:
No containment procedures required.

Experiment Record:
To verify the accuracy of the Ghost Train Passenger Manual, Zerogon Laboratory designed targeted experiments for each rule. Only a small excerpt is recorded in this log. To access the full log, please submit a request to Zerogon Laboratory.

……
Experiment 17
Corresponding rule: Section 6 of the Ghost Train Passenger Manual: "Except on suspension days, whenever a passenger is waiting on the platform, the Ghost Train will arrive within one minute".

Objective: Verify how the Ghost Train responds to waiting passenger behavior.

Method:
On a non-suspension day, multiple test groups were arranged on the same platform for comparison:
· Group I: 1 Passenger, normally waiting on the platform;
· Group II: no humans, only a humanoid dummy placed in a waiting posture;
· Group III: 1 Passenger present, but instead of waiting at a fixed point, they walk repeatedly around the station;
· Group IV: 1 Passenger in a waiting posture on the platform, but silently and repeatedly thinking negative phrases such as "I don't need to ride" and "The train isn't coming."
The observers recorded whether the Ghost Train arrived, its arrival time, and whether the doors opened.

Results:
With test subjects from Groups I, III, and IV present, the train arrived within one minute;
Group II did not trigger any response;
In Group IV, although the train arrived, its doors never opened.

Conclusion:
The Ghost Train's judgment of "a passenger is waiting" is based on the passenger's actual presence and a recognized intention to board. Whether that intention is valid has nothing to do with outward behavior. The exact method by which the Ghost Train confirms a Passenger's intent still requires further study.
……

Derivative Anomaly:
U-5972-1(Or) Miss Levi
U-5972-2(Lo) Ghost Station
story.id:
Beberapa waktu lalu, sebuah kereta memasuki stasiun bawah tanah yang tiba-tiba muncul entah dari mana di pinggiran kota. Modelnya sama dengan seri gerbong lama yang sudah dipensiunkan Hethereau bertahun-tahun lalu, tapi tidak punya nomor kereta, dan desain interiornya tak mirip apa pun yang pernah diproduksi sebelumnya. Ciri paling mencolok kereta ini adalah cahaya birunya yang menyeramkan, yang tak terelakkan membuatnya dinamai "Ghost Train".
Sebagian besar waktu, Ghost Train sama sekali tidak berbahaya. Bahkan, ia sepenuhnya diabaikan saat pertama kali muncul. Namun, keadaan berubah saat penjelajah urban terkenal, Karen Wilde, meluncurkan kampanye bernama "Ghost Train Dare", mengajak para anak muda nekat dan pencari sensasi berkemah semalaman di stasiun untuk membuktikan keberanian mereka. Akhirnya, seorang penjelajah muda mencoba naik ke kereta itu. Teman-temannya menyaksikan gerbong tanpa masinis itu tiba-tiba hidup, melaju keluar stasiun, lalu tak lama kemudian kembali, jelas tanpa penjelajah muda yang tadi ikut bersamanya. Satu kasus hilang itu cukup untuk membuat BAC bergerak, sehingga "Ghost Train Station" ditutup.
Saat Bureau mulai meneliti karakteristik Ghost Train, sebuah Oddity berbentuk burung hantu tiba-tiba terbang keluar dari kabin masinis yang kosong. Menurut Oddity ini, yang juga dikenal sebagai Miss Levi, keinginan Ghost Train sangat sederhana: mengantar penumpang sampai ke tujuan. Setelah serangkaian uji, eksperimen, dan verifikasi, Bureau of Anomaly Control mencapai kesimpulan: Ghost Train memang ingin menjadi seperti kereta metro biasa.
Setelah langkah keamanan yang ekstensif diterapkan, BAC akhirnya memutuskan membuka Ghost Train untuk umum. Bersama Zerogon Laboratory dan Ghost Train (diwakili Miss Levi, sang Kondektur), BAC menyusun Passenger Manual untuk memastikan keselamatan penumpang. Setiap pelancong yang ingin naik Ghost Train wajib mematuhi dan memahami sepenuhnya Passenger Manual serta lulus Ghost Train Qualification Exam di Bureau.
Ghost Train tidak pilih-pilih saat menerima penumpang. Ia beroperasi dengan rajin sepanjang waktu, dan selalu tiba di stasiun nyaris seketika setiap kali ada penumpang yang melangkah ke peron. Karena kereta ini melintasi Anomalous Realm, terkadang ia salah muncul di stasiun yang keliru, menurunkan penumpang yang kebingungan di tempat yang dipenuhi Surge Anomaly, yang kemungkinan menjadi penyebab banyaknya kasus hilang sebelumnya.
Miss Levi tidak membenarkan tindakan Anomaly Hunter yang sengaja ingin turun di stasiun yang salah, dan karena sangat menjunjung profesionalisme, ia membantu penumpang mana pun yang "tak sengaja" berakhir di tempat yang salah. Secara keseluruhan, berkat upaya BAC, keamanan Ghost Train sudah meningkat pesat. Kini, Ghost Train bisa dianggap sebagai cara berkeliling kota yang cepat dan tidak berdesakan.

Karakteristik:
· Ghost Train adalah gerbong kereta bergaya retro, dengan seluruh badannya diselimuti cahaya biru. Ia tidak butuh rel fisik; sebagai gantinya, ia membuka Anomalous Realm dan melaju di dalamnya.
Karena itu, Ghost Train sesekali bisa menurunkan penumpang di stasiun yang salah.
· Mengejutkan, Ghost Train menunjukkan pola perilaku yang tegas sekaligus keras kepala. Catatan menunjukkan ia menolak membantu penumpang yang melanggar Passenger Manual.
· Setiap kali hari Rabu bertepatan dengan bulan purnama, kereta akan menghentikan semua layanan untuk perawatan.
· Mungkin karena Kondekturnya Oddity jenis burung, Ghost Train cenderung menghindari penumpang yang mirip kucing.
Karena itu, sebagai aturan, semua hewan, Oddity, atau Esper berciri kucing disarankan untuk tidak naik.

Anomaly Nexus:
Akses ditolak.

Penilaian Risiko:
Selama Passenger Manual diikuti dan kereta dipakai secara normal, Ghost Train tidak berbahaya.

Status Containment:
Dijamin oleh Bureau of Anomaly Control. Sebagai layanan transportasi anomali yang tersertifikasi resmi, ia terbuka untuk dipakai seluruh warga Hethereau.

Prosedur Containment:
Tidak perlu prosedur Containment.

Catatan Eksperimen:
Untuk membuktikan keakuratan Ghost Train Passenger Manual, Zerogon Laboratory merancang eksperimen khusus untuk setiap aturan. Hanya sebagian kecil yang dicatat di log ini. Untuk mengakses log lengkap, silakan ajukan permintaan ke Zerogon Laboratory.

……
Eksperimen 17
Aturan terkait: Bagian 6 Ghost Train Passenger Manual: "Kecuali pada hari penghentian layanan, setiap kali ada penumpang yang menunggu di peron, Ghost Train akan tiba dalam satu menit".

Tujuan: Membuktikan bagaimana Ghost Train merespons perilaku penumpang yang menunggu.

Metode:
Pada hari tanpa penghentian layanan, beberapa kelompok uji diatur di peron yang sama sebagai pembanding:
· Kelompok I: 1 penumpang, menunggu di peron seperti biasa;
· Kelompok II: tanpa manusia, hanya boneka berbentuk manusia yang diletakkan dalam posisi menunggu;
· Kelompok III: 1 penumpang hadir, tapi alih-alih menunggu di satu titik, ia berjalan bolak-balik mengelilingi stasiun;
· Kelompok IV: 1 penumpang dalam posisi menunggu di peron, tapi diam-diam terus memikirkan kalimat negatif seperti "Aku tidak perlu naik" dan "Keretanya tidak akan datang."
Para pengamat mencatat apakah Ghost Train tiba, waktu kedatangannya, dan apakah pintunya terbuka.

Hasil:
Dengan kehadiran subjek uji Kelompok I, III, dan IV, kereta tiba dalam satu menit;
Kelompok II tidak memicu respons apa pun;
Pada Kelompok IV, meski kereta tiba, pintunya tak pernah terbuka.

Kesimpulan:
Penilaian Ghost Train bahwa "ada penumpang yang menunggu" didasarkan pada kehadiran nyata penumpang dan niat untuk naik yang dikenalinya. Sah tidaknya niat itu tidak ada hubungannya dengan perilaku luar. Cara pasti Ghost Train memastikan niat penumpang masih perlu diteliti lebih lanjut.
……

Derivative Anomaly:
U-5972-1(Or) Miss Levi
U-5972-2(Lo) Ghost Station

story.en:
R-4321[Ob] "Dimension Visitor" is, in essence, an ancient nautical astrolabe. Beyond locating physical directions such as north, south, east, and west, as well as the positions of stars in the cosmos, it possesses a strange ability: it can point toward where the heart belongs, the path to hidden treasure, those with potential, and more. The ancient astrolabe was kept in an equally ancient hidden village. The villagers used it and worshiped it, yet they never spoke of it to outsiders, nor did they use its power for immoral ends. Grateful for their kindness, it formed a contract with the villagers and granted them long lives.
Those peaceful days lasted until word of the "long-lived village" eventually reached the outside world. Rumors grew and spread until the villagers were forced to leave their home and become trapped in a cruel "game." Tragically, the village's already scarce bloodline was completely extinguished in that game, and the organizers were disappointed to discover that they truly were only ordinary people who lived a little longer. Realizing that everything they had done had been meaningless, the powerful complained and walked away. Dimension Visitor was left adrift amid this undeserved chaos. Yet to the very end, everyone still prayed to it and protected their shared secret. Dimension Visitor felt confusion, bewilderment, and endless loneliness. But how was it supposed to process emotions that "should have belonged to humans"? Unfortunately, the astrolabe could not point the way to its own future. Thus, it developed a desire to "escape," giving birth to the Anomalous Realm known as the Corridor of Echoes.
Taking on the appearance of its last contract bearer, Dimension Visitor has wandered for ages at the entrance to the Corridor of Echoes, fulfilling the astrolabe's original purpose: speaking with every visitor likewise drowned in the past and guiding them toward "escape." The present no longer exists, and even the future will someday become the past. Perhaps in this way, it can forever keep the contractors it once knew, and the kind people who live on in its memories.

Characteristics
Its true form is an ancient nautical astrolabe with a strange ability to form contracts with people and grant them long life.
After all of its contract bearers passed away, the astrolabe was left adrift. It eventually took on the appearance of its final contractor and began wandering the entrance to the Corridor of Echoes, an Anomalous Realm born from its will.
It speaks with every visitor similarly lost in the past and guides them toward "escape."

Anomaly Nexus
Insufficient clearance. Currently inaccessible.

Risk Assessment
Low risk.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Unique Anomaly. Not currently contained.
story.id:
R-4321[Ob] "Dimension Visitor" pada dasarnya adalah astrolab navigasi kuno. Selain menentukan arah fisik seperti utara, selatan, timur, dan barat, serta posisi bintang di alam semesta, ia punya kemampuan aneh: bisa menunjuk ke tempat hati berlabuh, jalan menuju harta tersembunyi, orang-orang yang berpotensi, dan lainnya. Astrolab kuno itu disimpan di sebuah desa tersembunyi yang sama kunonya. Para penduduk desa memakainya dan memujanya, tapi mereka tak pernah menceritakannya kepada orang luar, juga tak pernah memakai kekuatannya untuk tujuan tak bermoral. Bersyukur atas kebaikan mereka, ia menjalin kontrak dengan para penduduk desa dan memberi mereka umur panjang.
Hari-hari damai itu bertahan sampai kabar tentang "desa berumur panjang" akhirnya sampai ke dunia luar. Rumor berkembang dan menyebar sampai para penduduk desa terpaksa meninggalkan rumah mereka dan terjebak dalam "permainan" yang kejam. Tragisnya, garis keturunan desa yang memang sudah sedikit itu benar-benar musnah dalam permainan itu, dan para penyelenggaranya kecewa mendapati bahwa mereka benar-benar hanya orang biasa yang hidup sedikit lebih lama. Sadar semua yang mereka lakukan tak ada artinya, orang-orang berkuasa itu mengeluh lalu pergi begitu saja. Dimension Visitor ditinggalkan terombang-ambing di tengah kekacauan yang tak layak ini. Namun sampai akhir, semua orang tetap berdoa kepadanya dan menjaga rahasia bersama mereka. Dimension Visitor merasakan kebingungan, keheranan, dan kesepian tanpa akhir. Tapi bagaimana ia harus mengolah emosi yang "seharusnya milik manusia"? Sayangnya, astrolab itu tak bisa menunjukkan jalan menuju masa depannya sendiri. Maka ia mengembangkan keinginan untuk "melarikan diri", melahirkan Anomalous Realm yang dikenal sebagai Corridor of Echoes.
Mengambil penampilan pemegang kontrak terakhirnya, Dimension Visitor sudah berabad-abad berkeliaran di pintu masuk Corridor of Echoes, menjalankan tujuan asli astrolab: berbicara dengan setiap pengunjung yang juga tenggelam di masa lalu dan menuntun mereka menuju "pelarian". Masa kini sudah tak ada, dan bahkan masa depan suatu hari akan menjadi masa lalu. Mungkin dengan cara ini, ia bisa selamanya menyimpan para pemegang kontrak yang pernah ia kenal, dan orang-orang baik yang tetap hidup dalam ingatannya.

Karakteristik
Wujud aslinya astrolab navigasi kuno dengan kemampuan aneh menjalin kontrak dengan orang dan memberi mereka umur panjang.
Setelah semua pemegang kontraknya meninggal, astrolab itu ditinggalkan terombang-ambing. Ia akhirnya mengambil penampilan pemegang kontrak terakhirnya dan mulai berkeliaran di pintu masuk Corridor of Echoes, Anomalous Realm yang lahir dari kehendaknya.
Ia berbicara dengan setiap pengunjung yang juga tersesat di masa lalu dan menuntun mereka menuju "pelarian".

Anomaly Nexus
Izin akses tidak mencukupi. Saat ini tidak bisa diakses.

Penilaian Risiko
Risiko rendah.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Anomaly unik. Saat ini tidak di-contain.

quote.en: "…The tears we gulped turned into rivers, our weeping into song. Ah, do not mourn, for it is guiding us to everlasting peace."
quote.id: "…Air mata yang kita telan menjadi sungai, tangis kita menjadi lagu. Ah, jangan berduka, karena ia sedang menuntun kita menuju kedamaian abadi."

story.en:
R-4321-1[Ob], or the "Helm of Theseus," looks no different from any other weathered, battered ship's wheel after years of storms. The origin of its existence is unknown. It is believed to have appeared in the same Anomalous Realm when the Corridor of Echoes was created. Obeying the will of the Dimension Visitor, this worn-out wheel carries out its duty, like a clock running in reverse, guiding the vessel ever backwards into the past.
For the dreamwalkers in the Corridor, the Helm of Theseus is the very law of their world and everything they could ever wish for. It brings them happiness, peace, and a pain that will never arrive. With a beautiful past to lose themselves in, why would they ever need to face a future filled with uncertainty? Here, they can smooth over old scars with sweet dreams, forgetting the memories that brought them sorrow one at a time. They can cast aside all cumbersome emotions and fill their bodies with joy. At least, this is what the Dimension Visitor believes in, as the Visitor guides those who have suffered similar fates and those who long to break free of their chains, onto this drifting, restless solitary vessel.

It is only human nature to romanticize the memories of the past as a way to push back against the cruelties of life. However, blindly following the guidance of the Helm of Theseus like the dreamwalkers, becoming a part of the past, may not be the foolproof choice it seems. Dreams are called dreams precisely because we will eventually wake up. What's more, since both the Helm and the Corridor stem from the will of the Dimension Visitor, what would become of those affected by them, if one day, that will wavered and shifted? To where, then, would the Corridor and the Helm of Theseus carry its passengers?

——Updated Records——
The Corridor has collapsed, and the Helm now exists beyond the Corridor, having fallen into the possession of the Scarlet Letter, location unknown.

Characteristics
- Likely created along with the spatial anomaly known as the Corridor of Echoes. The Helm takes the form of a massive, worn-out ship wheel.
- Follows the will of the Dimension Visitor, enforcing the rules of the "past" within the Corridor.
- When the Dimension Visitor is neither nullified nor contained, that is, when the Corridor exists, the Helm of Theseus cannot leave the Anomalous Space.
——Updated Records——
- Now that the Corridor has collapsed, the Helm of Theseus exists beyond the Corridor. Its functions are not clear at this moment.

Anomaly Nexus
High clearance required to access files.

Risk Assessment
Low risk.

Containment/Guarantor Status
The anomaly is not currently under containment.
story.id:
R-4321-1[Ob], atau "Helm of Theseus", tampak tak berbeda dari kemudi kapal usang dan rusak lainnya setelah bertahun-tahun diterpa badai. Asal-usul keberadaannya tidak diketahui. Ia diyakini muncul di Anomalous Realm yang sama saat Corridor of Echoes tercipta. Mematuhi kehendak Dimension Visitor, kemudi usang ini menjalankan tugasnya, seperti jam yang berputar mundur, menuntun kapal terus mundur ke masa lalu.
Bagi para dreamwalker di Corridor, Helm of Theseus adalah hukum dunia mereka sekaligus segala yang bisa mereka harapkan. Ia membawa kebahagiaan, kedamaian, dan rasa sakit yang tak akan pernah datang. Dengan masa lalu yang indah untuk dihanyutkan, buat apa mereka menghadapi masa depan yang penuh ketidakpastian? Di sini, mereka bisa menghaluskan bekas luka lama dengan mimpi manis, melupakan kenangan yang membawa kesedihan satu per satu. Mereka bisa membuang semua emosi yang memberatkan dan mengisi tubuh mereka dengan kebahagiaan. Setidaknya, inilah yang diyakini Dimension Visitor, saat sang Visitor menuntun mereka yang bernasib serupa dan mereka yang ingin lepas dari belenggunya ke atas kapal tunggal yang terombang-ambing gelisah ini.

Wajar saja manusia meromantisasi kenangan masa lalu sebagai cara melawan kejamnya hidup. Namun, mengikuti tuntunan Helm of Theseus secara buta seperti para dreamwalker, menjadi bagian dari masa lalu, mungkin bukan pilihan sempurna seperti kelihatannya. Mimpi disebut mimpi justru karena kita pada akhirnya akan terbangun. Terlebih lagi, karena Helm dan Corridor sama-sama berasal dari kehendak Dimension Visitor, apa jadinya mereka yang terpengaruh jika suatu hari kehendak itu goyah dan berubah? Ke mana, kalau begitu, Corridor dan Helm of Theseus akan membawa para penumpangnya?

——Catatan Terbaru——
Corridor telah runtuh, dan Helm kini berada di luar Corridor, jatuh ke tangan Scarlet Letter, lokasinya tidak diketahui.

Karakteristik
- Kemungkinan tercipta bersama Space Anomaly bernama Corridor of Echoes. Helm berwujud kemudi kapal raksasa yang usang.
- Mengikuti kehendak Dimension Visitor, menegakkan aturan "masa lalu" di dalam Corridor.
- Saat Dimension Visitor belum di-nullify maupun di-contain, yaitu saat Corridor masih ada, Helm of Theseus tidak bisa meninggalkan Anomalous Space.
——Catatan Terbaru——
- Kini setelah Corridor runtuh, Helm of Theseus berada di luar Corridor. Fungsinya belum jelas saat ini.

Anomaly Nexus
Perlu izin akses tinggi untuk membuka berkas.

Penilaian Risiko
Risiko rendah.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Anomaly ini saat ini tidak di-contain.

quote.en:
"Once upon a time…"

[Anomaly Story]
999 Nights is a Pop Toy type of anomaly product released by DSD. It is a board game that allows participants to step inside and experience unique adventure stories. Depending on the choices made by the participants, 999 Nights can generate completely different environments and stories, giving players a different experience every time. To be precise, the stories created by 999 Nights come from a vast collection of stories, and if all the stories were played through, 999 Nights would be nullified. However, given the immense number of stories collected, this is almost impossible. That said, physical destruction of the board game itself would also result in nullification.
DSD POP currently offers different versions of 999 Nights. Aside from variations in accessories and merch, the central anomaly board itself doesn't vary much between versions. DSD also added a wider story collection to the deluxe edition, but even the standard edition has more than enough stories to keep players exploring for a long time.

[Characteristics]
It takes the appearance of a board game. Each time players begin, the game randomly creates a customized adventure experience based on the participants.

[Anomaly Nexus]
Experience each and every story collected in 999 Nights.

[Risk Assessment]
Harmless.

[Containment/Guarantor Status]
No need to contain.

[Containment]
/

[Experiment Record]
/

[Derivative Anomaly]
/

[More Information]
/
quote.id:
"Pada zaman dahulu kala…"

[Kisah Anomaly]
999 Nights adalah Anomaly Product jenis Pop Toy yang dirilis DSD. Ini adalah permainan papan yang memungkinkan pesertanya masuk ke dalam dan mengalami kisah petualangan yang unik. Tergantung pilihan para peserta, 999 Nights bisa menciptakan lingkungan dan cerita yang sama sekali berbeda, sehingga pemain mendapat pengalaman berbeda setiap kali bermain. Tepatnya, kisah-kisah yang diciptakan 999 Nights berasal dari kumpulan cerita yang sangat banyak, dan jika semua cerita itu dimainkan sampai habis, 999 Nights akan ter-nullify. Namun, mengingat jumlah cerita yang terkumpul begitu besar, hal ini hampir mustahil. Meski begitu, menghancurkan papan permainannya secara fisik juga akan menyebabkan Nullification.
DSD POP saat ini menawarkan beberapa versi 999 Nights. Selain perbedaan aksesori dan merchandise, papan Anomaly utamanya tidak jauh berbeda antarversi. DSD juga menambahkan koleksi cerita yang lebih luas di edisi deluxe, tapi edisi standar pun sudah punya lebih dari cukup cerita untuk dijelajahi pemain dalam waktu lama.

[Karakteristik]
Berwujud permainan papan. Setiap kali pemain memulai, permainan ini secara acak menciptakan pengalaman petualangan yang disesuaikan dengan para peserta.

[Anomaly Nexus]
Mengalami setiap cerita yang terkumpul di 999 Nights.

[Penilaian Risiko]
Tidak berbahaya.

[Status Containment/Penjaminan]
Tidak perlu di-contain.

quote.en: "Old soldiers never retire, they merely lie in wait."
quote.id: "Prajurit tua tak pernah pensiun, mereka hanya menunggu dalam diam."

story.en:
The fairy-tale play, "The Brave Tin Soldier," written by playwright Cassandra, tells the following story: A child once bought a box of tin soldiers to play games with. Some of the Tin Soldiers are wounded in fierce "battles", while others are awarded plastic "medals". As time progresses, however, these fine soldiers are soon left behind and forgotten. Once the child grew older and finally moved away, the Tin Soldiers were packed up and abandoned, stuck in a lone box soaked by the rain. Thus, the once highly-decorated regiment is disbanded, and left wondering: "What now?"

The soldiers in the tale never found the answer. In reality, however, the "Tin Soldiers" did: they created "Bubble Cans." While some Tin Soldiers venture out to gather materials, others handle the processing and guarding of the Bubble Can Factory. The cans themselves are able to, somehow, seal away fragments of Cassandra's fairy tales.
Some believe that Cassandra's play itself created the "Tin Soldiers". Others believe that the Tin Soldiers were inspired by Cassandra's writing, and thus manifested existence and purpose for themselves. This debate has yet to be resolved, unless someone is willing to ask the author themself.
Nowadays, Tin Soldiers are an uncommon, though not rare, Anomaly. Most remain at the Bubble Can Factory, but those who are sent out to accumulate resources have been encountered. If left unthreatened, these Anomalies will avoid onlookers or passersby.

Characteristics
They appear as brightly painted tin can soldiers, but their physical durability far exceeds what tin should be capable of;
 They often appear in groups;
The toy weapons they carry are as powerful as normal weapons, if not more so.

Anomaly Nexus
Remove the military cap and pull the tab on top of the Tin Soldier's head. If they are not defeated, they will continue aggressive behavior.

Risk Assessment
Low risk.

Containment Status
Four Tin Soldiers are currently contained at the Celaeno Compound. No guarantee is permitted at this time.

Containment Measures
Tin Soldiers can be restrained with sufficiently strong restraining devices. Standard methods include custom handcuffs and leg irons fixed to the floor with electromagnets. As long as they are prevented from using their weapons, they can be safely contained.
story.id:
Drama dongeng "The Brave Tin Soldier" karya penulis naskah Cassandra bercerita sebagai berikut: seorang anak pernah membeli sekotak prajurit kaleng untuk dimainkan. Sebagian Tin Soldier terluka dalam "pertempuran" sengit, sementara yang lain dianugerahi "medali" plastik. Namun, seiring waktu, prajurit-prajurit hebat ini segera ditinggalkan dan dilupakan. Begitu si anak beranjak besar dan akhirnya pindah, para Tin Soldier dikemas dan ditelantarkan, terjebak dalam sebuah kotak yang basah kuyup oleh hujan. Maka resimen yang dulu penuh penghargaan itu dibubarkan, dan dibiarkan bertanya-tanya: "Sekarang apa?"

Para prajurit dalam dongeng itu tak pernah menemukan jawabannya. Namun, di dunia nyata, para "Tin Soldier" menemukannya: mereka menciptakan "Bubble Can". Sementara sebagian Tin Soldier keluar mengumpulkan bahan, yang lain mengurus pengolahan dan penjagaan Bubble Can Factory. Kaleng-kaleng itu sendiri entah bagaimana bisa menyegel potongan-potongan dongeng Cassandra.
Ada yang percaya drama Cassandra itu sendiri yang menciptakan "Tin Soldier". Ada juga yang percaya para Tin Soldier terinspirasi tulisan Cassandra, sehingga mewujudkan keberadaan dan tujuan bagi diri mereka sendiri. Perdebatan ini belum terselesaikan, kecuali ada yang mau bertanya langsung kepada penulisnya.
Kini, Tin Soldier adalah Anomaly yang tidak umum, meski tidak langka. Sebagian besar tetap berada di Bubble Can Factory, tapi mereka yang dikirim keluar mengumpulkan sumber daya pernah ditemui. Jika tidak merasa terancam, Anomaly ini akan menghindari orang yang menonton atau lewat.

Karakteristik
Mereka berwujud prajurit kaleng yang dicat cerah, tapi daya tahan fisiknya jauh melampaui kemampuan kaleng seharusnya;
Mereka sering muncul berkelompok;
Senjata mainan yang mereka bawa sama kuatnya dengan senjata biasa, bahkan lebih kuat.

Anomaly Nexus
Lepaskan topi militernya dan tarik penarik kaleng di atas kepala Tin Soldier. Jika tidak dikalahkan, mereka akan terus berperilaku agresif.

Penilaian Risiko
Risiko rendah.

Status Containment
Empat Tin Soldier saat ini di-contain di Celaeno Compound. Penjaminan belum diizinkan saat ini.

Langkah Containment
Tin Soldier bisa ditahan dengan alat pengekang yang cukup kuat. Cara standarnya berupa borgol khusus dan belenggu kaki yang dikunci ke lantai dengan elektromagnet. Selama mereka dicegah memakai senjatanya, mereka bisa di-contain dengan aman.

quote.en: "If only I could cuddle it forever…"
quote.id: "Andai aku bisa memeluknya selamanya…"

story.en:
When a "Cuddly Bear" is no longer needed by its owner and is cast aside, it has the potential to transform into the Derivative Anomaly "Saddy Teddy."
A Saddy Teddy takes the form of a large, worn—if not damaged—plush bear. Common features include a cape and a weapon. The original discarded doll, the Anomaly "Cuddly Bear," is stuffed into the place its heart would be if the bear was a real creature. The Saddy Teddy is known to collect other abandoned toys that met a similar fate of abandonment, repeatedly tearing open its own heart to stuff them inside.
Children's picture book-like patterns sometimes appear in the area surrounding a Saddy Teddy, and can often serve as an early warning sign of its presence. According to multiple investigations, Saddy Teddies are highly hostile and aggressive towards others. Some unverified reports claim that Saddy Teddies do not attack children.
Although Saddy Teddies are hostile towards people, many eyewitness records show that they are open to cooperation with other Anomalies—to a certain extent.

Characteristics
- Appears as a worn, damaged plush bear;
- Has stitched marks over the heart area;
- Continuously collects discarded toys;
- Highly aggressive.

Anomaly Nexus
Destroy the toy(s) in its heart.

Risk Assessment
Low risk.

Containment Status
The Celaeno Compound currently contains one Saddy Teddy. Guaranteeing this Anomaly is currently prohibited.
story.id:
Saat sebuah "Cuddly Bear" tak lagi dibutuhkan pemiliknya dan dibuang, ia berpotensi berubah menjadi Derivative Anomaly "Saddy Teddy".
Saddy Teddy berwujud boneka beruang besar yang usang, bahkan rusak. Ciri umumnya adalah jubah dan senjata. Boneka asli yang dibuang, yaitu Anomaly "Cuddly Bear", dijejalkan ke tempat yang seharusnya menjadi jantungnya jika beruang itu makhluk sungguhan. Saddy Teddy diketahui mengumpulkan mainan lain yang bernasib sama dibuang, berulang kali merobek jantungnya sendiri untuk menjejalkan mainan-mainan itu ke dalamnya.
Pola mirip buku bergambar anak-anak terkadang muncul di sekitar Saddy Teddy, dan sering bisa menjadi tanda peringatan awal kehadirannya. Menurut berbagai penyelidikan, Saddy Teddy sangat bermusuhan dan agresif terhadap orang lain. Beberapa laporan yang belum terverifikasi menyebut Saddy Teddy tidak menyerang anak-anak.
Meski Saddy Teddy bermusuhan terhadap manusia, banyak catatan saksi mata menunjukkan mereka terbuka untuk bekerja sama dengan Anomaly lain, sampai batas tertentu.

Karakteristik
- Berwujud boneka beruang yang usang dan rusak;
- Ada bekas jahitan di area jantungnya;
- Terus mengumpulkan mainan yang dibuang;
- Sangat agresif.

Anomaly Nexus
Hancurkan mainan di dalam jantungnya.

Penilaian Risiko
Risiko rendah.

Status Containment
Celaeno Compound saat ini meng-contain satu Saddy Teddy. Penjaminan Anomaly ini saat ini dilarang.

quote.en: "A relic of the past."
quote.id: "Peninggalan masa lalu."

story.en:
T-1881 (Ob) Scarlet Phantom is an Anomaly that occasionally appears at performance venues, such as concert halls, theaters, cinemas, and so on. It often manifests as black-and-white evening wear, with men's and women's outfits always appearing in pairs. The pairs of clothing will float in midair and engage in ballroom or other styles of dancing. Because Scarlet Phantom is drawn to ostentatious performances and is subsequently nullified following their ending, this Anomaly is typically considered harmless. However, disrupting a performance, or inhibiting Scarlet Phantom's dance, will trigger an aggressive response from the Anomaly. When attacking, what were once moves dedicated to dancing transform into moves for combat. For experienced Anomaly Hunters, Scarlet Phantom poses little to no threat. However, Scarlet Phantoms are known to appear in groups, thereby greatly increasing their danger to the public.
Some performers regard the appearance of Scarlet Phantoms as a sign of a spectacular performance. This belief isn't entirely unfounded, considering that Scarlet Phantoms have distinct tastes. However, it is always ideal to remain conscious of their threat levels, and notify the Bureau of any Anomaly appearances.

Characteristics
- Drawn to grand performances, they attack anyone who tries to hinder their performance.
- Recent reports indicate that when an object, imbued with intense human obsession, is present in the environment, the underlying nullification rules are severely disrupted, and a corresponding performance stage is constructed according to said obsession.

Anomaly Nexus
When the performance that attracts them ends, or when their dance steps are disrupted by an external force.
When Scarlet Phantoms are in a state where their underlying nullification logic has been disrupted, active intervention in the stage they have constructed is required, and the core entity within the area must be defeated to force the performance to conclude.

Risk Assessment
Low hazard. When they appear in groups, the hazard level may rise to moderate.

Containment Status
A small number are contained at Celaeno Compound.

Containment Measures
The Containment Units must provide enough space for dancing. Since this Anomaly is naturally nullified when the performance ends, the Containment Units should continuously play classic performances that have previously attracted Scarlet Phantoms on a large screen, and the playback list should be updated according to appearance records.
story.id:
T-1881 (Ob) Scarlet Phantom adalah Anomaly yang sesekali muncul di tempat pertunjukan, seperti gedung konser, teater, bioskop, dan sebagainya. Ia sering muncul sebagai busana malam hitam-putih, dengan busana pria dan wanita yang selalu muncul berpasangan. Pasangan busana ini melayang di udara dan berdansa ballroom atau gaya dansa lainnya. Karena Scarlet Phantom tertarik pada pertunjukan yang megah dan ter-nullify setelah pertunjukan berakhir, Anomaly ini biasanya dianggap tidak berbahaya. Namun, mengganggu pertunjukan atau menghalangi dansa Scarlet Phantom akan memicu respons agresif dari Anomaly ini. Saat menyerang, gerakan yang tadinya untuk berdansa berubah menjadi gerakan bertarung. Bagi Anomaly Hunter berpengalaman, Scarlet Phantom nyaris tidak mengancam. Namun, Scarlet Phantom diketahui muncul berkelompok, sehingga sangat meningkatkan bahayanya bagi publik.
Sebagian penampil menganggap kemunculan Scarlet Phantom sebagai tanda pertunjukan yang spektakuler. Anggapan ini tidak sepenuhnya tanpa dasar, mengingat Scarlet Phantom punya selera yang khas. Namun, sebaiknya selalu waspada terhadap tingkat ancaman mereka, dan laporkan kemunculan Anomaly apa pun ke Bureau.

Karakteristik
- Tertarik pada pertunjukan megah, mereka menyerang siapa pun yang mencoba menghalangi pertunjukannya.
- Laporan terbaru menunjukkan bahwa saat ada benda yang sarat obsesi manusia yang kuat di lingkungan sekitar, aturan dasar Nullification-nya sangat terganggu, dan panggung pertunjukan dibangun sesuai obsesi tersebut.

Anomaly Nexus
Saat pertunjukan yang menarik mereka berakhir, atau saat langkah dansa mereka terganggu kekuatan dari luar.
Saat Scarlet Phantom berada dalam kondisi logika dasar Nullification-nya terganggu, perlu campur tangan aktif terhadap panggung yang mereka bangun, dan entitas inti di area tersebut harus dikalahkan untuk memaksa pertunjukan berakhir.

Penilaian Risiko
Bahaya rendah. Saat muncul berkelompok, tingkat bahaya bisa naik menjadi sedang.

Status Containment
Sejumlah kecil di-contain di Celaeno Compound.

Langkah Containment
Unit Containment harus menyediakan ruang yang cukup untuk berdansa. Karena Anomaly ini ter-nullify secara alami saat pertunjukan berakhir, unit Containment harus terus memutar pertunjukan klasik yang pernah menarik Scarlet Phantom di layar besar, dan daftar putarnya harus diperbarui sesuai catatan kemunculan.

quote.en:
"The dead dance with the dead, and the ashes spin with the ashes."

[Anomaly Story]

"First Confirmation"
During the Scarlet Letter incident, Bureau personnel observed for the first time a massive, pitch-black coffin whose appearance matched no known anomaly. The only confirmable information mainly comes from the testimony of the Dimension Visitor. Roughly two hundred years ago, as a bystander, she witnessed the elimination process of the Fogden Game. From all the participants, only one woman, Inanna, survived to the end. As the victor, Inanna entered into a contract with a black coffin. The black coffin described by the Dimension Visitor matches the object discovered in this operation in both looks and traits. On this basis, we believe that the black coffin discovered in this operation is the same anomaly, the Fog Coffin, she witnessed two hundred years ago.

During this incident, the Fog Coffin was ritually awakened by Madam T, the leader of the Scarlet Letter. Madam T is the "Inanna" mentioned in the Dimension Visitor's testimony; she won the Fogden game two hundred years ago and entered into a contract with the coffin, which gives her the Offering Right to awaken the coffin. The ritual was carried out in the underground space of an abandoned building. Madam T offered up three anomalies: the Helm of Theseus, the Eternal Present, and the First Branch, and submitted her handwritten rules. Once the offerings and the rules were taken in by the Fog Coffin, the coffin door opened, presenting a portal to the Fogden. The portal stayed open for about an hour. Anyone who entered during that time automatically became a participant.

During this round of the game, several participants witnessed ■■■■ appear in the Fogden. The Fog Coffin's avatar and enforcer, the Fog Coffin Colossus, designated ■■■■ as its primary target and fought it, yet was ultimately destroyed by ■■■■. With the enforcer gone, the Fogden's Anomalous Realm began to collapse. At the same time, the Fog Coffin, which was still in the real world, crumbled into black dust before everyone.

Henceforth, it has been determined that the Fog Coffin has been nullified.

"The Initial Game"
In subsequent investigations, Madam T's surviving private records, together with statements from members of the Scarlet Letter, gradually pieced together the Fog Coffin's origins. This account did not come from official documentation, but from fragments Madam T herself privately gathered over many years. She called it "The Initial Game."
According to the records, the Fog Coffin first appeared on a nameless, isolated island. The island once held a lighthouse and was guarded by generations of keepers. They made a promise to the villagers on the shore: as long as the light stayed lit, no ship would lose its way. In return, the villagers regularly sent supplies.
Though remote, the coast was still caught in war. Surviving villagers gradually forgot their pact with the lighthouse keepers. No more provisions came, and the lighthouse had long since dimmed.
Until one day, a pitch-black coffin was swept ashore.
No one knew where it came from, or how long it took to arrive. The keeper opened the coffin but found nothing inside, except for a sentence carved into the coffin inside:
"Everyone, let's play a game."

[Characteristics]
It appeared as a massive, pitch-black coffin, with no inscriptions, no ornaments, and no markings. Its material was unknown, and it looked like it was in perfect condition.
When dormant, it remains asleep, and can only be awakened through a specific offering ritual. Awakening requires all of the following conditions to be met:
First, a contract bearer who is qualified to make an offering. The qualification must come from being a previous winner of the Fogden Game and having had formed a contract with the Fog Coffin.
Second, three anomaly artifacts offered by the contract bearer.
Third, written rules submitted in physical form, handwritten by the contractor, its contents being the rules of this Fogden game.
Once awakened, the Fog Coffin opens, revealing a portal leading to the Fogden, which itself is a confined Anomalous Realm. The portal stays open for about an hour. Once it closes, the coffin seals shut again, and it returns back to a dormant state, awaiting the next awakening.

[Anomaly Nexus]
The Fogdame's rules no longer enforceabe; the Fogden's anomalous realm destroyed.

[Risk Assessment]
In its dormancy, the coffin poses no danger. During the ritual, it devours the offerings chosen by the contractor. Once the coffin opens, there is almost zero possibility of survival.

[Containment/Guarantee Status]
Nullified
quote.id:
"Yang mati berdansa dengan yang mati, dan abu berputar bersama abu."

[Kisah Anomaly]

"Konfirmasi Pertama"
Saat insiden Scarlet Letter, personel Bureau untuk pertama kalinya melihat sebuah peti mati raksasa hitam pekat yang wujudnya tidak cocok dengan Anomaly mana pun yang dikenal. Satu-satunya informasi yang bisa dipastikan terutama berasal dari kesaksian Dimension Visitor. Sekitar dua ratus tahun lalu, sebagai saksi, ia menyaksikan proses eliminasi Fogden Game. Dari semua peserta, hanya satu wanita, Inanna, yang bertahan sampai akhir. Sebagai pemenang, Inanna menjalin kontrak dengan sebuah peti mati hitam. Peti hitam yang digambarkan Dimension Visitor cocok dengan objek yang ditemukan dalam operasi ini, baik penampilan maupun sifatnya. Berdasarkan ini, kami yakin peti hitam yang ditemukan dalam operasi ini adalah Anomaly yang sama, Fog Coffin, yang ia saksikan dua ratus tahun lalu.

Dalam insiden ini, Fog Coffin dibangkitkan lewat ritual oleh Madam T, pemimpin Scarlet Letter. Madam T adalah "Inanna" yang disebut dalam kesaksian Dimension Visitor; ia memenangkan Fogden Game dua ratus tahun lalu dan menjalin kontrak dengan peti itu, yang memberinya Offering Right untuk membangkitkan peti tersebut. Ritual itu dilakukan di ruang bawah tanah sebuah gedung terbengkalai. Madam T mempersembahkan tiga Anomaly: Helm of Theseus, Eternal Present, dan First Branch, lalu menyerahkan aturan yang ditulisnya sendiri. Begitu persembahan dan aturan itu diterima Fog Coffin, pintu peti terbuka dan memperlihatkan portal menuju Fogden. Portal tetap terbuka sekitar satu jam. Siapa pun yang masuk selama waktu itu otomatis menjadi peserta.

Dalam ronde permainan ini, beberapa peserta menyaksikan ■■■■ muncul di Fogden. Avatar sekaligus penegak aturan Fog Coffin, Fog Coffin Colossus, menetapkan ■■■■ sebagai target utamanya dan melawannya, tapi akhirnya dihancurkan oleh ■■■■. Dengan lenyapnya sang penegak, Anomalous Realm Fogden mulai runtuh. Pada saat yang sama, Fog Coffin, yang masih berada di dunia nyata, hancur menjadi debu hitam di hadapan semua orang.

Sejak saat itu, Fog Coffin dinyatakan sudah ter-nullify.

"Permainan Pertama"
Dalam penyelidikan berikutnya, catatan pribadi Madam T yang tersisa, ditambah keterangan anggota Scarlet Letter, perlahan merangkai asal-usul Fog Coffin. Kisah ini tidak berasal dari dokumen resmi, melainkan dari potongan-potongan yang dikumpulkan Madam T sendiri secara pribadi selama bertahun-tahun. Ia menyebutnya "The Initial Game".
Menurut catatan itu, Fog Coffin pertama kali muncul di sebuah pulau terpencil tanpa nama. Pulau itu dulu punya mercusuar yang dijaga para penjaga turun-temurun. Mereka berjanji kepada penduduk desa di pesisir: selama cahayanya tetap menyala, tak ada kapal yang akan tersesat. Sebagai gantinya, penduduk desa rutin mengirim perbekalan.
Meski terpencil, pesisir itu tetap terseret perang. Penduduk desa yang selamat perlahan melupakan perjanjian mereka dengan para penjaga mercusuar. Perbekalan tak lagi datang, dan mercusuar itu sudah lama meredup.
Sampai suatu hari, sebuah peti mati hitam pekat terdampar di pantai.
Tak ada yang tahu dari mana asalnya, atau berapa lama ia terombang-ambing sampai tiba. Sang penjaga membuka peti itu tapi tak menemukan apa pun di dalamnya, kecuali satu kalimat yang terukir di bagian dalam peti:
"Semuanya, ayo kita bermain."

[Karakteristik]
Berwujud peti mati raksasa hitam pekat, tanpa tulisan, tanpa hiasan, dan tanpa tanda. Bahannya tidak diketahui, dan tampak dalam kondisi sempurna.
Saat dorman, ia tetap tertidur, dan hanya bisa dibangkitkan lewat ritual persembahan tertentu. Untuk membangkitkannya, semua syarat berikut harus dipenuhi:
Pertama, pemegang kontrak yang berhak memberikan persembahan. Hak ini harus didapat sebagai pemenang Fogden Game sebelumnya yang sudah menjalin kontrak dengan Fog Coffin.
Kedua, tiga artefak Anomaly yang dipersembahkan pemegang kontrak.
Ketiga, aturan tertulis dalam bentuk fisik, ditulis tangan oleh pemegang kontrak, berisi aturan Fogden Game ronde itu.
Begitu bangkit, Fog Coffin terbuka dan memperlihatkan portal menuju Fogden, yang merupakan Anomalous Realm tertutup. Portal tetap terbuka sekitar satu jam. Begitu tertutup, peti itu tersegel kembali dan kembali ke kondisi dorman, menunggu kebangkitan berikutnya.

[Anomaly Nexus]
Aturan Fogdame tak lagi bisa ditegakkan; Anomalous Realm Fogden hancur.

[Penilaian Risiko]
Saat dorman, peti ini tidak berbahaya. Saat ritual, ia melahap persembahan yang dipilih pemegang kontrak. Begitu peti terbuka, kemungkinan bertahan hidup nyaris nol.

[Status Containment/Penjaminan]
Sudah di-nullify

quote.id: "Aku mendengarmu: dendammu, amarahmu, jerit kesakitanmu… Berdoalah kepadaku, dan akan kuberikan kebahagiaan tertinggi."

story.en:
Throughout history, with the emergence of the witch-hunt anomaly, victims who fell prey to human malice would crystallize into blood-red stones that radiate a crimson glow. Their souls, filled with resentment and unwillingness to accept their fate, would be imprisoned within, suffering endless torment and crying out day and night. If they are fortunate enough to be purified, those aggrieved souls will return to their original bodies, given a chance to rekindle the flame of life. But if they fail to receive timely purification, the bloody radiance of Oracle Stones will gradually fade, until it is completely consumed by the black taint of resentment.
At present, the only known way to purify Oracle Stones is through the power of the anomaly Blackbird. For more than five hundred years, Blackbird has diligently purified countless Oracle Stones scattered across the world since the witch-hunt era. However, most of those Oracle Stones are black, and no matter how much they are purified, the souls within can no longer return to the ranks of the living. All Blackbird can do is drive away the nightmares that have haunted them for centuries and pray that the souls who have endured centuries of suffering may finally sink into a peaceful slumber.
In the world of today, there is no longer any place for the witch-hunt anomaly to exist, and as civilization has advanced, the number of Oracle Stones has consequently dwindled. As the anomaly's power has weakened, Oracle Stones no longer carry the weight they once did. The Oracle Stones we encounter today are more often crystallizations of the malice within people's hearts. Yet Blackbird's work remains unchanged. Black birds still bring her glittering stones from all corners of the world, and she continues to purify them with the same devotion and diligence as she once did, until pure light envelops the Oracle Stones and one more trace of malice is erased from the world.

Characteristics
Throughout history, the souls of victims who fell prey to human malice would crystallize into Oracle Stones that radiate a blood-red glow.
If a red Oracle Stone is purified in time, the soul within will return to the world of the living. If it is not purified, the Oracle Stone will gradually be consumed by black taint, and the soul will never be able to return to life.
At present, the only known way to purify Oracle Stones is through the power of the anomaly Blackbird.
Oracle Stones have lost their original significance in the modern world, and the Oracle Stones we encounter today are more often crystallizations of the malice within people's hearts.

Anomaly Nexus
Being purified by the anomaly Blackbird.

Risk Assessment
No risk.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Not in containment.
story.id:
Sepanjang sejarah, seiring munculnya Anomaly perburuan penyihir, para korban yang menjadi mangsa kebencian manusia akan mengkristal menjadi batu merah darah yang memancarkan cahaya merah tua. Jiwa mereka, yang penuh dendam dan tak sudi menerima nasibnya, akan terpenjara di dalamnya, menderita siksaan tanpa akhir dan menjerit siang malam. Jika beruntung dimurnikan, jiwa-jiwa yang teraniaya itu akan kembali ke tubuh aslinya, diberi kesempatan untuk menyalakan kembali api kehidupan. Tapi jika tak segera dimurnikan, cahaya merah darah Oracle Stone perlahan memudar, sampai sepenuhnya ditelan noda hitam kebencian.
Saat ini, satu-satunya cara yang diketahui untuk memurnikan Oracle Stone adalah lewat kekuatan Anomaly Blackbird. Selama lebih dari lima ratus tahun, Blackbird dengan tekun memurnikan Oracle Stone yang tak terhitung, yang tersebar di seluruh dunia sejak era perburuan penyihir. Namun, sebagian besar Oracle Stone itu sudah hitam, dan seberapa pun dimurnikan, jiwa di dalamnya tak lagi bisa kembali ke dunia orang hidup. Yang bisa dilakukan Blackbird hanyalah mengusir mimpi buruk yang menghantui mereka selama berabad-abad dan berdoa agar jiwa-jiwa yang sudah menanggung penderitaan berabad-abad akhirnya bisa terlelap dengan damai.
Di dunia saat ini, tak ada lagi tempat bagi Anomaly perburuan penyihir, dan seiring majunya peradaban, jumlah Oracle Stone pun berkurang. Seiring melemahnya kekuatan Anomaly itu, Oracle Stone tak lagi membawa beban seperti dulu. Oracle Stone yang kita temui hari ini lebih sering merupakan kristalisasi kebencian di hati manusia. Namun, pekerjaan Blackbird tetap tak berubah. Burung-burung hitam masih membawakannya batu-batu berkilau dari segala penjuru dunia, dan ia terus memurnikannya dengan pengabdian dan ketekunan yang sama seperti dulu, sampai cahaya murni menyelimuti Oracle Stone dan satu lagi jejak kebencian terhapus dari dunia.

Karakteristik
Sepanjang sejarah, jiwa para korban yang menjadi mangsa kebencian manusia akan mengkristal menjadi Oracle Stone yang memancarkan cahaya merah darah.
Jika Oracle Stone merah dimurnikan tepat waktu, jiwa di dalamnya akan kembali ke dunia orang hidup. Jika tidak dimurnikan, Oracle Stone perlahan akan ditelan noda hitam, dan jiwa itu tak akan pernah bisa hidup kembali.
Saat ini, satu-satunya cara yang diketahui untuk memurnikan Oracle Stone adalah lewat kekuatan Anomaly Blackbird.
Oracle Stone sudah kehilangan makna aslinya di dunia modern, dan Oracle Stone yang kita temui hari ini lebih sering merupakan kristalisasi kebencian di hati manusia.

Anomaly Nexus
Dimurnikan oleh Anomaly Blackbird.

Penilaian Risiko
Tidak berisiko.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Tidak di-contain.
