story.en:
Kapanela rose from the icy river, soaked from head to toe and shivering in the evening wind. All he wanted to do was return home to the warmth of the stove and a dinner made by his loving mother. When he staggered to the bus stop, he realized he had missed the last bus.
"Just my luck…" he muttered, wondering about the route he would take home.
Just then, a bus pulled over by the roadside. He had never seen this bus before, and it looked nothing like any bus he had ever ridden. When the driver opened the door, Kapanela was shocked to see Xiaomin—the little dog he had once raised, who had died before he started middle school. Xiaomin had both paws on the steering wheel and wore a driver's cap.
Xiaomin honked the horn. "Hop on, Kapanela!"
"You can talk?!" Kapanela exclaimed. "I haven't seen you in so long, Xiaomin! I've missed you so much!"
Kapanela eagerly boarded the bus. As he watched the scenery pass by, he told Xiaomin about everything that had happened over the years, pouring out all his troubles about school.
The bus soon stopped at the next station, and a Frizzle climbed aboard.
"Want to try some of my French fries?" the Frizzle asked warmly. "I've never seen a human on this bus before!"
Kapanela picked up a fry from the Frizzle and put it in his mouth. It was crisp and well-salted, with the rich flavor of potato spreading across his tongue.
"It's delicious!" Kapanela cried. "Can we be friends? Then I'll have endless fries!"
"Of course! We can be best friends forever!"
The bus soon reached the next stop, where two Danzaburou climbed aboard. They appeared to be arguing, and almost looked ready to scuffle. Kapanela hurried to mediate between the two, and learned in turn that they were actually friends who were blaming each other for waking up late and nearly missing the bus! Thanks to Kapanela's mediation, they were able to agree and let the issue drop.
"Do you always mediate arguments between your friends at school, too?" one of the Danzaburou asked.
"No… I don't have any friends at school," Kapanela said. "They always bully me. One time, they even threw my homework into the river, so I had to go into the water to retrieve it. It's not so bad, though… It's not like anyone talks to me anyway. If they stopped bullying me, no one would pay attention to me at all."
"We'll be friends from now on, then."
Kapanela was overjoyed. In such a short time, he had somehow made many, many friends.
The bus stopped again, and a Mysty climbed aboard. It looked around the bus and quickly spotted the conspicuous Kapanela.
"Hey! What is a human doing here?" the Mysty demanded. "Get off, quick! We're almost at the Terminal Station. Once we get there, you won't be able to leave."
"What's at the Terminal Station?" Kapanela asked.
"I don't know. I've never been there either. They say that whether you're human or an Oddity, you only get one chance in your life to reach the Terminal Station."
"Please let me go with you, then. You're all my friends, and I've never had this many friends before. I'm having more fun on this bus than I've ever had in my life!"
Seeing that Kapanela could not be persuaded, the Mysty said nothing more.
After the bus had traveled for a while longer, Xiaomin suddenly spoke up. "Everyone, we've entered the Terminal Station. Please, look out the windows on both sides of the vehicle."
Kapanela pressed himself up against the window and glanced outside. The scenery of Hethereau was gone, replaced by a sky full of stars. More precisely, he was surrounded by stars, floating in outer space. Red, yellow, blue… Stars of every color glittered like sugar crystals. Kapanela gradually forgot the past, where he came from, his parents, the way home, and, eventually, who he was. Gazing at the vast, dazzling starscape, he exclaimed from the bottom of his heart—
"Oh my gosh, there are only stars from here on out…"

Anomaly Characteristics
In appearance, the Wayward Line has no significant differences from any other bus. Its overall body is only slightly larger.
The Anomaly has a unique ability to attract Oddities, especially low-level Oddities.
The time required for the Wayward Line to complete its entire route varies, usually depending on the number of Oddities that board at each stop.
The Anomaly can maintain a nearly constant speed while traveling. Its maximum speed ranges from roughly 40 to 45 miles per hour.
The Anomaly itself has no independent consciousness and does not respond to interference from the driver. This means the bus can easily be operated by unaffected humans or Oddities, which is one of the main reasons it is classified as an object.

Anomaly Nexus
Return the Anomaly to containment

Risk Assessment
Stable

Containment Status
Contained, with the Bureau of Anomaly Control acting as Guarantor, and operated under supervision.

Containment Measures
/
Experiment Record
The following experiments were conducted on the Anomalous Realm entered by the Wayward Line when it traveled to the Terminal Station under its own power:
Cameras and audio recorders were installed inside the bus. After it entered the Anomalous Realm, the video showed radial static, while the audio consisted of irregular low-frequency noise. The devices disconnected after a dozen seconds.
A tracked robot carrying cameras and collection equipment was used. After it entered the Anomalous Realm, its signal rapidly degraded and was lost within 5 to 8 seconds.
A low-level Oddity was used as a carrier for experimental equipment, with its behavior controlled through simple bioelectric neural stimulation. Its signal was lost instantly upon entering the Anomalous Realm.
Inference: The speed at which the Anomalous Realm blocks signals appears to correlate positively with the intelligence of those entering it. The more intelligent an object is determined to be, the sooner its connection with the outside world is lost.
story.id:
Kapanela keluar dari sungai yang sedingin es, basah kuyup dari ujung kepala sampai kaki dan menggigil diterpa angin sore. Ia hanya ingin pulang ke hangatnya tungku dan makan malam buatan ibunya yang penyayang. Saat ia terhuyung sampai ke halte, ia sadar sudah ketinggalan bus terakhir.
"Sial banget…" gumamnya, memikirkan rute yang akan ia tempuh untuk pulang.
Saat itu juga, sebuah bus menepi di pinggir jalan. Ia belum pernah melihat bus ini, dan bentuknya sama sekali tak mirip bus mana pun yang pernah ia naiki. Saat sopirnya membuka pintu, Kapanela kaget melihat Xiaomin, anjing kecil yang dulu ia pelihara, yang mati sebelum ia masuk SMP. Kedua kaki Xiaomin memegang setir dan ia memakai topi sopir.
Xiaomin membunyikan klakson. "Naik, Kapanela!"
"Kamu bisa ngomong?!" seru Kapanela. "Sudah lama banget aku nggak ketemu kamu, Xiaomin! Aku kangen banget!"
Kapanela naik ke bus dengan semangat. Sambil melihat pemandangan yang lewat, ia menceritakan kepada Xiaomin semua yang terjadi selama bertahun-tahun, mencurahkan semua masalahnya di sekolah.
Bus segera berhenti di halte berikutnya, dan seekor Frizzle naik.
"Mau coba kentang gorengku?" tanya Frizzle itu dengan ramah. "Aku belum pernah lihat manusia di bus ini!"
Kapanela mengambil sepotong kentang goreng dari Frizzle dan memasukkannya ke mulut. Renyah dan pas asinnya, dengan rasa kentang yang gurih menyebar di lidahnya.
"Enak!" seru Kapanela. "Kita bisa berteman, nggak? Nanti aku bisa makan kentang goreng terus!"
"Tentu saja! Kita bisa jadi sahabat selamanya!"
Bus segera tiba di halte berikutnya, tempat dua Danzaburou naik. Mereka tampak sedang bertengkar, bahkan hampir saling dorong. Kapanela buru-buru melerai keduanya, dan malah tahu bahwa mereka sebenarnya berteman yang saling menyalahkan karena bangun kesiangan dan nyaris ketinggalan bus! Berkat Kapanela yang melerai, mereka bisa sepakat dan melupakan masalahnya.
"Kamu juga selalu melerai teman-temanmu yang bertengkar di sekolah?" tanya salah satu Danzaburou.
"Nggak… Aku nggak punya teman di sekolah," jawab Kapanela. "Mereka selalu merundungku. Pernah, mereka bahkan membuang PR-ku ke sungai, jadi aku harus masuk ke air untuk mengambilnya. Tapi nggak apa-apa kok… Lagian nggak ada yang mau ngobrol sama aku. Kalau mereka berhenti merundungku, nggak bakal ada yang peduli sama aku sama sekali."
"Kalau begitu, mulai sekarang kita berteman."
Kapanela sangat gembira. Dalam waktu sesingkat itu, entah bagaimana ia punya banyak sekali teman.
Bus berhenti lagi, dan seekor Mysty naik. Ia melihat-lihat sekeliling bus dan cepat melihat Kapanela yang mencolok.
"Hei! Ngapain ada manusia di sini?" tanya Mysty itu. "Cepat turun! Kita hampir sampai di Terminal Station. Begitu sampai di sana, kamu nggak bakal bisa pergi."
"Ada apa di Terminal Station?" tanya Kapanela.
"Aku nggak tahu. Aku juga belum pernah ke sana. Katanya, mau manusia atau Oddity, kamu cuma punya satu kesempatan seumur hidup untuk sampai ke Terminal Station."
"Kalau begitu, biarkan aku ikut kalian. Kalian semua temanku, dan aku belum pernah punya teman sebanyak ini. Aku paling senang di bus ini dibanding seumur hidupku!"
Melihat Kapanela tak bisa dibujuk, Mysty itu tak berkata apa-apa lagi.
Setelah bus melaju beberapa lama lagi, Xiaomin tiba-tiba berbicara. "Semuanya, kita sudah memasuki Terminal Station. Silakan lihat ke luar jendela di kedua sisi kendaraan."
Kapanela menempelkan diri ke jendela dan melirik keluar. Pemandangan Hethereau sudah lenyap, tergantikan langit penuh bintang. Lebih tepatnya, ia dikelilingi bintang-bintang, melayang di luar angkasa. Merah, kuning, biru… Bintang-bintang dari segala warna berkilauan seperti kristal gula. Kapanela perlahan melupakan masa lalu, asal-usulnya, orang tuanya, jalan pulang, dan akhirnya, siapa dirinya. Menatap hamparan bintang yang luas dan menyilaukan, ia berseru dari lubuk hatinya—
"Ya ampun, mulai sekarang yang ada cuma bintang…"

Karakteristik Anomaly
Dari luar, Wayward Line tak berbeda jauh dari bus lainnya. Badannya secara keseluruhan hanya sedikit lebih besar.
Anomaly ini punya kemampuan unik menarik Oddity, terutama Oddity tingkat rendah.
Waktu yang dibutuhkan Wayward Line untuk menyelesaikan seluruh rutenya bervariasi, biasanya tergantung jumlah Oddity yang naik di setiap halte.
Anomaly ini bisa mempertahankan kecepatan yang nyaris konstan saat melaju. Kecepatan maksimumnya sekitar 40 hingga 45 mil per jam.
Anomaly ini sendiri tak punya kesadaran mandiri dan tidak merespons campur tangan sopir. Artinya, bus ini bisa dengan mudah dikemudikan manusia atau Oddity yang tidak terpengaruh, yang menjadi salah satu alasan utama ia digolongkan sebagai objek.

Anomaly Nexus
Kembalikan Anomaly ini ke Containment

Penilaian Risiko
Stabil

Status Containment
Di-contain, dengan Bureau of Anomaly Control sebagai penjamin, dan dioperasikan di bawah pengawasan.

Langkah Containment
/
Catatan Eksperimen
Eksperimen berikut dilakukan terhadap Anomalous Realm yang dimasuki Wayward Line saat melaju sendiri ke Terminal Station:
Kamera dan perekam suara dipasang di dalam bus. Setelah masuk ke Anomalous Realm, videonya menampilkan gangguan statis berbentuk radial, sementara audionya berisi derau frekuensi rendah yang tidak beraturan. Perangkat terputus setelah belasan detik.
Robot beroda rantai yang membawa kamera dan peralatan pengumpul data dipakai. Setelah masuk ke Anomalous Realm, sinyalnya cepat memburuk dan hilang dalam 5 sampai 8 detik.
Seekor Oddity tingkat rendah dipakai sebagai pembawa peralatan eksperimen, dengan perilakunya dikendalikan lewat rangsangan saraf bioelektrik sederhana. Sinyalnya langsung hilang begitu memasuki Anomalous Realm.
Dugaan: Kecepatan Anomalous Realm memblokir sinyal tampaknya berkorelasi positif dengan kecerdasan yang memasukinya. Semakin cerdas suatu objek, semakin cepat koneksinya dengan dunia luar terputus.

quote.en: "My entire life has been utterly, utterly ordinary."
quote.id: "Seluruh hidupku benar-benar, benar-benar biasa saja."

story.en:
Several monkeys were placed in an experimental enclosure, with food suspended above their heads. At first, every monkey desperately reached out for the food. But whenever one of them touched it, they were all visibly punished.
Gradually, the monkeys realized the pattern. Therefore, they all chose to stop reaching for the food.
Then, a new monkey was placed in the enclosure. Instinctively, it reached for the food, but the moment it tried, the other monkeys prevented it from doing so. Before long, the new monkey stopped thinking about the food above its head entirely.
Every monkey introduced afterward went through the same procedure. Eventually, even after all the original monkeys had left the enclosure, the remaining monkeys still refused to touch the food above them. Some of them may never have tried to touch it, even if they were never punished for doing so in the first place. Or perhaps the original rule—that touching the food would result in punishment—had ceased to exist long ago. None of the monkeys would ever know, however.
…
Although this is an Anomaly Profile, I still wanted to preserve the thought experiment above. We live in an orderly society, where many of the rules have no clear origin—much like the later-generation monkeys, who did not know why they could not touch the food above them. As ordinary people, we cannot afford the cost of defying the rules. All we can do is comply.
The Anomaly "Dreamaway Pillow" presents us with a similar Dreamscape: all you need to do is follow the crowd, hide in the shadows, and do what you are "supposed" to do. Deviant behavior is not permitted. As long as you follow everyone's choice and remain an ordinary person, you can obtain stable happiness for next to nothing.
The concept of a "pillow" has existed since ancient times, while the "Dreamaway Pillow" evolved from the modern soft pillow. This does not mean that such ideas only began to emerge in the modern era. Perhaps it is only now that we have the opportunity to rationally observe our own behavior—and that of the group as a whole.

Anomaly Characteristics
The "Dreamaway Pillow" appears to be an ordinary soft cotton pillow. When unused, it does not affect its surroundings. If someone uses the Anomaly pillow to fall asleep and enter a dream, the dream manifests as several consecutive, bizarre rooms, with indescribable monsters circling overhead, as if constantly monitoring the dreamer's every move.
This Anomaly only affects the images presented in people's dreams. It does not create a real Anomalous Realm.
Once someone uses the Anomaly to enter a dream, everyone else within a certain range will continue having separate dreams within the same environment until the Anomaly undergoes Nullification. The affected range varies, and it is currently believed that the number of affected people is capped, though at what number remains unknown. When the surrounding population is more dense, the affected range becomes significantly smaller.
The affected range moves as the user moves through space. In other words, if the user leaves the original area and enters another, the original area will no longer be affected by the Anomaly.
Most people will unconsciously perform the same actions as those around them in the dream. A small number of people have reported waking up within the dream and voluntarily leaving the crowd, only to be attacked by the monsters overhead. They immediately wake up and are unable to enter a dream again until the Anomaly undergoes Nullification.
Studies indicate that the Anomaly generally does not affect sleep quality. Some subjects reported feeling more relaxed upon waking after following the crowd and performing the same actions in their dreams.
The Anomaly's effects are automatically lifted when the pillow's user leaves the "room" in the dream. Users who leave the room cannot use the Anomaly to enter a dream again.

Anomaly Nexus
The user successfully leaves the room in the dream

Risk Assessment
No Risk

Containment Status
Uncontained
story.id:
Beberapa monyet ditempatkan di kandang eksperimen, dengan makanan digantung di atas kepala mereka. Awalnya, setiap monyet mati-matian meraih makanan itu. Tapi setiap kali salah satu menyentuhnya, mereka semua dihukum dengan jelas.
Perlahan, para monyet memahami polanya. Karena itu, mereka semua memilih berhenti meraih makanan.
Lalu, seekor monyet baru dimasukkan ke kandang. Secara naluriah, ia meraih makanan itu, tapi begitu mencoba, monyet-monyet lain mencegahnya. Tak lama kemudian, monyet baru itu sama sekali berhenti memikirkan makanan di atas kepalanya.
Setiap monyet yang dimasukkan setelahnya mengalami proses yang sama. Pada akhirnya, bahkan setelah semua monyet asli meninggalkan kandang, monyet-monyet yang tersisa tetap menolak menyentuh makanan di atas mereka. Sebagian mungkin tak pernah mencoba menyentuhnya, bahkan jika sejak awal mereka tak pernah dihukum karena itu. Atau mungkin aturan aslinya, bahwa menyentuh makanan akan berujung hukuman, sudah lama tak berlaku. Tapi tak satu pun monyet yang akan pernah tahu.
…
Meski ini Profil Anomaly, aku tetap ingin menyimpan eksperimen pikiran di atas. Kita hidup di masyarakat yang teratur, di mana banyak aturan tak jelas asal-usulnya, mirip monyet-monyet generasi berikutnya yang tak tahu kenapa mereka tak boleh menyentuh makanan di atas mereka. Sebagai orang biasa, kita tak sanggup menanggung harga melawan aturan. Yang bisa kita lakukan hanyalah patuh.
Anomaly "Dreamaway Pillow" menyajikan Dreamscape yang serupa: kamu cukup mengikuti orang banyak, bersembunyi dalam bayang-bayang, dan melakukan apa yang "seharusnya" kamu lakukan. Perilaku menyimpang tidak diizinkan. Selama kamu mengikuti pilihan semua orang dan tetap menjadi orang biasa, kamu bisa mendapat kebahagiaan yang stabil nyaris tanpa biaya.
Konsep "bantal" sudah ada sejak zaman kuno, sementara "Dreamaway Pillow" berkembang dari bantal empuk modern. Ini tidak berarti gagasan seperti ini baru muncul di era modern. Mungkin baru sekaranglah kita punya kesempatan untuk mengamati perilaku kita sendiri, juga perilaku kelompok secara keseluruhan, dengan rasional.

Karakteristik Anomaly
"Dreamaway Pillow" tampak seperti bantal kapuk empuk biasa. Saat tidak dipakai, ia tidak memengaruhi sekitarnya. Jika seseorang memakai bantal Anomaly ini untuk tidur dan masuk ke mimpi, mimpinya tampil sebagai beberapa ruangan aneh yang berurutan, dengan monster tak terlukiskan berputar di atas kepala, seolah terus mengawasi setiap gerak-gerik si pemimpi.
Anomaly ini hanya memengaruhi gambaran yang muncul dalam mimpi orang. Ia tidak menciptakan Anomalous Realm sungguhan.
Begitu seseorang memakai Anomaly ini untuk masuk ke mimpi, semua orang lain dalam jangkauan tertentu akan terus mengalami mimpi masing-masing di lingkungan yang sama sampai Anomaly ini ter-nullify. Jangkauan pengaruhnya bervariasi, dan saat ini diyakini jumlah orang yang terpengaruh ada batasnya, meski berapa angkanya belum diketahui. Saat penduduk di sekitar lebih padat, jangkauan pengaruhnya menjadi jauh lebih kecil.
Jangkauan pengaruhnya berpindah seiring pemakainya berpindah tempat. Dengan kata lain, jika pemakai meninggalkan area asal dan masuk ke area lain, area asal tak lagi terpengaruh Anomaly ini.
Kebanyakan orang tanpa sadar akan melakukan tindakan yang sama dengan orang-orang di sekitarnya dalam mimpi. Sebagian kecil orang melaporkan tersadar di dalam mimpi dan memilih meninggalkan kerumunan, lalu diserang monster di atas kepala. Mereka langsung terbangun dan tak bisa masuk ke mimpi lagi sampai Anomaly ini ter-nullify.
Penelitian menunjukkan Anomaly ini umumnya tidak memengaruhi kualitas tidur. Sebagian subjek melaporkan merasa lebih rileks saat bangun setelah mengikuti kerumunan dan melakukan tindakan yang sama dalam mimpi.
Efek Anomaly ini otomatis hilang saat pemakai bantal meninggalkan "ruangan" dalam mimpi. Pemakai yang meninggalkan ruangan tak bisa memakai Anomaly ini untuk masuk ke mimpi lagi.

Anomaly Nexus
Pemakai berhasil meninggalkan ruangan dalam mimpi

Penilaian Risiko
Tidak Berisiko

Status Containment
Belum di-contain

quote.en: "If She Stops Dreaming of You…"
quote.id: "Jika Ia Berhenti Memimpikanmu…"

story.en:
A new circus had come to town. But Alice's mother wouldn't let her go see it, saying that the circus was a vulgar, low-class form of entertainment. Instead, Alice was made to stay in her room, practice the piano, learn math, and do all those tedious, boring things.
But Alice still wanted to see the circus. So she began to dream. In her dream, she tried to create a mirror that could transport her anywhere. She envisioned every detail, from the outside in: its wood-grain frame, its smooth and reflective surface, and so on. Alice locked herself in her room and stopped practicing the piano and studying math. She neither ate nor drank. She only dreamed. Before long, the mirror was complete in her dream. She studied it carefully, as if her reflection were studying her in return. Unable to contain her excitement, Alice climbed inside. She walked through a long, dark tunnel and emerged in the center of the circus amid a blinding flash of light.
It turned out that Mr. Rabbit had been performing a conjuring act, and Alice had appeared from an empty box. The audience erupted in applause and showered Alice onstage with flowers. Alice was overjoyed. She joined the circus and performed with the troupe.
Gradually, Alice stopped trying to wake up. All she did each day was dream. Each and every day, in her dreams, she traveled through the mirror to the circus and performed alongside the troupe.
Then one day, a familiar voice suddenly rang out from the audience, interrupting the performance. Everyone turned to look. Standing among the spectators was a girl identical to Alice, who also claimed to be Alice. The other Alice ran onto the stage and confronted the original, demanding to know why she wasn't practicing the piano or studying math.
Alice panicked and asked, "Why should I have to do such boring things?"
"Because," the other Alice claimed, "you're just another version of me that I dreamed up. I needed you to do those boring things in my dreams so I'd have time to come see the circus."
Alice froze. She realized that her body was beginning to dissolve, spilling into the pool on the stage. Alice disappeared, like a drop of water vanishing into an ocean.
"Since you can't do those boring things for me," the other Alice continued,
"I've decided to stop dreaming about you entirely."

Anomaly Characteristics
The mirror's surface produces a cloudy reflection that cannot render clear shapes.
It reflects very little light, which is one reason it cannot render clear shapes.
The mirror strongly absorbs light, presumably because of the space behind its surface.
The mirror itself cannot be shattered, and any cracks caused by damage quickly repair themselves.
The mirror's surface appears to be made of a nonlinear fluid. It becomes exceptionally hard when struck with great force, but feels like a viscous, adhesive fluid when touched lightly.

Anomaly Nexus
Find the mirror that serves as the exit

Risk Assessment
Stable

Containment Status
Following its risk assessment, the Bureau has guaranteed the anomaly for use as an amusement park attraction

Containment Measures
/
Experiment Record
To explore the Anomalous Realm behind the mirror, the researchers initiated the Ariadne Project. Portions of the plan are as follows:
Researchers wear specially designed orange protective suits and explore the space in teams of four.
Everyone must carry a "Red Thread," a device that leaves marks in the form of pheromone traces. Each "Red Thread" can operate for thirty minutes.
All researchers must return to the nearest station before the "Red Thread" runs out.
The food ration consists of one raisin cake to restore energy and a serving of black tea soda to recover their sanity.
Each exploration cycle lasts seven days. After seven days, all researchers who participated in that cycle must exit the project and undergo psychological evaluations lasting from one to six months.
story.id:
Sebuah sirkus baru datang ke kota. Tapi ibu Alice tak mengizinkannya menonton, katanya sirkus adalah hiburan kasar kelas rendahan. Sebaliknya, Alice disuruh tetap di kamarnya, berlatih piano, belajar matematika, dan mengerjakan semua hal yang membosankan itu.
Tapi Alice tetap ingin menonton sirkus. Maka ia mulai bermimpi. Dalam mimpinya, ia mencoba menciptakan cermin yang bisa membawanya ke mana saja. Ia membayangkan setiap detailnya, dari luar ke dalam: bingkainya yang bermotif serat kayu, permukaannya yang halus dan memantulkan cahaya, dan seterusnya. Alice mengunci diri di kamar dan berhenti berlatih piano dan belajar matematika. Ia tak makan dan tak minum. Ia hanya bermimpi. Tak lama kemudian, cermin itu selesai dalam mimpinya. Ia mengamatinya dengan saksama, seolah pantulannya balik mengamatinya. Tak bisa menahan kegembiraan, Alice memanjat masuk. Ia berjalan melewati terowongan panjang yang gelap dan keluar di tengah sirkus di tengah kilatan cahaya yang menyilaukan.
Ternyata Mr. Rabbit sedang membawakan atraksi sulap, dan Alice muncul dari sebuah kotak kosong. Penonton bertepuk tangan meriah dan melempari Alice di panggung dengan bunga. Alice sangat gembira. Ia bergabung dengan sirkus dan tampil bersama rombongan.
Perlahan, Alice berhenti berusaha bangun. Yang ia lakukan setiap hari hanyalah bermimpi. Setiap hari, dalam mimpinya, ia melewati cermin ke sirkus dan tampil bersama rombongan.
Lalu suatu hari, suara yang akrab tiba-tiba terdengar dari penonton, menghentikan pertunjukan. Semua orang menoleh. Di antara penonton berdiri seorang gadis yang persis sama dengan Alice, yang juga mengaku sebagai Alice. Alice yang lain berlari ke panggung dan menghadapi Alice yang asli, menanyakan kenapa ia tidak berlatih piano atau belajar matematika.
Alice panik dan bertanya, "Kenapa aku harus mengerjakan hal-hal yang membosankan itu?"
"Karena," kata Alice yang lain, "kamu cuma versi lain diriku yang kuimpikan. Aku butuh kamu mengerjakan hal-hal membosankan itu dalam mimpiku supaya aku punya waktu menonton sirkus."
Alice membeku. Ia sadar tubuhnya mulai larut, tumpah ke kolam di atas panggung. Alice lenyap, bagai setetes air yang hilang di lautan.
"Karena kamu tak bisa mengerjakan hal-hal membosankan itu untukku," lanjut Alice yang lain,
"aku memutuskan berhenti memimpikanmu sama sekali."

Karakteristik Anomaly
Permukaan cermin menghasilkan pantulan keruh yang tak bisa menampilkan bentuk dengan jelas.
Ia memantulkan sangat sedikit cahaya, yang menjadi salah satu alasan ia tak bisa menampilkan bentuk dengan jelas.
Cermin ini sangat kuat menyerap cahaya, diduga karena ruang di balik permukaannya.
Cermin itu sendiri tak bisa dipecahkan, dan retakan apa pun akibat kerusakan cepat pulih dengan sendirinya.
Permukaan cermin tampaknya terbuat dari cairan non-linear. Ia menjadi sangat keras saat dipukul dengan kuat, tapi terasa seperti cairan kental dan lengket saat disentuh pelan.

Anomaly Nexus
Temukan cermin yang menjadi pintu keluar

Penilaian Risiko
Stabil

Status Containment
Setelah penilaian risiko, Bureau telah menjamin Anomaly ini untuk dipakai sebagai wahana taman hiburan

Langkah Containment
/
Catatan Eksperimen
Untuk menjelajahi Anomalous Realm di balik cermin, para peneliti memulai Ariadne Project. Sebagian rencananya sebagai berikut:
Para peneliti memakai pakaian pelindung oranye yang dirancang khusus dan menjelajahi ruang itu dalam tim berempat.
Semua orang wajib membawa "Red Thread", alat yang meninggalkan tanda berupa jejak feromon. Setiap "Red Thread" bisa bekerja selama tiga puluh menit.
Semua peneliti harus kembali ke pos terdekat sebelum "Red Thread" habis.
Ransum makanannya terdiri dari satu kue kismis untuk memulihkan tenaga dan seporsi soda teh hitam untuk memulihkan kewarasan.
Setiap siklus penjelajahan berlangsung tujuh hari. Setelah tujuh hari, semua peneliti yang ikut dalam siklus itu harus keluar dari proyek dan menjalani evaluasi psikologis selama satu hingga enam bulan.

quote.en:
Anomaly Story
Did I lock the door? Did I turn off the lights? Did I turn off the faucet? These questions pile up minutes after you leave home. You keep replaying the details in your memory: the twist of the handle, the feel of the switch… but memories aren't entirely reliable. You want to run back and check again, just to feel at ease.
This is a form of compulsive doubt, and only a lucky few aren't troubled by it. Those who are, however, are tormented by it again and again. Did I lock the door? What if I didn't? Won't my home get robbed? Did I turn off the faucet? What if I didn't? The water will keep flowing and flowing until it floods the room, then the hallway, then the stairwell, then the entire building… These increasingly catastrophic imaginings spread through the mind, and from them, the "Faucet Left Running" was born. It is the embodiment of baseless fear, thus, the water that flows out appears dark and muddy, sometimes takes the form of monsters. After all, how could catastrophic imaginings exist without monsters?

Anomaly Characteristics
· Manifests as a sink with a faucet. The faucet is in the open position, with dark water continuously flowing from it.
· The dark water flowing from the faucet is not affected by gravity and can spread in any direction. In most cases, the water does not spread directly into the real world, but expands through other means that connect to the Anomalous Realm.
· Occasionally, highly aggressive entities appear within the dark water.
· Once the faucet is turned off, the sink and water will disappear.

Anomaly Nexus
Find the faucet, turn it off.

Risk Assessment
The water exhibits aggressive behavior and is a threat. Prompt nullification is required.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Not contained.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/
quote.id:
Kisah Anomaly
Sudah kunci pintu belum? Sudah matikan lampu belum? Sudah tutup keran belum? Pertanyaan-pertanyaan ini menumpuk beberapa menit setelah kamu keluar rumah. Kamu terus memutar ulang detailnya dalam ingatan: putaran gagang pintu, rasa saat menekan sakelar… tapi ingatan tidak sepenuhnya bisa diandalkan. Kamu ingin berlari pulang dan mengecek lagi, sekadar supaya tenang.
Ini adalah bentuk keraguan kompulsif, dan hanya segelintir orang beruntung yang tidak terganggu olehnya. Tapi bagi yang mengalaminya, mereka tersiksa berulang kali. Sudah kunci pintu belum? Bagaimana kalau belum? Nanti rumahku dibobol maling, kan? Sudah tutup keran belum? Bagaimana kalau belum? Airnya akan terus mengalir sampai membanjiri kamar, lalu lorong, lalu tangga, lalu seluruh gedung… Bayangan bencana yang makin parah ini menyebar di pikiran, dan dari situlah "Faucet Left Running" lahir. Ia adalah perwujudan ketakutan yang tidak berdasar, sehingga air yang keluar tampak gelap dan keruh, terkadang berwujud monster. Lagi pula, bagaimana bayangan bencana bisa ada tanpa monster?

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Muncul sebagai wastafel dengan keran. Kerannya dalam posisi terbuka, dengan air gelap yang terus mengalir darinya.
· Air gelap yang mengalir dari keran tidak terpengaruh gravitasi dan bisa menyebar ke segala arah. Dalam kebanyakan kasus, airnya tidak langsung menyebar ke dunia nyata, tapi meluas lewat cara lain yang terhubung ke Anomalous Realm.
· Sesekali, entitas yang sangat agresif muncul di dalam air gelap itu.
· Begitu keran ditutup, wastafel dan airnya akan menghilang.

Anomaly Nexus
Temukan kerannya, lalu tutup.

Penilaian Risiko
Airnya menunjukkan perilaku agresif dan menjadi ancaman. Perlu segera di-nullify.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Belum di-contain.

Langkah Containment
/

Catatan Eksperimen
/

Derivative Anomaly
/

quote.en: "A rain to end the world, flowing from a wound upon reality's skin."
quote.id: "Hujan pengakhir dunia, mengalir dari luka di kulit kenyataan."

story.en:
The Hypervortex is a highly dangerous Anomaly that suddenly appeared in New Helios, archived under number N-0824(Ph). The Hypervortex appeared and underwent nullification very quickly, yet in that brief window, it caused devastating destruction, nearly obliterating all affected areas of New Helios and resulting in countless casualties and property losses.

The Hypervortex can be divided into three parts: the storm, the halo, and the core. Currently, we cannot confirm whether the Hypervortex's appearance created the storm, or whether it emerged from within the storm. The thick clouds during the New Helios incident was one of the reasons early warnings were not issued. Under the Hypervortex's influence, precipitation from the storm cloud causes physical laws within the rainfall area to fall into chaos. The rain erodes the material structure of anything it touches, and organisms that come into contact with the rain lose control of their bodies, compulsively staring up at the sky. Protective equipment used by JTF, including the Black Box Mask, can resist rain erosion to some degree, but cannot completely block its effects.
Those who look up at the sky under the rain's influence will inevitably see the Hypervortex's halo, and unfortunately… by that point, there is no turning back. Directly viewing the halo instantly destroys the minds of ordinary people. Of those rescued from the ruins of New Helios after the Hypervortex's nullification, many had suffered brain death or become vegetative. Those with milder symptoms still had severe cognitive disorders, amnesia, or other post-traumatic conditions. Survivors who were fortunate enough to avoid the rain and did not directly look at the halo mostly escaped direct harm from the Hypervortex. According to feedback from Espers who participated in rescue operations, Espers can briefly look at the halo without serious injury, but will only see chaotic, bizarre images and experience tremendous pain, as if their minds were being torn apart.
Ironically, despite being an Anomaly that "cannot be looked at," its Nexus is surprisingly fragile. The Hypervortex began undergoing natural nullification from the moment it appeared, and directly looking at its core greatly accelerates the nullification process. Strangely, looking at the Hypervortex's core is harmless. The core is protected by layers of halos and thick storm clouds. The core has no describable physical form. Only "■■■■■" and "■■" truly witnessed the Hypervortex's core. According to eyewitness accounts, it looked like a "rift," or even a "wound." The erroneous info overflowing from the rift conflicted with the physical laws of reality and common sense, thus producing the phenomena including the storm and the halo.
After the Hypervortex's nullification, the damage it caused did not disappear, and the danger of secondary disasters cannot be underestimated. Surge Anomalies, primarily Protocores, appeared in large numbers within the Hypervortex's area of influence, attacking everything around them. Even after the Hypervortex's nullification, these Surge Anomalies did not vanish. Contrary to initial predictions, the Hypervortex's nullification left behind more than just ruins and rubble. Floating buildings, trees growing in reverse, steel reinforcement bars slowly branching like limbs… The city displays a twisted form of "prosperity," yet is no longer suitable for human habitation. There are detailed plans on clearing the ruins and rebuilding the city, with enormous workforces and resources being committed to the cause.

There were many witnesses to the Hypervortex, but most of them only saw the halo. Even if they were lucky enough to survive, we cannot extract useful information from them. Researchers later speculated based on the core's nature that the Hypervortex is essentially some kind of… space, region, or something similar, originating from outside our world, which intersected with ours. That world operates on a completely different logic, and the conflict caused by the leaked erroneous info led to everything that followed. We know very little about that world, but this may be fortunate. Directly viewing that world would probably fry my brain. The Hypervortex's appearance also caused some disturbances within the Circle, though those were unrelated to the Hypervortex itself.
In this Anomaly disaster, we did not come away empty-handed. We discovered… Insufficient clearance. Unable to access.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Divided into three parts: storm, halo, and core.
· Rain from the storm cloud alters physical laws, erodes material structures, and causes those who contact the rain to look up at the Hypervortex.
· Those who look at the halo suffer severe mental damage. Espers have better resistance but are not immune to it.
· The core is a rift with no describable physical form. Looking at the core accelerates the Hypervortex's nullification process.

Anomaly Nexus
The core being directly observed by someone.

Risk Assessment
Extremely high hazard. Has the potential to destroy an entire city.

Containment/Guarantee Status
The only known individual has been nullified. No containment was performed.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/
story.id:
Hypervortex adalah Anomaly yang sangat berbahaya yang tiba-tiba muncul di New Helios, diarsipkan dengan nomor N-0824(Ph). Hypervortex muncul dan ter-nullify dengan sangat cepat, tapi dalam waktu singkat itu, ia menimbulkan kehancuran dahsyat, nyaris memusnahkan seluruh area New Helios yang terdampak dan menyebabkan korban jiwa serta kerugian harta yang tak terhitung.

Hypervortex bisa dibagi menjadi tiga bagian: badai, lingkaran cahaya, dan inti. Saat ini, kami belum bisa memastikan apakah kemunculan Hypervortex yang menciptakan badai, atau ia muncul dari dalam badai. Awan tebal saat insiden New Helios menjadi salah satu alasan peringatan dini tidak dikeluarkan. Di bawah pengaruh Hypervortex, hujan dari awan badai membuat hukum fisika di area hujan menjadi kacau. Hujan mengikis struktur materi apa pun yang disentuhnya, dan makhluk hidup yang terkena hujan kehilangan kendali atas tubuhnya, terpaksa terus menatap langit. Perlengkapan pelindung yang dipakai JTF, termasuk Black Box Mask, bisa menahan pengikisan hujan sampai batas tertentu, tapi tidak bisa memblokir efeknya sepenuhnya.
Mereka yang menatap langit di bawah pengaruh hujan pasti akan melihat lingkaran cahaya Hypervortex, dan sayangnya… pada titik itu, sudah tak ada jalan kembali. Melihat lingkaran cahaya itu secara langsung seketika menghancurkan pikiran orang biasa. Dari mereka yang diselamatkan dari reruntuhan New Helios setelah Hypervortex ter-nullify, banyak yang mengalami mati otak atau koma permanen. Mereka yang gejalanya lebih ringan tetap mengalami gangguan kognitif parah, amnesia, atau kondisi pascatrauma lainnya. Penyintas yang beruntung terhindar dari hujan dan tidak melihat lingkaran cahaya secara langsung sebagian besar lolos dari bahaya langsung Hypervortex. Menurut keterangan Esper yang ikut operasi penyelamatan, Esper bisa melihat lingkaran cahaya itu sebentar tanpa cedera serius, tapi hanya akan melihat gambaran kacau dan ganjil serta merasakan sakit luar biasa, seolah pikiran mereka dirobek.
Ironinya, meski merupakan Anomaly yang "tidak boleh dilihat", Nexus-nya ternyata rapuh. Hypervortex mulai ter-nullify secara alami sejak saat ia muncul, dan menatap intinya secara langsung sangat mempercepat proses Nullification. Anehnya, menatap inti Hypervortex tidak berbahaya. Inti dilindungi lapisan-lapisan lingkaran cahaya dan awan badai yang tebal. Inti tidak punya wujud fisik yang bisa digambarkan. Hanya "■■■■■" dan "■■" yang benar-benar menyaksikan inti Hypervortex. Menurut keterangan saksi mata, ia tampak seperti sebuah "retakan", bahkan sebuah "luka". Informasi keliru yang meluap dari retakan itu bertentangan dengan hukum fisika dan akal sehat dunia nyata, sehingga menimbulkan fenomena seperti badai dan lingkaran cahaya.
Setelah Hypervortex ter-nullify, kerusakan yang ditimbulkannya tidak hilang, dan bahaya bencana susulan tidak bisa diremehkan. Surge Anomaly, terutama Protocore, muncul dalam jumlah besar di area pengaruh Hypervortex, menyerang segala sesuatu di sekitarnya. Bahkan setelah Hypervortex ter-nullify, Surge Anomaly ini tidak lenyap. Bertentangan dengan perkiraan awal, Nullification Hypervortex meninggalkan lebih dari sekadar reruntuhan dan puing. Gedung yang melayang, pohon yang tumbuh terbalik, batang tulangan baja yang perlahan bercabang seperti anggota tubuh… Kota itu menampilkan bentuk "kemakmuran" yang menyimpang, tapi tak lagi layak dihuni manusia. Ada rencana terperinci untuk membersihkan reruntuhan dan membangun kembali kota, dengan tenaga kerja dan sumber daya besar yang dikerahkan untuk itu.

Ada banyak saksi Hypervortex, tapi kebanyakan hanya melihat lingkaran cahayanya. Meski beruntung selamat, kami tak bisa menggali informasi berguna dari mereka. Para peneliti kemudian menduga berdasarkan sifat intinya bahwa Hypervortex pada dasarnya semacam… ruang, wilayah, atau sesuatu yang serupa, yang berasal dari luar dunia kita dan bersinggungan dengan dunia kita. Dunia itu bekerja dengan logika yang sama sekali berbeda, dan konflik akibat informasi keliru yang bocor memicu semua yang terjadi setelahnya. Kami hanya tahu sedikit tentang dunia itu, tapi mungkin ini justru keberuntungan. Melihat dunia itu secara langsung mungkin akan membuat otakku gosong. Kemunculan Hypervortex juga menimbulkan beberapa gejolak di dalam Circle, meski itu tidak berkaitan dengan Hypervortex itu sendiri.
Dalam bencana Anomaly ini, kami tidak pulang dengan tangan kosong. Kami menemukan… Izin akses tidak mencukupi. Tidak bisa diakses.

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Dibagi menjadi tiga bagian: badai, lingkaran cahaya, dan inti.
· Hujan dari awan badai mengubah hukum fisika, mengikis struktur materi, dan membuat mereka yang terkena hujan menatap Hypervortex.
· Mereka yang melihat lingkaran cahaya mengalami kerusakan mental parah. Esper punya daya tahan lebih baik tapi tidak kebal.
· Intinya adalah retakan tanpa wujud fisik yang bisa digambarkan. Menatap intinya mempercepat proses Nullification Hypervortex.

Anomaly Nexus
Intinya diamati langsung oleh seseorang.

Penilaian Risiko
Bahaya sangat tinggi. Berpotensi menghancurkan seluruh kota.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Satu-satunya individu yang diketahui sudah ter-nullify. Tidak ada Containment yang dilakukan.

quote.en:
Anomaly Story
Picture this: a group of expressionless people ascending or descending through the open air. Sounds creepy and funny at the same time, right? But that's exactly what's happening in every elevator out there.
The earliest elevators weren't so enclosed. You could see the gaps between floors from inside them. Only later, for safety or whatever reason, did elevators become fully sealed. The doors open, people walk in, doors close, and when they open again, the world outside has become completely different. For those inside, once the doors close, the outside world becomes a complete unknown.
Most people trust elevators, believing this machine will dutifully deliver them to their destination. A pitiful few, both imaginative and insecure, feel it's dangerous to be locked in an enclosed space and left at the mercy of machinery, fearing the unknown that lies beyond their line of sight. Even after being delivered to the correct floor nine hundred and ninety-nine times, they still fear that on the thousandth ride, when the doors open, they'll be greeted by a terrifying scene…
One such poor wretch's imagination actually came true. When the elevator doors opened before him, lights flickered, eerie sounds persisted, and unfamiliar dark water flowed into the elevator. This was how Level Proliferation was first discovered. Fortunately, this poor wretch already worked in Anomaly-related fields and didn't pass out from the sudden abnormality, so he can still sit here now, writing the profile for this obliging Anomaly.

Anomaly Characteristics
· An Anomaly that may occur in elevators with enclosed views in buildings of three floors or higher. This Anomaly will not appear in elevators where the outside can be observed from inside, such as transparent sightseeing elevators.
· Manifests as an elevator malfunction where the elevator cannot reach its original floors and has a high probability of connecting to random Anomalous Realms. Additionally, announcements or music occasionally appear out of nowhere inside the elevator.
· Its nature resembles a peculiar elevator malfunction that forcibly connects random elevators to strange floors, while stairs in the same building are completely unaffected.
· Destroying the malfunctioning elevator and replacing it with a new one will eliminate this phenomenon.
· Dismantling the connected Anomalous Realm will cause the elevator to automatically repair itself ahead of schedule, meaning the problem to solve is not the elevator itself, but the other anomalies outside it.

Anomaly Nexus
Insist on not using the malfunctioning elevator and taking the stairs for at least one year (exact required varies). The elevator will repair itself back to a normal elevator as if healing on its own.

Risk Assessment
Hazard level fluctuates depending on the Anomalous Realm the elevator connects to, with an extreme range between upper and lower limits. For ordinary people and Anomaly Hunters without sufficient preparation, the best advice is: just take the stairs until the elevator is fixed. Think of it as exercise, what's wrong with that?

quote.id:
Kisah Anomaly
Bayangkan ini: sekelompok orang tanpa ekspresi naik atau turun melayang di udara terbuka. Terdengar seram sekaligus lucu, kan? Tapi itulah yang terjadi di setiap lift.
Lift-lift pertama tidak setertutup ini. Dari dalam, kamu bisa melihat celah di antara lantai. Baru belakangan, demi keamanan atau alasan lain, lift dibuat tertutup sepenuhnya. Pintu terbuka, orang masuk, pintu tertutup, dan saat terbuka lagi, dunia di luar sudah berubah total. Bagi yang ada di dalam, begitu pintu tertutup, dunia luar menjadi hal yang sama sekali tidak diketahui.
Kebanyakan orang memercayai lift, yakin mesin ini akan dengan patuh mengantar mereka ke tujuan. Segelintir orang malang yang imajinatif sekaligus mudah cemas merasa berbahaya terkurung di ruang tertutup dan pasrah pada mesin, takut pada hal tak dikenal di luar jangkauan pandangan mereka. Bahkan setelah diantar ke lantai yang benar sembilan ratus sembilan puluh sembilan kali, mereka tetap takut bahwa di perjalanan keseribu, saat pintu terbuka, mereka akan disambut pemandangan mengerikan…
Imajinasi salah satu orang malang seperti itu ternyata menjadi kenyataan. Saat pintu lift terbuka di hadapannya, lampu berkedip, suara-suara ganjil terus terdengar, dan air gelap yang asing mengalir masuk ke lift. Begitulah Level Proliferation pertama kali ditemukan. Untungnya, orang malang ini sudah bekerja di bidang yang berkaitan dengan Anomaly dan tidak pingsan karena keanehan mendadak itu, sehingga ia masih bisa duduk di sini sekarang, menulis profil Anomaly yang baik hati ini.

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Anomaly yang bisa muncul di lift berpandangan tertutup di gedung berlantai tiga atau lebih. Anomaly ini tidak akan muncul di lift yang memungkinkan pemandangan luar terlihat dari dalam, seperti lift kaca untuk wisata.
· Muncul sebagai kerusakan lift, di mana lift tidak bisa mencapai lantai aslinya dan kemungkinan besar terhubung ke Anomalous Realm acak. Selain itu, pengumuman atau musik sesekali terdengar entah dari mana di dalam lift.
· Sifatnya menyerupai kerusakan lift yang aneh, yang memaksa lift acak terhubung ke lantai-lantai ganjil, sementara tangga di gedung yang sama sama sekali tidak terpengaruh.
· Menghancurkan lift yang rusak dan menggantinya dengan yang baru akan menghilangkan fenomena ini.
· Membongkar Anomalous Realm yang terhubung akan membuat lift memperbaiki dirinya sendiri lebih cepat, artinya masalah yang harus diselesaikan bukan liftnya, melainkan Anomaly lain di luarnya.

Anomaly Nexus
Bersikeras tidak memakai lift yang rusak dan naik tangga setidaknya selama satu tahun (lamanya bervariasi). Lift akan memperbaiki dirinya kembali menjadi lift normal, seolah sembuh dengan sendirinya.

Penilaian Risiko
Tingkat bahayanya berubah-ubah tergantung Anomalous Realm yang terhubung dengan lift, dengan rentang batas atas dan bawah yang ekstrem. Bagi orang biasa dan Anomaly Hunter yang tidak cukup persiapan, saran terbaiknya: naik tangga saja sampai liftnya pulih. Anggap saja olahraga, apa salahnya?

quote.en: "A carp emerges from the chasm of heaven, the tide flows back through the mortal realm. The Dragon Gate stands tall and timeless, ever awaiting the return of shimmering scales."
quote.id: "Seekor ikan mas muncul dari jurang langit, pasang mengalir kembali melintasi dunia fana. Dragon Gate berdiri tegak dan abadi, selalu menanti kembalinya sisik yang berkilauan."

story.en:
As one of the oldest anomalies, Tidal Ascension has existed in this world long before paper and pens. Whenever it manifests, it is accompanied by gentle rain falling from the sky and all vegetation sprouting forth into spring. Even the most barren and desolate lands are revitalized. Thus, in an age when every blade of grass was sacred, Tidal Ascension was regarded as an auspicious blessing from the heavens. Simple folk would hold feasts and celebrations of song and dance, commemorating this phenomenon through various ceremonial traditions. Yet one ritual was performed everywhere without exception: the leaping of the Dragon Gate.
When the ritual began, people would construct a towering Dragon Gate. The Skyfish Banners that migrated along with the Tidal Ascension phenomenon would then compete to leap over it, while skilled performers would cleverly maneuver against them, preventing them from crossing the Dragon Gate. Yes, I said preventing, not assisting. This has been the custom since ancient times, and even though the reasons for it have long since faded into obscurity, later generations have continued to follow it strictly. Needless to say, such a fantastical and grand performance won the adoration of all children, and so Tidal Ascension took on another layer of meaning: to fulfill childhood dreams together with the youth, so that they would carry a heart that never loses its innocence.
The ethereal colorful carps have no physical form and cannot actually be harmed or blocked, but they respond to their opponents' actions accordingly. Stopping them is not difficult, as if this spectacle itself deliberately cooperates with humans to present the Dragon Gate trial more romantically to the eyes of eager children. When encountering obstacles, the carp blow bubbles, trapping those who block them from leaping over the Dragon Gate. These light bubbles carry the people inside up into the air before gently floating back down, and so children eagerly join in. Weighing less, children often fly higher, high enough to vanish amidst the clouds and glimpse the homeland of the carp. Such rituals would eventually transform into joyful games, and the carp would complete their Dragon Gate trial amidst laughter. The translucent colorful carp that failed to leap over the Dragon Gate would wave their tails and ascend like fireworks, gradually vanishing into the distant sky. Thus the celebration would come to a perfect close, and the children would continue to grow while cherishing the beautiful memories of that day.
This celebration continued until a certain ceremony in a certain place in a certain year. In retrospect, it was likely that some curious young people deliberately allowed the carp to successfully leap over the Dragon Gate…
A witness once told their children and grandchildren what happened that day: it was an extraordinarily magnificent dragon, rising from the Faraway land. "A great dragon made of countless colorful carp! It circled round and round in the sky, with fish constantly swimming into its body from all directions. Then a river in the sky descended to meet it, and the dragon followed that heavenly stream back into the clouds."
It was not until several days later, when the last of the fish had scattered and vanished, that people discovered everyone who had participated in the ceremony at that place had disappeared. Where the village once stood was now silent, yet the vegetation had grown astonishingly lush… Even the tallest chimney was covered in countless flowers. Some said they were punished for angering the spirits with their irreverence toward the ritual. Others said they were chosen by the dragon formed from fish and taken to the heavens, becoming new colorful carp awaiting the next migration.
However, all we can confirm is that this Anomaly may cause extraordinary consequences after evolving, that is, after successfully leaping over the Dragon Gate. From every perspective, we should do our utmost to avoid repeating this mistake. As recorded in ancient texts restored by archaeologists: "…The shimmering scales came from the nine heavens in great numbers, seeking to cross the Dragon Gate. Wherever they passed, sweet rain fell upon the world and all vegetation was revived. All people celebrated, and this became an established custom, passed down through generations… To prevent disaster, there is but one rule: they must not be allowed to cross the Dragon Gate."
Regrettably, after more and more people learned the truth, it became impossible to approach this phenomenon with the same pure innocence as before. The ritual of leaping the Dragon Gate has gradually become an ancient ceremony only found in history books… The children of yesteryear have long been swallowed by the river of time, remembered by none… Only the colorful carp still return to the human world, and again.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Accompanying that slender river from the heavens, the translucent fish shadows that migrate here seek the trial of leaping over the Dragon Gate.
· Ignores geographic conditions. Able to revitalize the surrounding area.
· Failed trials result in a 'return to the sky', while successful ones cause the Anomaly to evolve.

Anomaly Nexus
Help the Skyfish Banner complete the challenge of leaping over the Dragon Gate, regardless of whether they succeed or fail.

Risk Assessment
Generally does not attack proactively. Can serve as city scenery.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Cannot be contained.

Containment Measures
Not in containment.

Experiment Records

Skyfish Banner
story.id:
Sebagai salah satu Anomaly tertua, Tidal Ascension sudah ada di dunia ini jauh sebelum kertas dan pena. Setiap kali muncul, ia diiringi hujan lembut dari langit dan semua tumbuhan bersemi seperti musim semi. Bahkan tanah paling tandus dan gersang pun kembali hidup. Karena itu, di zaman ketika setiap helai rumput dianggap suci, Tidal Ascension dianggap berkah baik dari langit. Rakyat jelata menggelar pesta serta perayaan nyanyian dan tarian, memperingati fenomena ini lewat berbagai tradisi upacara. Namun, ada satu ritual yang dilakukan di mana-mana tanpa kecuali: melompati Dragon Gate.
Saat ritual dimulai, orang-orang membangun Dragon Gate yang menjulang tinggi. Skyfish Banner yang bermigrasi bersama fenomena Tidal Ascension lalu berlomba melompatinya, sementara para penampil terampil dengan cerdik menghadang mereka, mencegah mereka melewati Dragon Gate. Ya, aku bilang mencegah, bukan membantu. Inilah adat sejak zaman kuno, dan meski alasannya sudah lama terlupakan, generasi berikutnya tetap mengikutinya dengan ketat. Tak perlu dikatakan, pertunjukan yang begitu fantastis dan megah memikat hati semua anak, sehingga Tidal Ascension punya lapisan makna lain: mewujudkan impian masa kecil bersama kaum muda, agar mereka membawa hati yang tak pernah kehilangan kepolosannya.
Ikan mas warna-warni yang halus bagai kabut ini tak punya wujud fisik dan sebenarnya tak bisa dilukai atau dihalangi, tapi mereka menanggapi tindakan lawannya dengan sesuai. Menghentikan mereka tidak sulit, seolah tontonan ini sendiri sengaja bekerja sama dengan manusia untuk menyajikan ujian Dragon Gate dengan lebih romantis di mata anak-anak yang antusias. Saat menghadapi rintangan, ikan-ikan mas itu meniup gelembung, menjebak mereka yang menghalangi lompatan ke Dragon Gate. Gelembung-gelembung ringan ini membawa orang di dalamnya naik ke udara sebelum perlahan melayang turun lagi, sehingga anak-anak dengan semangat ikut serta. Karena lebih ringan, anak-anak sering terbang lebih tinggi, cukup tinggi untuk lenyap di antara awan dan melihat sekilas kampung halaman ikan-ikan mas itu. Ritual semacam ini akhirnya berubah menjadi permainan yang menggembirakan, dan ikan-ikan mas itu menyelesaikan ujian Dragon Gate mereka di tengah gelak tawa. Ikan mas warna-warni transparan yang gagal melompati Dragon Gate akan mengibaskan ekornya dan naik seperti kembang api, perlahan lenyap di langit yang jauh. Maka perayaan pun berakhir sempurna, dan anak-anak terus tumbuh sambil menyimpan kenangan indah hari itu.
Perayaan ini terus berlangsung sampai sebuah upacara di suatu tempat pada suatu tahun. Jika dipikir kembali, kemungkinan ada beberapa anak muda yang penasaran sengaja membiarkan ikan-ikan mas itu berhasil melompati Dragon Gate…
Seorang saksi pernah menceritakan kepada anak cucunya apa yang terjadi hari itu: seekor naga yang luar biasa megah, bangkit dari negeri yang jauh. "Naga raksasa yang terbuat dari ikan mas warna-warni yang tak terhitung! Ia berputar-putar di langit, dengan ikan-ikan yang terus berenang masuk ke tubuhnya dari segala arah. Lalu sebuah sungai di langit turun menyambutnya, dan naga itu mengikuti aliran surgawi itu kembali ke awan."
Baru beberapa hari kemudian, saat ikan-ikan terakhir sudah berpencar dan lenyap, orang-orang mendapati semua yang ikut upacara di tempat itu menghilang. Tempat desa itu dulu berdiri kini sunyi, tapi tumbuhannya tumbuh luar biasa lebat… Bahkan cerobong asap tertinggi pun tertutup bunga yang tak terhitung. Ada yang bilang mereka dihukum karena membuat marah para roh dengan sikap tak hormat terhadap ritual. Ada juga yang bilang mereka dipilih naga yang terbentuk dari ikan dan dibawa ke langit, menjadi ikan mas warna-warni baru yang menunggu migrasi berikutnya.
Namun, yang bisa kami pastikan hanyalah bahwa Anomaly ini bisa menimbulkan akibat luar biasa setelah berevolusi, yaitu setelah berhasil melompati Dragon Gate. Dari sudut pandang mana pun, kita harus berusaha sekuat tenaga agar kesalahan ini tidak terulang. Seperti tercatat dalam naskah kuno yang dipulihkan para arkeolog: "…Sisik-sisik berkilauan datang dari sembilan langit dalam jumlah besar, berusaha melewati Dragon Gate. Ke mana pun mereka lewat, hujan yang manis turun ke dunia dan semua tumbuhan hidup kembali. Seluruh rakyat bersuka cita, dan ini menjadi adat yang turun-temurun… Untuk mencegah bencana, hanya ada satu aturan: mereka tidak boleh dibiarkan melewati Dragon Gate."
Sayangnya, setelah makin banyak orang mengetahui kebenarannya, mustahil lagi mendekati fenomena ini dengan kepolosan murni seperti dulu. Ritual melompati Dragon Gate perlahan menjadi upacara kuno yang hanya ada di buku sejarah… Anak-anak masa lalu sudah lama ditelan sungai waktu, tak diingat siapa pun… Hanya ikan-ikan mas warna-warni yang masih kembali ke dunia manusia, lagi dan lagi.

Karakteristik Anomaly
· Mengiringi sungai ramping dari langit itu, bayangan ikan transparan yang bermigrasi ke sini mencari ujian melompati Dragon Gate.
· Mengabaikan kondisi geografis. Mampu menghidupkan kembali area di sekitarnya.
· Ujian yang gagal berakhir dengan "kembali ke langit", sementara yang berhasil membuat Anomaly ini berevolusi.

Anomaly Nexus
Bantu Skyfish Banner menyelesaikan tantangan melompati Dragon Gate, berhasil maupun gagal.

Penilaian Risiko
Umumnya tidak menyerang lebih dulu. Bisa menjadi pemandangan kota.

Status Containment/Penjaminan
Tidak bisa di-contain.

Langkah Containment
Tidak di-contain.

Catatan Eksperimen
/

story.en:
When Dolores Constantine broke the ultimate taboo of life and death, bringing the dead back to life and avoiding her own death entirely, the "Debt Collector" manifested. To drag what should have remained dead back to the afterlife, the Debt Collector mercilessly hunted down the lives of Dolores and her machinations. Though the Constantine family managed to dodge fate once, they were unable to do so again. In the end, the Debt Collector drove the bygone Constantine family straight into ruin.

The Debt Collector is the embodiment of a Rule Anomaly with a single, crystal‑clear purpose: erase any consequences caused by those attempting to defy the natural order. In every case recorded, the Debt Collector's appearance is closely linked to the last matriarch of the Constantine family—Dolores Constantine. After Dolores used her Esper Ability to transfer the embers of her remaining life into a puppet, her drained lifespan should've ended then and there. But the Anomaly she held, "Eternal Present," shielded her life. That perverse act—the reversal of life and death, the theft of time—triggered the manifestation of the Debt Collector, which went on to relentlessly pursue the Constantine family. It's believed that the Debt Collector's ongoing attacks on its "Debtors" are its way of forcing the world back into its proper, natural timeline.
The Debt Collector itself appears as a humanoid figure wrapped in a dark cloak, with one hand replaced by a large glaive, and the other substituted with a heavy chain. Only the "Debtor" themselves, along with other Espers, can perceive the Debt Collector. It manifests at the same time every day to attack its Debtor. These attacks are usually not physical, but instead, metaphysical. That isn't to say it cannot also cause serious physical harm—if anyone interferes with the Debt Collector's collection process, it will utilize the blade and chains it is equipped with till the very end. Once suffering sufficient damage, or its given attack window closes, the Debt Collector temporarily vanishes. Current theory suggests that only by fulfilling its "Rule" and fully clearing any outstanding debt can the Debt Collector finally be nullified.



Characteristics:
· The Debt Collector appears as a humanoid entity draped in a dark cloak.
· It attacks "Debtors" who committed the highest sin: reversal of the natural order.
· Only the Debtor and other Espers can see this Anomaly.
· It cannot be entirely destroyed, only temporarily repelled.

Anomaly Nexus:
The Debt recorded in the "Tally of Ages" is fully cleared.

Risk Assessment:
Difficult to measure accurately. As a Rule Anomaly, it is almost impossible to eliminate via normal means, and can only be temporarily banished, making it extremely dangerous for the victim. On the other hand, it almost never poses a threat to anyone other than the Debtor.

Containment Status:
Not contained.

/

Experiment Record:
/

story.id:
Saat Dolores Constantine melanggar tabu tertinggi tentang hidup dan mati, menghidupkan kembali yang sudah mati dan sepenuhnya menghindari kematiannya sendiri, "Debt Collector" pun muncul. Untuk menyeret apa yang seharusnya tetap mati kembali ke alam baka, Debt Collector tanpa ampun memburu nyawa Dolores dan hasil rekayasanya. Meski keluarga Constantine sempat sekali lolos dari takdir, mereka tak bisa melakukannya lagi. Pada akhirnya, Debt Collector menyeret keluarga Constantine yang sudah memudar itu menuju kehancuran.

Debt Collector adalah perwujudan Rule Anomaly dengan satu tujuan yang sangat jelas: menghapus segala akibat yang ditimbulkan mereka yang mencoba menentang tatanan alam. Dalam setiap kasus yang tercatat, kemunculan Debt Collector sangat berkaitan dengan nyonya terakhir keluarga Constantine, Dolores Constantine. Setelah Dolores memakai Esper Ability-nya untuk memindahkan bara sisa hidupnya ke sebuah boneka, umurnya yang terkuras seharusnya berakhir saat itu juga. Tapi Anomaly yang dipegangnya, "Eternal Present", melindungi nyawanya. Tindakan menyimpang itu, membalik hidup dan mati, mencuri waktu, memicu munculnya Debt Collector, yang kemudian tanpa henti memburu keluarga Constantine. Serangan Debt Collector yang terus-menerus terhadap "pengutang"-nya diyakini sebagai caranya memaksa dunia kembali ke garis waktu alaminya yang semestinya.
Debt Collector sendiri berwujud sosok manusia yang terbungkus jubah gelap, dengan satu tangan berupa glaive besar dan tangan lainnya berupa rantai berat. Hanya "pengutang" itu sendiri, beserta Esper lain, yang bisa melihat Debt Collector. Ia muncul pada waktu yang sama setiap hari untuk menyerang pengutangnya. Serangan ini biasanya bukan fisik, melainkan metafisik. Bukan berarti ia tak bisa menimbulkan cedera fisik serius; jika ada yang mengganggu proses penagihan Debt Collector, ia akan memakai bilah dan rantai yang dimilikinya sampai akhir. Setelah menerima cukup banyak kerusakan, atau saat waktu serangannya habis, Debt Collector lenyap untuk sementara. Teori saat ini menyebut bahwa hanya dengan memenuhi "Aturan"-nya dan melunasi seluruh utang yang tersisa, Debt Collector akhirnya bisa ter-nullify.



Karakteristik:
· Debt Collector berwujud entitas mirip manusia yang berselubung jubah gelap.
· Ia menyerang "pengutang" yang melakukan dosa tertinggi: membalik tatanan alam.
· Hanya pengutang dan Esper lain yang bisa melihat Anomaly ini.
· Ia tak bisa dihancurkan sepenuhnya, hanya bisa diusir sementara.

Anomaly Nexus:
Utang yang tercatat di "Tally of Ages" lunas sepenuhnya.

Penilaian Risiko:
Sulit diukur secara akurat. Sebagai Rule Anomaly, ia nyaris mustahil disingkirkan dengan cara biasa, dan hanya bisa diusir sementara, sehingga sangat berbahaya bagi korbannya. Di sisi lain, ia nyaris tak pernah mengancam siapa pun selain pengutangnya.

Status Containment:
Belum di-contain.

story.en:
Kids love cuddling their stuffed animals. Plenty of children grow up with at least one plush, bear-shaped friend. That bear is a diehard partner in crime, right up until the kid matures and the stuffed animal gets left behind in a closet or on a shelf somewhere.

The Phenomenon Anomaly, "Cuddly Bear", only manifests in toys adored by children. Its arrival seems to be visible to children only. Once affected, the toy becomes "alive" in the eyes of a child, while apparently remaining a normal stuffed animal to adults. Despite the name "Cuddly Bear", the toy's actual form depends on the child's preferences, and isn't limited specifically to bears.
From the moment a Cuddly Bear is born, it is dedicated towards one objective—to stay by its owner's side, grow up with them, listen to their troubles, and make sure they never feel alone. As the child grows and gradually becomes more independent, they stop needing their stuffed animal. When that time comes, the Cuddly Bear naturally undergoes nullification and reverts to being an ordinary toy.
Aside from providing emotional support, Cuddly Bears have no other effects. When the time for nullification arrives, most Cuddly Bears accept their fate with grace. However, there are always exceptions. Some refuse to disappear, causing their host toys to gain physical mobility and sentience, thus transforming into Derivative Anomalies. Those who are saddened by the "adults" who no longer need them become "Saddy Teddies", while those who harbor resentment toward the "child" who abandoned them become "Teehee Bears". Driven by grudges and animosity, a Cuddly Bear that has turned into a Derivative Anomaly will actively threaten the target of its anger.

In general, a person will encounter their very own Cuddly Bear once in a lifetime. So far, there are no recorded cases of a new Cuddly Bear manifesting on the same child's toys after the previous one has undergone nullification. However, "maturing" does not seem to be an absolute requirement for Cuddly Bear nullification. In a select few cases, there have been Cuddly Bear owners who, even as adults, still can't part with their Cuddly Bear. In such cases, the Cuddly Bear's duration of existence far exceeds the norm.

Characteristics:
· When an ordinary toy is affected by this Anomaly, it moves and acts—within the child's perception—in whatever way the child desires.
· It has no real physical capabilities and only serves to provide emotional value to the child.

Anomaly Nexus:
As the child matures, and the Cuddly Bear is no longer needed and is gradually forgotten, the Anomaly undergoes nullification—typically resulting in the Cuddly Bear returning to its initial stuffed animal state.

Risk Assessment:
Low Risk.

Containment Status:
Due to its unique Nexus, no Cuddly Bear has been contained to date.

Containment Procedures:
/

Experiment Record:
/

Derivative Anomaly:
C-3091-1(Ob) Teehee Bear
C-3091-2(Ob) Saddy Teddy
story.id:
Anak-anak suka memeluk boneka mereka. Banyak anak tumbuh dengan setidaknya satu teman boneka berbentuk beruang. Beruang itu adalah sahabat setia, sampai si anak dewasa dan boneka itu tertinggal di lemari atau di rak entah di mana.

Phenomenon Anomaly "Cuddly Bear" hanya muncul pada mainan yang sangat disayangi anak-anak. Kehadirannya tampaknya hanya bisa dilihat anak-anak. Begitu terpengaruh, mainan itu menjadi "hidup" di mata seorang anak, sementara bagi orang dewasa tetap tampak seperti boneka biasa. Meski bernama "Cuddly Bear", wujud mainan sebenarnya tergantung kesukaan si anak, dan tidak terbatas pada beruang.
Sejak lahir, Cuddly Bear punya satu tujuan: tetap di sisi pemiliknya, tumbuh bersamanya, mendengarkan keluh kesahnya, dan memastikan ia tak pernah merasa sendirian. Seiring anak tumbuh dan perlahan makin mandiri, ia tak lagi membutuhkan bonekanya. Saat waktu itu tiba, Cuddly Bear akan ter-nullify secara alami dan kembali menjadi mainan biasa.
Selain memberi dukungan emosional, Cuddly Bear tidak punya efek lain. Saat waktu Nullification tiba, sebagian besar Cuddly Bear menerima nasibnya dengan lapang dada. Namun, selalu ada pengecualian. Sebagian menolak lenyap, membuat mainan inangnya bisa bergerak dan punya kesadaran, sehingga berubah menjadi Derivative Anomaly. Mereka yang sedih karena "orang dewasa" tak lagi membutuhkan mereka menjadi "Saddy Teddy", sementara mereka yang menyimpan dendam terhadap "anak" yang menelantarkan mereka menjadi "Teehee Bear". Didorong dendam dan kebencian, Cuddly Bear yang sudah menjadi Derivative Anomaly akan aktif mengancam sasaran kemarahannya.

Secara umum, seseorang akan bertemu Cuddly Bear miliknya sendiri sekali seumur hidup. Sejauh ini, belum ada kasus tercatat Cuddly Bear baru muncul di mainan anak yang sama setelah yang sebelumnya ter-nullify. Namun, "menjadi dewasa" tampaknya bukan syarat mutlak Nullification Cuddly Bear. Dalam beberapa kasus langka, ada pemilik Cuddly Bear yang bahkan saat dewasa masih tak bisa berpisah dengan Cuddly Bear-nya. Dalam kasus seperti itu, masa keberadaan Cuddly Bear jauh melebihi biasanya.

Karakteristik:
· Saat mainan biasa terpengaruh Anomaly ini, ia bergerak dan bertindak, dalam persepsi si anak, sesuai keinginan anak itu.
· Ia tidak punya kemampuan fisik nyata dan hanya berfungsi memberi nilai emosional bagi si anak.

Anomaly Nexus:
Seiring anak tumbuh dewasa, dan Cuddly Bear tak lagi dibutuhkan lalu perlahan terlupakan, Anomaly ini ter-nullify, biasanya membuat Cuddly Bear kembali menjadi boneka biasa.

Penilaian Risiko:
Risiko Rendah.

Status Containment:
Karena Nexus-nya yang unik, sampai saat ini belum ada Cuddly Bear yang berhasil di-contain.

Prosedur Containment:
/

Catatan Eksperimen:
/

Derivative Anomaly:
C-3091-1(Ob) Teehee Bear
C-3091-2(Ob) Saddy Teddy
